Blockage of GADD153/CHOP expression by siRNA reduced Tan-IIA-induced cell death in LNCaP cells. These data provide evidence supporting Tan-IIA as a potential anticancer agent by inducing ER stress in prostate cancer.

titre: Changes in fPSA level could discriminate tPSA flare-up from tPSA progression in patients with castration-refractory prostate cancer during the initial phase of docetaxel-based chemotherapy.
resume_court: To evaluate whether changes in fPSA level could predict tPSA flare-up in patients with castration-refractory prostate cancer during the initial phase of docetaxel-based chemotherapy. According to changes in tPSA level, 79 patients were divided into 3 groups: response (group 1), progression (group 2) and flare-up (group 3). fPSA and tPSA levels showed different patterns in groups 1, 2 and 3.

titre: Selection of 2'F-modified RNA aptamers against prostate-specific antigen and their evaluation for diagnostic and therapeutic applications.
resume_court: Currently, prostate-specific antigen (PSA) is considered to be the most sensitive marker available for prostate cancer detection and for monitoring of disease progression. In order to demonstrate the functionality of the selected aptamers, an apta-PCR approach was used for the quantitative detection of PSA, achieving a limit of detection of 11 nM.

titre: A new RNA-seq method to detect the transcription and non-coding RNA in prostate cancer.
resume_court: Prostate cancer is a big killer in many regions especially American men, and this year, the diagnosed rate rises rapidly. We aimed to find the biomarker or any changing in prostate cancer patients. Finally, we found the many important non-coding RNA related to prostate cancer, some of them were long non-coding RNA (lncRNA).

titre: Denosumab and bone metastasis-free survival in men with nonmetastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer: exploratory analyses by baseline prostate-specific antigen doubling time.
resume_court: To identify men at greatest risk for bone metastasis or death, we evaluated relationships between PSA and PSADT with BMFS in the placebo group and the efficacy and safety of denosumab in men with PSADT = 10, = 6, and = 4 months. Denosumab consistently improves BMFS in men with shorter PSADT and seems to have the greatest treatment effects in men at high risk for progression.

titre: Comparison of continence recovery between robot-assisted laparoscopic prostatectomy and open radical retropubic prostatectomy: a single surgeon experience.
resume_court: To evaluate the recovery of continence after robot-assisted laparoscopic prostatectomy (RALP) and open radical retropubic prostatectomy (RRP). Our study suggests that RALP is an independent factor for the recovery of continence and that RALP has advantages for postoperative continence recovery and the quality of continence compared with RRP.

titre: Risks and benefits of late onset hypogonadism treatment: an expert opinion.
resume_court: Late-onset hypogonadism (LOH) is a syndromic condition that has a well-recognized association with sexual and reproductive failure. Despite this evidence, in patients with these conditions, LOH is still only rarely investigated and testosterone replacement therapy (TRT) rarely considered. Hence, further research is required regarding the long-term benefits and adverse effects of TRT in LOH.

titre: The surgical procedure is the most important factor affecting continence recovery after laparoscopic radical prostatectomy.
resume_court: We analyzed factors associated with early recovery of continence after laparoscopic radical prostatectomy. None of the urodynamic parameters correlated with continence recovery time. The current intrafascial surgical procedure is the most important factor affecting early recovery of continence after laparoscopic radical prostatectomy.

titre: Comparison of robot-assisted and open retropubic radical prostatectomy for risk of biochemical progression in men with positive surgical margins.
resume_court: Robot-assisted radical prostatectomy (RARP) is a minimally invasive alternative to open retropubic radical prostatectomy (RP), and is reported to offer equivalent oncologic outcomes while reducing perioperative morbidity. As such, all patients with a PSM at RP are at high risk for BCR and should be followed in the same manner regardless of the surgical approach.

titre: Synthesis and structure-activity relationship studies of novel dihydropyridones as androgen receptor modulators.
resume_court: A library of 3-hydroxy-2,3-dihydropyridones was synthesized, and their activities as antiandrogens were tested in the human prostate cancer cell line LNCaP. The model is qualitatively consistent with the observed SAR. Therefore, the model probably represents a realistic conformation of the antagonist form and can be utilized for structure-based design of novel antiandrogens.

titre: Use of combined scanning electrochemical and fluorescence microscopy for detection of reactive oxygen species in prostate cancer cells.
resume_court: Release of ROS from prostate cancer (PC3) cells was studied using scanning electrochemical microscopy (SECM) and fluorescence microscopy. This profile reflects the combined effects of topographical change and ROS release at the PC3 cell surfaces. The extracellular ROS level detected at the SECM tip was found to be similar to the intracellular ROS level monitored using fluorescence microscopy.

titre: Endorectal balloons in the post prostatectomy setting: do gains in stability lead to more predictable dosimetry?
resume_court: To perform a comparative study assessing potential benefits of endorectal-balloons (ERB) in post-prostatectomy patients. The range of mean ?COV for the rectum was 0.15-0.58 cm and 0.15-0.59 cm for the non-ERB and ERB groups. While for the ERB group the difference in D95% was 8.7 ± 12.6 Gy and 0.003 ± 0.104 Gy.

titre: Palliative pelvic radiotherapy of symptomatic incurable prostate cancer - a systematic review.
resume_court: Patients with prostate cancer (PC) and a symptomatic pelvic tumor may be treated with palliative pelvic radiotherapy for symptom relief or to delay symptom progression. There were large variations in radiotherapy dose and fractionation. No recommendations can be provided regarding target dose or fractionation schedule in this context.

titre: Multisector prostate dosimetric quality: analysis of a large community database.
resume_court: To evaluate multi-institutional prostate brachytherapy dosimetric quality using multisector analysis. At the anterior midgland and apex, 22% and 19% of sectors were minimal. Coverage of base sectors was inferior to midgland and apical sectors, and coverage of anterior sectors was notably inferior to lateral and posterior sectors.

titre: Overestimation of nuclear matrix protein 22 in concentrated urine.
resume_court: To confirm the hypothesis that nuclear matrix protein 22 (NMP22) is overestimated in concentrated urine, we compared the NMP22 values measured at different dietary states. Subjects with an abnormal NMP22 value tended to have a more concentrated urine with a greater urine specific gravity than did the subjects with a normal NMP22 value.

titre: Obesity is associated with larger prostate volume but not with worse urinary symptoms: analysis of a large multiethnic cohort.
resume_court: To evaluate the associations between body mass index (BMI) and prostate volume (PV) and lower urinary tract symptoms in a multiethnic cohort. In multivariable analyses, higher BMI was associated with larger PV (P <.001) but not IPSS (P = .91). Higher BMI is associated with larger PV but not worse lower urinary tract symptoms (measured using IPSS).

titre: Emergency presentation of cancer and short-term mortality.
resume_court: The short-term survival following a cancer diagnosis in England is lower than that in comparable countries, with the difference in excess mortality primarily occurring in the months immediately after diagnosis. This is partly a case-mix effect but EP remains predictive of short-term mortality even when age, stage, and co-morbidity are accounted for.

titre: Sexual values as the key to maintaining satisfying sex after prostate cancer treatment: the physical pleasure-relational intimacy model of sexual motivation.
resume_court: Sexual dysfunction is the most significant long lasting effect of prostate cancer (PrCa) treatment. The PRISM model predicts that couples who place a greater value on sex for relational intimacy will better adjust to the sexual challenges after PrCa treatment than couples who place a lower value on sex for relational intimacy. Implications of the model for counselling are discussed.

titre: York Mason procedure to repair iatrogenic rectourinary fistula: our experience.
resume_court: Rectourinary fistula (RUF) is an uncommon but devastating condition in men. Overall, more than 50 % of patients treated with the York Mason posterior, transanal, transrectal approach remained free of fistula during follow-up. The posterior trans-sphincteric approach of the York Mason technique is effective in treating RUF.

titre: The association between HIF-1a polymorphism and cancer risk: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
resume_court: Epidemiological studies have assessed the association between HIF-1a polymorphisms and cancer risk. Overall, C1772T and G1790A but not rs2057482 were associated with increased risk for cancer. Furthermore, we detected increased cancer risk in haplotypes TA and CA and in those carrying at least one risk allele, and decreased cancer risk in haplotype TG regarding C1772T and G1790A polymorphisms.

titre: The potential impact of adding genetic markers to clinical parameters in managing high-risk prostate cancer patients.
resume_court: High-risk prostate cancer is a potentially lethal disease that is increasing in the diagnosis of prostate cancer patients. The main objective is to identify genetic variants of RNASEL that could be associated with high-risk prostate cancer to improve the clinical managing of these patients. A total of 231 prostate cancer patients were genotyped for 7 variants of RNASEL gene.

titre: Pre-analytical-related variability influencing serum peptide profiles demonstrated in a mass spectrometry-based search for colorectal and prostate cancer biomarkers.
resume_court: Although the degradome, which comprises proteolytic fragments of blood proteins, presents a potential source of diagnostic biomarkers, studies on cancer peptide biomarkers have provided inconsistent conclusions. In the present study, we reevaluated the usefulness of serum degradome analyses for searching peptide cancer biomarker candidates. Of them, 49 peptides originated from APOA4.

titre: Molecular lipidomics of exosomes released by PC-3 prostate cancer cells.
resume_court: The molecular lipid composition of exosomes is largely unknown. Furthermore, lipid species, even of classes not enriched in exosomes, were selectively included in exosomes. Several of the lipids enriched in exosomes could potentially be used as cancer biomarkers.

titre: Design, synthesis, and biological evaluation of novel investigational nonapeptide KISS1R agonists with testosterone-suppressive activity.
resume_court: Metastin/kisspeptin is a 54 amino acid peptide ligand of the KISS1R receptor and is a critical regulator of GnRH secretion. We have developed a decapeptide analog [D-Tyr(45),D-Trp(47),azaGly(51),Arg(Me)(53)]metastin(45-54) with improved serum stability compared with metastin(45-54) but with decreased KISS1R agonistic activity.

titre: Extracellular matrix protein fibronectin induces matrix metalloproteinases in human prostate adenocarcinoma cells PC-3.
resume_court: Studies on interaction of tumor cells with ECM components showed increased extracellular protease activity mediated by the family of matrix metalloproteinases (MMPs). Our findings indicate that, binding of PC-3 cells to FN, possibly via a5ß1 integrin, induces signaling involving FAK, PI-3K, Akt, NF-?B followed by upregulation of MMP-9 and MMP-1. CD-44 may have role in modulating MMP-9 activity.

titre: Magnetic nanobeads as potential contrast agents for magnetic resonance imaging.
resume_court: Metal-oxo clusters have been used as building blocks to form hybrid nanomaterials and evaluated as potential MRI contrast agents. The metal-oxo cluster Mn8Fe4(VBA)16 (VBA = vinyl benzoic acid) can be copolymerized with styrene under miniemulsion conditions.

titre: Patient with TDS and increased PSA (implications in prostate biopsy)
resume_court: Since 70 years ago testosterone is considered a risk factor for prostate cancer and its supplementation in men with testosterone deficit syndrome is considered a risk for the development of a prostatic neoplasia. Over this practical base, we expose the current evidence on prostatic safety in men with testosterone supplementation.

titre: Patient with testosterone deficit syndrome after radical prostatectomy
resume_court: Testosterone Deficiency Syndrome is associated with age. Only one patient had biochemical recurrence during replacement therapy. Testosterone replacement therapy must be indicated in selected patients with history of low risk localized prostate cancer treated satisfactorily who are symptomatic and have good oncological control.

titre: Patient with testosterone deficit syndrome after external beam radiotherapy
resume_court: In certain situations there is still great controversy, without enough evidence to establish an action. References in case of patientstreated with brachytherapy or radiotherapy are unspecific: they only recommend caution in the treatment with TRT in these patients and strict monitoring of the possible recurrence.

titre: Testosterone deficit syndrome in the old male
resume_court: Epidemiological studies have demonstrated that prevalence of hypogonadism in old males increases with every additional decade of life. Currently, testosterone injections and gel preparations are the most used. A general recommendation cannot be given that testosterone replacement therapy may be applied to all aging males with low testosterone levels independently of significant signs or symptoms.

titre: Current recommendations about the diagnosis and treatment of testosterone deficit syndrome: Clinical guidelines
resume_court: Testosterone deficit syndrome (TDS) is a clinical and biochemical syndrome associated with advanced age and characterized by some typical symptoms and decrease in serum testosterone levels, which can affect multiple organs and systems, deteriorating the quality of life of the males who suffer it.

titre: A case on hemodialysis with castration-resistant prostate cancer which responded to combination chemotherapy with docetaxel and prednisolone
resume_court: A 71-year-old man on hemodialysis was admitted for castration-resistant prostate cancer. He received chemotherapy with docetaxel(60mg/m2 every 3 weeks)and prednisolone(10mg/day). Chemotherapy with docetaxel and prednisolone can be safely carried out for a patient with castration-resistant prostate cancer, even while on hemodialysis with the usual dose of docetaxel.

titre: Hydrodynamic cavitation kills prostate cells and ablates benign prostatic hyperplasia tissue.
resume_court: Hydrodynamic cavitation is a physical phenomenon characterized by vaporization and bubble formation in liquids under low local pressures, and their implosion following their release to a higher pressure environment. We showed that hydrodynamic cavitation could kill prostate cells in a pressure- and time-dependent manner.

titre: Monoclonal antibody against cell surface GRP78 as a novel agent in suppressing PI3K/AKT signaling, tumor growth, and metastasis.
resume_court: The ER chaperone GRP78 translocates to the surface of tumor cells and promotes survival, metastasis, and resistance to therapy. Antitumor activity was tested in cancer cell culture, tumor xenograft models, tumor metastasis models, and spontaneous tumor models. GRP78-specific antibody MAb159 modulates the PI3K pathway and inhibits tumor growth and metastasis.

titre: Combination therapy with a second-generation androgen receptor antagonist and a metastasis vaccine improves survival in a spontaneous prostate cancer model.
resume_court: Enzalutamide, a second-generation androgen antagonist, was approved by the U.S. Finally, the combination of enzalutamide and Twist-vaccine to improve TRAMP mice overall survival was evaluated. The combination of enzalutamide and Twist-vaccine resulted in significantly increased overall survival of TRAMP mice compared with other treatment groups (27.5 vs. 10.3 weeks).

titre: Terfenadine induces anti-proliferative and apoptotic activities in human hormone-refractory prostate cancer through histamine receptor-independent Mcl-1 cleavage and Bak up-regulation.
resume_court: Although the results of several studies have underscored the regulatory effect of H1-histamine receptors in cell proliferation of some cancer cell types, its effect in prostate cancers remains unclear. The activation of caspase cascades was detected to be linked to terfenadine action. In conclusion, terfenadine induced apoptotic signaling cascades against HRPCs in a sequential manner.

titre: Tissues in different anatomical sites can sculpt and vary the tumor microenvironment to affect responses to therapy.
resume_court: The tumor microenvironment can promote tumor growth and reduce treatment efficacy. Compared with SC tumors, orthotopic tumors had a microenvironment associated with a type 2 immune response, related to immunosuppression, and an involvement of alternatively activated macrophages in the kidney model. Orthotopic kidney tumors were more highly vascularized than SC tumors.

titre: Preoperative prognostic factors for biochemical recurrence after robot-assisted radical prostatectomy in Japan.
resume_court: We investigated oncological outcomes in Japanese patients who underwent robot-assisted radical prostatectomy (RARP). This study included 389 patients who underwent RARP at a single institution with a follow-up period of at least 1 year. This report provides a framework with which to estimate oncological outcomes in patients who underwent RARP for localized prostate cancer.

titre: Lifetime body size and prostate cancer risk in a population-based case-control study in Sweden.
resume_court: The role of body size in prostate cancer etiology is unclear and potentially varies by age and disease subtype. We investigated whether body size in childhood and adulthood, including adult weight change, is related to total, low-intermediate-risk, high-risk, and fatal prostate cancer. Moderate adult weight gain increased the risk of disease in men with low BMI at start and in short men.

titre: Quality assurance evaluation of spot scanning beam proton therapy with an anthropomorphic prostate phantom.
resume_court: The purpose of this study was to evaluate spot scanning proton therapy with an anthropomorphic prostate phantom at the Proton Therapy Center of The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center at Houston, TX (PTCH). The RPC anthropomorphic prostate phantom could be used to establish quality assurance of spot scanning proton beam for patients with prostate cancer.

titre: Role of step size and max dwell time in anatomy based inverse optimization for prostate implants.
resume_court: In high dose rate (HDR) brachytherapy, the source dwell times and dwell positions are vital parameters in achieving a desirable implant dose distribution. This study was designed to evaluate the optimum source step size and maximum source dwell time for prostate brachytherapy implants using an Ir-192 source. Our study supports use of a 0.5 cm step size for prostate implants.

titre: Pharmaceutical approval update.
resume_court: Fluticasone furoate/vilanterol inhalation powder (Breo Ellipta) for chronic obstructive pulmonary disease; atorvastatin/ezetimibe tablets (Liptruzet) for reducing low-density lipoproteincholesterol; and radium 223 dichloride (Xofigo) injection for late-stage, castrationresistant prostate cancer.

titre: Focal low-dose rate brachytherapy for the treatment of prostate cancer.
resume_court: Whole-gland low-dose rate (LDR) brachytherapy has been a well-established modality of treating low-risk prostate cancer. Treatment in a focal manner has the advantages of reduced toxicity to surrounding organs. Focal treatment using LDR brachytherapy has been relatively unexplored, but it may offer advantages over other modalities that have established experiences with a focal approach.

titre: Effect of an angiotensin II type 1 receptor blocker on caveolin-1 expression in prostate cancer cells.
resume_court: Caveolin-1, the major structural protein of caveolae, interacts directly with the AT1 receptor. The AT1-R-caveolin complex in caveolae may coordinate angiotensin II (Ang II) induced signalling. The aim of this study was to determine the effect of the angiotensin II receptor type 1 blocker candesartan on caveolin expression in human metastatic prostate adenocarcinoma cells PC-3.

titre: Prostatic Schistosoma japonicum with atypical immunophenotyping of individual glandular tubes: a case report and review of the literature.
resume_court: There are few cases of prostatic schistosomiasis. Whether the S. japonicum infection contributed to the lesion or not is unknown. This is the first case report of prostatic S. japonicum in the English literatures.

titre: Nutraceuticals for prostate cancer chemoprevention: from molecular mechanisms to clinical application.
resume_court: Nutraceutical is a food, or part of a food, used for the prevention and/or treatment of diseases. Their mechanisms of action on regulating key processes of carcinogenesis are also discussed. Future cancer prevention clinical trials for the nutraceuticals should recruit men with an increased risk of prostate cancer.

titre: Relation of ETS transcription factor family member ERG, androgen receptor and topoisomerase 2ß expression to TMPRSS2-ERG fusion status in prostate cancer.
resume_court: Fusion of TMPRSS2 with ERG in prostate cells is determined by double-strand DNA breaks induced by androgen signaling and transcription stress. The most significant co-expression of ERG was found with AR in CaP (p=0.001). Keywords: androgen receptor; ERG; topoisomerase 2ß; TMPRSS2-ERG fusion; prostate cancer.

titre: Tribody: robust self-assembled trimeric targeting ligands with high stability and significantly improved target-binding strength.
resume_court: The C-terminal coiled-coil region of mouse and human cartilage matrix protein (CMP) self-assembles into a parallel trimeric complex. Our results demonstrate that CMP-based self-assembly of tribodies can be a general strategy for the facile and robust generation of trivalent targeting ligands for a wide variety of in vitro and in vivo applications.

titre: Declining use of brachytherapy for the treatment of prostate cancer.
resume_court: To analyze the recent trends in the utilization of external beam radiation therapy (EBRT) and brachytherapy (BT) for the treatment of prostate cancer. The decline of BT utilization differed by patient race, SEER registry, median county income, and National Comprehensive Cancer Network risk categorization (all p<0.001), but not by patient age (p=0.763) or marital status (p=0.193).

titre: Climacturia after definitive treatment of prostate cancer.
resume_court: Prostate cancer treatment results in several sexually related side effects beyond the well studied erectile dysfunction. Climacturia had no significant impact on orgasmic function and satisfaction. We found a complex relationship between stress urinary incontinence and climacturia, and noted that the presence of climacturia does not necessarily negatively impact sexual satisfaction.

titre: Effect of comprehensive lifestyle changes on telomerase activity and telomere length in men with biopsy-proven low-risk prostate cancer: 5-year follow-up of a descriptive pilot study.
resume_court: Telomere shortness in human beings is a prognostic marker of ageing, disease, and premature morbidity. We followed up participants to investigate long-term effects. Our comprehensive lifestyle intervention was associated with increases in relative telomere length after 5 years of follow-up, compared with controls, in this small pilot study.

titre: Adjuvant versus salvage radiation therapy for prostate cancer patients with adverse pathologic features: comparative analysis of long-term outcomes.
resume_court: To compare long-term outcomes of men with adverse pathologic features after adjuvant radiation therapy (ART) versus salvage radiation therapy (SRT) after radical prostatectomy at our institution. Although unadjusted analyses showed improved FFBF with ART, the propensity score-adjusted analyses demonstrated that long-term outcomes of patients treated with ART and SRT do not differ significantly.

titre: Radium-223 chloride: Extending life in prostate cancer patients by treating bone metastases.
resume_court: The treatment scope for patients with metastatic castrate-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) is rapidly expanding. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved radium-223 chloride ((223)RaCl2) for the treatment of mCRPC patients whose metastases are limited to the bones. Radium-223 is an a-emitting alkaline earth metal ion, which, similar to calcium ions, accumulates in the bone.

titre: Targeting fibroblast growth factor pathways in prostate cancer.
resume_court: Advanced prostate cancer carries a poor prognosis and novel therapies are needed. The involvement of FGF pathways in multiple mechanisms relevant to prostate tumorigenesis provides a rationale for the therapeutic blockade of this pathway, and two small-molecule tyrosine kinase inhibitors-dovitinib and nintedanib-are currently in phase II clinical development for advanced prostate cancer.

titre: The novel toluidine sulphonamide EL102 shows pre-clinical in vitro and in vivo activity against prostate cancer and circumvents MDR1 resistance.
resume_court: Taxanes are routinely used for the treatment of prostate cancer, however the majority of patients eventually develop resistance. Tubulin polymerisation and immunofluorescence assays were used to assess tubulin dynamics. Multidrug-resistant lung cancer DLKPA was used to assess EL102 in a MDR1-mediated drug resistance background.

titre: PIAS1-modulated Smad2/4 complex activation is involved in zinc-induced cancer cell apoptosis.
resume_court: Prostate cancer is one of the most frequently diagnosed cancers among men. However, the mechanism for zinc-mediated prostate cancer chemoprevention remains enigmatic. Our results suggest a new avenue for regulation of zinc-induced apoptosis, and provide a model that demonstrates zinc endorses the Smad2/4/PIAS1 complex to activate the p21(WAF1/Cip1) gene that mediates apoptosis.

titre: Intraprostatic distribution and long-term follow-up after AdV-tk immunotherapy as neoadjuvant to surgery in patients with prostate cancer.
resume_court: A phase I-II study to evaluate gene-mediated cytotoxic immunotherapy in newly diagnosed prostate cancer before radical prostatectomy was conducted in Monterrey, Mexico. In vivo vector distribution was analyzed from the resected tissue of four patients. For vector delivery, two apical and two basal injections of 0.5 ml led to optimal organ-wide distribution ex vivo and in vivo.

titre: Targeting amino acid transport in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer: effects on cell cycle, cell growth, and tumor development.
resume_court: L-type amino acid transporters (LATs) uptake neutral amino acids including L-leucine into cells, stimulating mammalian target of rapamycin complex 1 signaling and protein synthesis. LAT inhibition suppressed M-phase cell cycle genes regulated by E2F family transcription factors including critical castration-resistant prostate cancer regulatory genes UBE2C, CDC20, and CDK1.

titre: Population-based analysis of prostate-specific antigen (PSA) screening in younger men (<55 years) in Australia.
resume_court: To analyse the trends in opportunistic PSA screening in Australia, focusing on younger men (<55 years of age), to examine the effects of this screening on transrectal ultrasonography (TRUS)-guided biopsy rates and to determine the nature of prostate cancers (PCas) being detected. Screening resulted in two thirds of men aged <55 years receiving a negative TRUS biopsy.

titre: Influence of lycopene on cell viability, cell cycle, and apoptosis of human prostate cancer and benign hyperplastic cells.
resume_court: Prostate cancer is the most common malignancy in men and the second leading cause of cancer-related mortality in men of the Western world. Using real time PCR assay, lycopene also induced apoptosis in prostate cancer cells with altered gene expression of Bax and Bcl-2. These results suggest an effect of lycopene on activity of human prostate cancer cells.

titre: Impact of prostate size on urinary quality of life scores after open radical prostatectomy: a single-center experience.
resume_court: The aim of this study was to assess the effects of prostate size on long-term health-related quality of life (HRQoL) and functional outcomes after radical prostatectomy (RP). In patients with large prostate glands, postoperative improvement was observed in HRQoL and functional outcome after RP. Thus, RP may be beneficial in patients with large prostates.

titre: Percentage of high-grade tumour volume does not meaningfully improve prediction of early biochemical recurrence after radical prostatectomy compared with Gleason score.
resume_court: Multivariable Cox regression models addressed early BCR. In multivariable Cox regression models %HGTV emerged as an independent predictor of early BCR (P < 0.001), whereas %TV did not (P > 0.05). In a large cohort of patients with high-risk prostate cancer, %HGTV and %TV did not improve prediction of early BCR after RP substantially, although %HGTV was an independent predictor of early BCR.

titre: Single nucleotide polymorphisms in fibroblast growth factor 23 gene, FGF23, are associated with prostate cancer risk.
resume_court: To determine whether sequence variants within the FGF23 gene are associated with the risk of developing prostate cancer in a Korean population. In addition, we performed a haplotype analysis for the five FGF23 SNPs tested. Three SNPs in the FGF23 gene (rs11063118, rs13312789 and rs7955866) were associated with an increased risk of prostate cancer in our study population.

titre: Current methods of analgesia for transrectal ultrasonography (TRUS)-guided prostate biopsy -- a systematic review.
resume_court: Transrectal ultrasonography (TRUS)-guided prostate biopsy is the most commonly used method of sampling prostate tissue for the diagnosis of prostate cancer. Commonly used approaches that are effective to minimise pain or discomfort include intravenous sedoanalgesia, inhalational agents and periprostatic infiltration of local anaesthetic.

titre: Soy and soy isoflavones in prostate cancer: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
resume_court: To evaluate the evidence from randomized controlled trials (RCTs) on the efficacy and safety of soy/isoflavones in men with prostate cancer (PCa) or with a clinically identified risk of PCa. Meta-analyses of the two studies including men with identified risk of PCa found a significant reduction in PCa diagnosis after administration of soy/soy isoflavones (risk ratio = 0.49, 95% CI 0.26, 0.95).

titre: Comparison of contemporary methods for estimating prostate tumour volume in pathological specimens.
resume_court: To evaluate the accuracy of various prostate tumour volume (TV) estimation methods. The estimation methods were compared against the 'gold-standard' and the accuracy of identifying clinically significant tumours of TV =0.5?cc was determined. Sensitivity and specificity for identifying clinically significant tumours was 94% and 92% respectively, when using the ellipsoid estimation.

titre: Oncological outcomes after robot-assisted radical prostatectomy: long-term follow-up in 4803 patients.
resume_court: To evaluate oncological outcomes in patients undergoing robot-assisted radical prostatectomy (RARP) at a high-volume tertiary centre with focus on biochemical recurrence (BCR); previous studies on oncological outcomes for patients undergoing RARP for prostate cancer are limited to small series. In patients with node-positive disease, actuarial 5-year BCRFS, MFS, and CSS were 26%, 82%, and 97%.

titre: Bladder outlet obstruction (BOO) in men with castration-resistant prostate cancer.
resume_court: To evaluate the frequency of bladder outlet obstruction (BOO) and detrusor overactivity (DO) in patients with castration-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC) and lower urinary tract symptoms (LUTS). Compared with the BPE group, patients with CRPC had lower cystometric bladder capacities (P = 0.003), were less likely to have BOO (14 vs 43%, P = 0.009) and more likely to have DO (57 vs 29%, P = 0.028).

titre: Prostate-specific antigen doubling time as a progression criterion in an active surveillance programme for patients with localized prostate cancer.
resume_court: To elucidate the role of prostate-specific antigen (PSA) doubling time (PSAdt) as a progression criterion in patients with low-risk prostate cancer managed by active surveillance (AS). The uncertainty of calculated PSAdt during AS leads to a significant risk of patients being misclassified in terms of risk of progression, which limits the use of PSAdt in the management of patients on AS.

titre: Mortality and complications after prostate biopsy in the Prostate, Lung, Colorectal and Ovarian Cancer Screening (PLCO) trial.
resume_court: To examine mortality and morbidity after prostate biopsy in the intervention arm of the Prostate, Lung, Colorectal and Ovarian Cancer Screening (PLCO) trial. Cancers and deaths among the participants were tracked. Mortality rates were not found to be higher after prostate biopsy in the PLCO trial and complications were relatively infrequent, with several risk factors identified.

titre: Comparative genomics reveals distinct host-interacting traits of three major human-associated propionibacteria.
resume_court: Propionibacteria are part of the human microbiota. Despite their omnipresence on human skin little is known about the role of cutaneous propionibacteria. Whereas P. avidum and P. granulosum produce an EPS-like surface structure and pili-like appendices, respectively, P. acnes possesses a number of unique surface-exposed proteins with host-interacting properties.

titre: Indications, results and safety profile of transperineal sector biopsies (TPSB) of the prostate: a single centre experience of 634 cases.
resume_court: To describe a protocol for transperineal sector biopsies (TPSB) of the prostate and present the clinical experience of this technique in a UK population. Of men with Gleason 3+3 disease on TRB, 29% were upgraded and went on to have radical treatment. TPSB of the prostate has a role in defining disease previously missed or under-diagnosed by TRB.

titre: Serum calcium concentration and prostate cancer risk: a multicenter study.
resume_court: This study sought to further evaluate the possible effects of serum calcium level on prostate cancer (PC) risk, with considering the age, body mass index (BMI), and sex steroid hormones. Serum total and ionized calcium levels were categorized into tertiles. Furthermore, no evidence was found regarding age, BMI, and sex steroid hormones to modify the association between serum calcium and PC risk.

titre: Prospective comparison of quality-of-life outcomes between ileal conduit urinary diversion and orthotopic neobladder reconstruction after radical cystectomy: a statistical model.
resume_court: To conduct a prospective comparison of quality-of-life (QoL) outcomes in patients who underwent ileal conduit (IC) urinary diversion with those who underwent orthotopic neobladder (ONB) reconstruction after radical cystectomy for invasive bladder cancers. ONB reconstruction provides better QoL outcomes than does IC urinary diversion.

titre: Functional and oncological outcomes of patients aged <50 years treated with radical prostatectomy for localised prostate cancer in a European population.
resume_court: To address the biochemical and functional outcomes after radical prostatectomy (RP) of men aged <50 years in a large European population. Men aged <50 years diagnosed with localised prostate cancer should not be discouraged from RP, as the postoperative rates of urinary incontinence and erectile dysfunction are low and probability of BCR-free survival at 2 and 5 years is high.

titre: Focal cryoablation: a treatment option for unilateral low-risk prostate cancer.
resume_court: To assess oncological (biochemical and histological recurrence) and functional (urinary and potency) outcomes in patients with unilateral low-risk organ-confined prostate cancer (PCa) treated with focal cryoablation (FC). Urinary symptoms were unchanged. A slight decrease in the IIEF-5 score was present at 3 months, but did not differ significantly from baseline at 6-month follow-up.

titre: Prospective analysis of penile length changes after radical prostatectomy.
resume_court: To assess the impact of radical prostatectomy (RP) on penile dimensions. In this rigorously conducted prospective study of SFPL changes after RP, there was evidence of SFPL loss at 2 months, but not at 6 months after RP. PDE5i use moderated SFPL loss, with patients who regularly used PDE5i having no loss in SFPL.

titre: The transcriptional programme of the androgen receptor (AR) in prostate cancer.
resume_court: The androgen receptor (AR) is essential for normal prostate and prostate cancer cell growth. Persistent AR activity in advanced disease regulates cell cycle activity, steroid biosynthesis and anabolic metabolism in conjunction with regulatory co-factors, such as the E2F family, c-Myc and signal transducer and activator of transcription (STAT) transcription factors.

titre: Differing leukocyte gene expression profiles associated with fatigue in patients with prostate cancer versus chronic fatigue syndrome.
resume_court: Androgen deprivation therapy (ADT) often worsens fatigue in patients with prostate cancer, producing symptoms similar to chronic fatigue syndrome (CFS). CFS patients showed higher P2RX7 and lower HSPA2 versus controls and PCF. Correlations with fatigue severity were similar in PCF and CFS for only DBI, the GABA-A receptor modulator (r=-0.50, p<0.005 and r=-0.34, p<0.05).

titre: A population-based competing-risks analysis of survival after nephrectomy for renal cell carcinoma.
resume_court: Variability in survival after surgical treatment is observed in patients with renal cell carcinoma (RCC), thereby affirming the heterogeneity of the disease. In subanalyses focusing on stage I RCC, CSM (3%-10%) rates were slightly higher for RN-treated patients, regardless of age and grade. However, OCM rates were nonnegligible in elderly individuals (= 70 y) with low-grade and stage I to III RCC.

titre: Cav1.3 channel a1D protein is overexpressed and modulates androgen receptor transactivation in prostate cancers.
resume_court: Widespread use of L-type calcium channel blockers for treating hypertension has led to multiple epidemiologic studies to assess the risk of prostate cancer incidence. Blocking L-type channel's function or knocking down CACNA1D gene expression significantly suppressed androgen-stimulated Ca(2+) influx, AR transactivation, and cell growth in prostate cancer cells.

titre: Validation of copy number variants associated with prostate cancer risk and prognosis.
resume_court: Two recent studies have reported novel heritable copy number variants on chromosomes 2p, 15q, and 12q to be associated with prostate cancer (PCa) risk in non-Hispanic Caucasians. Our findings are consistent with the reported observation that a heritable deletion on 2p24.3 is associated with PCa risk in non-Hispanic Caucasians.

titre: Next-generation sequencing of advanced prostate cancer treated with androgen-deprivation therapy.
resume_court: Androgen-deprivation therapy (ADT) is standard treatment for locally advanced or metastatic prostate cancer (PCa). Proof-of-principle inhibition of the Wnt/ß-catenin signalling pathway specifically delays androgen-independent PCa cell cycle progression and proliferation and warrants further investigation as a potential target for therapy for CRPC.

titre: Probiotics for rectal volume variation during radiation therapy for prostate cancer.
resume_court: To investigate the effect of the probiotic Lactobacillus acidophilus on the percentage volume change of the rectum (PVCR), a crucial factor of prostate movement. L acidophilus showed a significant reduction effect on the PVCR (P<.001). L acidophilus was useful in reducing the PVCR, which is the most important determining factor of prostate position, during radiation therapy for prostate cancer.

titre: Androgens and prostate cancer; pathogenesis and deprivation therapy.
resume_court: This review will present an update on the role of ADT in the treatment of prostate cancer, will summarize recent evidence regarding ADT-associated adverse effects with particular emphasis on cardiometabolic and musculoskeletal health, and will provide recommendations for further research.

titre: Characterization and analysis of the composition and dynamics of the mammalian riboproteome.
resume_court: Increasing evidence points to an important role for the ribosome in the regulation of biological processes and as a target for deregulation in disease. We further validated association with polyribosomes for several riboproteome components and demonstrate that enrichment at the riboproteome can depend on cell type, genetics, or cellular stimulus.

titre: Predicting risk of prostate cancer in men receiving finasteride: effect of prostate volume, number of biopsy cores, and American Urological Association symptom score.
resume_court: To examine the effect of prostate volume, number of biopsy cores, and American Urological Association symptom score (AUASS) for prostate cancer risk assessment among men receiving finasteride in the Prostate Cancer Prevention Trial. Obtaining fewer biopsy cores in men receiving finasteride preserves biopsy sensitivity and will likely reduce cost and morbidity.

titre: Does increasing the nodal yield improve outcomes in contemporary patients without nodal metastasis undergoing radical prostatectomy?
resume_court: To determine if the number of lymph nodes (LNs) removed is an independent predictor of biochemical recurrence (BCR) in patients without LN metastases undergoing radical prostatectomy (RP). A total of 3,698 (57%), 2,064 (32%), and 508 (8%) patients had = 6, = 10, and = 20 LNs removed, respectively.

titre: Induction of steroid sulfatase expression in PC-3 human prostate cancer cells by insulin-like growth factor II.
resume_court: Human steroid sulfatase (STS) plays an important role in regulating the formation of biologically active estrogens and may be a promising target for treating estrogen-mediated carcinogenesis. To determine whether insulin-like growth factor (IGF)-II can induce STS gene expression, the effects of IGF-II on STS expression were studied in PC-3 human prostate cancer cells.

titre: The costs of identifying undiagnosed prostate cancer in asymptomatic men in New Zealand general practice.
resume_court: Screening for prostate cancer (PCa) using the prostate-specific antigen (PSA) test is widespread in New Zealand. Most of the costs of screening were incurred in general practice. The current costs could be reduced by better targeting of screening.

titre: Deubiquitinating enzyme Usp12 is a novel co-activator of the androgen receptor.
resume_court: The androgen receptor (AR), a member of the nuclear receptor family, is a transcription factor involved in prostate cell growth, homeostasis, and transformation. Hence, deubiquitinating enzymes could offer novel therapeutic targets. In this report we demonstrate that Usp12, in complex with Uaf-1 and WDR20, deubiquitinates the AR to enhance receptor stability and transcriptional activity.

titre: MR molecular imaging of prostate cancer with a small molecular CLT1 peptide targeted contrast agent.
resume_court: Tumor extracellular matrix has abundance of cancer related proteins that can be used as biomarkers for cancer molecular imaging. The targeted contrast agent was effective to produce significant tumor contrast enhancement at a low dose of 0.03 mmol Gd/kg. The peptide targeted MRI contrast agent is promising for MR molecular imaging of prostate tumor.

titre: Long-term risks after splenectomy among 8,149 cancer-free American veterans: a cohort study with up to 27 years follow-up.
resume_court: Although preservation of the spleen following abdominal trauma and spleen-preserving surgical procedures have become gold standards, about 22,000 splenectomies are still conducted annually in the USA. Many of the observed risks were increased more than 10 years after splenectomy. Our results underscore the importance of vaccination, surveillance, and thromboprophylaxis after splenectomy.

titre: Serologic autoantibodies as diagnostic cancer biomarkers--a review.
resume_court: Current diagnostic techniques used for the early detection of cancers are successful but subject to detection bias. Therefore, autoantibody levels in patient blood serum have been proposed as diagnostic biomarkers for early-stage diagnosis of cancers. A discussion of the potential future use of autoantibodies as diagnostic cancer biomarkers is also included in this review.

titre: May non-metastatic clinically localized castration-resistant prostate cancer after primary androgen ablation benefit from salvage prostate radiotherapy?
resume_court: A proportion of patients with localized prostate cancer is still treated with primary androgen deprivation therapy (PADT) alone. Median follow-up after EBRT was 53 months. Twenty-one patients had BF after EBRT (median time 27.4 months): 13 presented with loco-regional and/or distant metastases, while in 8 patients, a PSA rise only was observed.

titre: A pilot study of blood epinephrine levels and CREB phosphorylation in men undergoing prostate biopsies.
resume_court: In mouse models of prostate cancer, increased epinephrine levels accelerated tumor growth via the beta2-adrenoreceptor/PKA signaling pathway. We measured epinephrine levels in blood samples collected immediately prior to prostate biopsies and measured phosphorylation of S133CREB (PKA site), S112BAD, T202/Y204ERK, and S473 Akt in prostate biopsy tissue samples.

titre: Cancer Treatment in Malawi: A Disease of Palliation.
resume_court: Worldwide, new cancer cases will nearly double in the next 20 years while disproportionately affecting low and middle income countries (LMICs). Although more than 50% of breast cancer operations were performed with curative intent, most procedures were palliative including prostate cancer (98%), colorectal cancer (69%), gastric cancer (71%), and pancreatic cancer (94%).

titre: Diabetes protects from prostate cancer by downregulating androgen receptor: new insights from LNCaP cells and PAC120 mouse model.
resume_court: Type 2 diabetes has been associated with decreased risk of prostate cancer in observational studies, and this inverse association has been recently confirmed in several large cohort studies. In conclusion, our results suggest that hyperglycemia and TNF-a play an important role in protecting against prostate cancer by reducing androgen receptor levels via NF-?B.

titre: Utilization of replication-competent XMRV reporter-viruses reveals severe viral restriction in primary human cells.
resume_court: The gammaretrovirus termed xenotropic murine leukemia virus-related virus (XMRV) was described to be isolated from prostate cancer tissue biopsies and from blood of patients suffering from chronic fatigue syndrome. However, many studies failed to detect XMRV and to verify these disease associations. Our results provide further evidence that XMRV is not a human pathogen.

titre: ABT-737, a small molecule Bcl-2/Bcl-xL antagonist, increases antimitotic-mediated apoptosis in human prostate cancer cells.
resume_court: Castration-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC) expresses high levels of the anti-apoptotic proteins Bcl-2, Bcl-xL and Mcl-1, resulting in resistance to apoptosis and association with poor prognosis. Overall, our data suggests that the high levels of anti-apoptotic proteins in Bax-expressing CRPC cells can be overcome by targeting Bcl-2/Bcl-xL with ABT-737 and Mcl-1 with antimitotics.

titre: Photoluminescence and X-ray excited luminescence from glutathione-stabilized gold nanoparticles.
resume_court: Au nanoparticles coated with glutathione (GSH) were prepared by the heat-assisted reduction of Au(I)-thiol complex at 1:1 or 5:4 molar ratio of Au to GSH. The luminescence lifetimes of the red emissions were on the nanosecond time scale while the 800 nm emission was on the microsecond time scale.

titre: Utility of diffusional kurtosis imaging as a marker of adverse pathologic outcomes among prostate cancer active surveillance candidates undergoing radical prostatectomy.
resume_court: ADC was not significantly different in the presence of adverse final pathologic findings for either scheme (p = 0.357, p = 0.383). Preliminary results suggest that diffusional kurtosis imaging findings may have more value than findings at conventional diffusion-weighted MRI as a marker of adverse final pathologic outcome among active surveillance candidates.

titre: Comparison of interreader reproducibility of the prostate imaging reporting and data system and likert scales for evaluation of multiparametric prostate MRI.
resume_court: Interreader reproducibility tended to be higher for relatively experienced readers than for less experienced readers and to be higher in the PZ than in the TZ. For the relatively experienced readers, reproducibility was similar for PI-RADS and Likert scales in the PZ but was somewhat higher for the Likert scale than for PI-RADS in the TZ.

titre: Real-time prostate motion assessment: image-guidance and the temporal dependence of intra-fraction motion.
resume_court: The rapid adoption of image-guidance in prostate intensity-modulated radiotherapy (IMRT) results in longer treatment times, which may result in larger intrafraction motion, thereby negating the advantage of image-guidance. This study aims to qualify and quantify the contribution of image-guidance to the temporal dependence of intrafraction motion during prostate IMRT.

titre: Metastatic prostate cancer cell-specific phage-like particles as a targeted gene-delivery system.
resume_court: One of the cardinal requirements for effective therapeutic management of tumors is the selective delivery of cancer drugs to the right site by ligand-decorated nanomedicines. A prostate cancer selective phage was converted to phage-like particles harboring emerald green fluorescent protein.

titre: Stereotactic body radiotherapy for localized prostate cancer: pooled analysis from a multi-institutional consortium of prospective phase II trials.
resume_court: The effectiveness of stereotactic body radiotherapy (SBRT) for localized prostate cancer is tested. The 5-year biochemical relapse free survival (bRFS) rate was 93% for all patients; 95%, 83% and 78% for GS ?6, 7 and ?8, respectively (p=0.001), and 95%, 84% and 81% for low-, intermediate- and high-risk patients, respectively (p<0.001). A PSA bounce of >0.2ng/ml was noted among 16% of patients.

titre: Is there a relation between the radiation dose to the different sub-segments of the lower urinary tract and urinary morbidity after brachytherapy of the prostate with I-125 seeds?
resume_court: To investigate possible relationships between the dose to the sub-segments of the lower urinary tract and lower urinary tract symptoms (LUTS) after brachytherapy of the prostate. Pre-treatment IPSS, prostate volume and dose to the bladder neck are correlated with post-implant IPSS. A combination of a large prostate and a high dose to the bladder neck is highly predictive for enhanced early LUTS.

titre: The modulation of attachment, growth and morphology of cancerous prostate cells by polyelectrolyte nanofilms.
resume_court: The behaviour of cancerous epithelial prostatic cells (PC3) growing on polyelectrolytes (PE) coatings was compared to the behaviour of immortalized normal prostatic cells (PNT-2). However, the proliferation rate of PC3 cells was reduced on the PAH-terminated surface and slightly increased on the PSS coatings.

titre: Synthesis and biological evaluation of novel alkyl amide functionalized trifluoromethyl substituted pyrazolo[3,4-b]pyridine derivatives as potential anticancer agents.
resume_court: All the synthesized compounds 5, 6 and 7 were screened for anticancer activity against four cancer cell lines such as A549-Lung cancer (CCL-185), MCF7-Breast cancer (HTB-22), DU145-Prostate cancer (HTB-81) and HeLa-Cervical cancer (CCL-2). The compounds 5i and 6e are found to have promising bioactivity at micro molar concentration.

titre: Prostate specific antigen velocity risk count predicts biopsy reclassification for men with very low risk prostate cancer.
resume_court: Prostate specific antigen velocity is an unreliable predictor of adverse pathology findings in patients on active surveillance for low risk prostate cancer. Treatment was recommended for biopsy reclassification. Prostate specific antigen velocity risk count may be useful for monitoring patients on active surveillance and decreasing the frequency of biopsies needed in the long term.

titre: Development of an intra-molecularly shuffled efficient chimeric plant promoter from plant infecting Mirabilis mosaic virus promoter sequence.
resume_court: We compared the transient activity of the MUASMSCP promoter in tobacco/Arabidopsis protoplasts and in whole plant (Petunia hybrida) with the same that obtained from CaMV35S and MUAS35SCP promoters individually. The MUASMSCP promoter showed 1.1 and 1.5 times stronger GUS-activities over that obtained from MUAS35SCP and CaMV35S promoters respectively, in tobacco (Xanthi Brad) protoplasts.

titre: Prostate cancer disease characteristics for foreign-born South Asian men living in the United States.
resume_court: We report the largest known cohort of South Asian (SA) men treated by radical prostatectomy living in the United States. A total of 69 SA men were identified in Cohort 1 and 24 men were identified in Cohort 2. SA men living in the United States have pathologic disease profiles that are comparable to AA men.

titre: Diagnostic dilemma in histopathology report following robot assisted laparoscopic prostatectomy: tumour 'hide and seek'.
resume_court: Widespread PSA (prostate specific antigen) screening has resulted in stage migration of prostate cancer. Nine patients were identified out of a total of 184 cases of RALP in which the final histopathology did not correlate with the initial biopsy report. The initial biopsy slides as well as the final histopathology slides were reviewed by a second pathologist.

titre: Serum amyloid A, phospholipase A2-IIA and C-reactive protein as inflammatory biomarkers for prostate diseases.
resume_court: We found that in comparison to healthy individuals (n = 55), patients with BPH, PCa and mPCa have elevated serum levels of SAA, sPLA2-IIA, and CRP, in addition to elevated levels of PSA. The results of the present study emphasize the utility of SAA, sPLA2-IIA, and CRP as circulating biomarkers of inflammation during BPH development and PCa progression.

titre: Transperineal biopsy of the prostate--is this the future?
resume_court: Transperineal prostate biopsy is re-emerging after decades of being an underused alternative to transrectal biopsy guided by transrectal ultrasonography (TRUS). However, the expansion of transperineal biopsy has been propagated by the increase in multiparametric MRI-guided biopsies, which often use the transperineal approach.

titre: Statin use and incident prostate cancer risk: does the statin brand matter? A population-based cohort study.
resume_court: Statins have known anticarcinogenic effects; evidence for long-term statin use as effective chemoprevention for prostate cancer is inconsistent. A total of 1813 cases of prostate cancer were diagnosed. Therapeutic success will depend on developing the best antigen delivery systems and on the elucidation of the entire network of immune signalingsignaling pathways that regulate immune responses in the tumor microenvironment.

titre: Malfunctions of implantable cardiac devices in patients receiving proton beam therapy: incidence and predictors.
resume_court: Photon therapy has been reported to induce resets of implanted cardiac devices, but the clinical sequelae of treating patients with such devices with proton beam therapy (PBT) are not well known. We recommend that PBT be avoided in pacing-dependent patients and that patients with any type of CIED receiving thoracic PBT be followed closely.

titre: Estimation of rectal dose using daily megavoltage cone-beam computed tomography and deformable image registration.
resume_court: The actual dose delivered to critical organs will differ from the simulated dose because of interfractional organ motion and deformation. The DSC of all treatment fractions of 8 patients was improved from 0.75±0.04 (mean ±SD) to 0.90 ±0.02 by DIR. We developed a method for evaluation of rectal dose using DIR and MVCBCT images and showed the necessity of DIR for the evaluation of total dose.

titre: Two sequential diagnoses of atypical foci suspicious for carcinoma on prostate biopsy: a follow-up study of 179 cases.
resume_court: To follow-up the outcomes with patients who have had 2 consecutive "atypical foci suspicious for carcinoma (ATYP)" diagnoses from prostate biopsies. Of the 516 men, 179 underwent additional repeat biopsy (34.8%) after 2 ATYP diagnoses. The results of our study have shown that 36.3% men will be diagnosed with cancer on biopsy after 2 ATYP diagnoses, with 23% having a Gleason score of =7.

titre: Learning curve in the application of a hydrogel spacer to protect the rectal wall during radiotherapy of localized prostate cancer.
resume_court: To evaluate the effect of increasing experience on hydrogel dimensions, rectal dose, and acute toxicity, and to discuss important technical issues gained from this experience. Increasing symmetry was detected comparing the first 15 patients to the subsequent rest, with mean differences between right and left of 0.6 cm vs 0.3 cm at the midgland (P = .03).

titre: Abiraterone acetate plus prednisone versus prednisone alone in chemotherapy-naive men with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer: patient-reported outcome results of a randomised phase 3 trial.
resume_court: Abiraterone acetate plus prednisone significantly improves radiographic progression-free survival in asymptomatic or mildly symptomatic, chemotherapy-naive patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer compared with prednisone alone. 1088 patients underwent randomisation: 546 were assigned to abiraterone plus prednisone and 542 to placebo plus prednisone.

titre: Cancer-induced bone pain: Mechanisms and models.
resume_court: Cancerous cells can originate in a number of different tissues such as prostate, breast and lung, but often go undetected and are non-painful. Part of this failure is due to the poor understanding of the etiology of cancer pain. Animal models of cancer-induced bone pain (CIBP) have revealed that the neurochemistry of cancer has features distinctive from other chronic pain states.

titre: Epithelial cell adhesion molecule (EpCAM) is associated with prostate cancer metastasis and chemo/radioresistance via the PI3K/Akt/mTOR signaling pathway.
resume_court: Prostate cancer (CaP) is the second leading malignancy in men. Our findings suggest that EpCAM plays an important role in CaP proliferation, invasion, metastasis and chemo-/radioresistance associated with the activation of the PI3K/Akt/mTOR signaling pathway and is a novel therapeutic target to sensitize CaP cells to chemo-/radiotherapy.

titre: Measuring and predicting prostate cancer related quality of life changes using EPIC for clinical practice.
resume_court: We expanded the clinical usefulness of EPIC-CP (Expanded Prostate Cancer Index Composite for Clinical Practice) by evaluating its responsiveness to health related quality of life changes, defining the minimally important differences for an individual patient change in each domain and applying it to a sexual outcome prediction model.

titre: The long noncoding RNA SChLAP1 promotes aggressive prostate cancer and antagonizes the SWI/SNF complex.
resume_court: Prostate cancers remain indolent in the majority of individuals but behave aggressively in a minority. SChLAP1 levels independently predict poor outcomes, including metastasis and prostate cancer-specific mortality. These results suggest that SChLAP1 contributes to the development of lethal cancer at least in part by antagonizing the tumor-suppressive functions of the SWI/SNF complex.

titre: An evaluation of a community-academic-clinical partnership to reduce prostate cancer disparities in the South.
resume_court: Engaging partners in the planning, implementation, and evaluation of cancer education programs is critical for improving the health of our communities. Evaluating partners' perceptions of this collaboration provided important recommendations for future planning, implementation, and evaluation of community-based cancer education programs.

titre: Exploring prostate cancer literacy and family cancer awareness in college students: getting ahead of the curve in cancer education.
resume_court: Cancer literacy and family cancer experiences have not been widely researched from the perspective of young adults. This study examined health literacy related to prostate cancer and family cancer awareness among a sample of 146 male and female college students.

titre: Cysteine (C)-X-C Receptor 4 Regulates NADPH Oxidase-2 During Oxidative Stress in Prostate Cancer Cells.
resume_court: Reactive oxygen species (ROS) are implicated in many human diseases, including cancer. Herein, we sought to determine whether the CXCR4/SDF-1a signaling axis mediates ROS production through NOX in prostate cancer. Taken together, these results suggest that CXCR4/SDF-1a-mediated ROS production through NOX2 enzymes may be an emerging concept by which chemokine signaling progresses tumorigenesis.

titre: Bilateral cancer in prostate biopsy associates with the presence of extracapsular disease and positive surgical margins in low risk patients: a consideration for bilateral nerve sparing radical prostatectomy decision.
resume_court: A total of 117 patients were included in the study. Bilateral prostate cancer in prostate biopsy is significantly associated with positive surgical margins and advanced disease in patients that are operated for prostate cancer of low risk.This observation may assist the selection of patients in whom a bilateral nerve sparing radical prostatectomy is planned to be performed.

titre: New endocrine treatments prolong survival of patients with castration-resistant prostate cancer
resume_court: Prostate cancer that progresses despite castrate levels of serum testosterone is defined as castration-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC). Recently, new endocrine treatments including an androgen receptor signalling inhibitor and a testosterone synthesis inhibitor have been approved for treatment of CRPC.

titre: Withaferin A, a steroidal lactone from Withania somnifera, induces mitotic catastrophe and growth arrest in prostate cancer cells.

In addition, decreased levels of phosphorylated Chk1 (Ser345) and Chk2 (Thr68) were evident in prostate cancer cells on treatment with 1. In conclusion, these results show clearly the potential of 1 as a regulator of the G2/M phase of the cell cycle and as a therapeutic agent for prostate cancer.

titre: Antiproliferative, antiandrogenic and cytotoxic effects of novel caffeic acid derivatives in LNCaP human androgen-dependent prostate cancer cells.
resume_court: However, little is known about their effects on prostate cancer cells. We synthesized and evaluated the effects of caffeic acid, CAPE (2) and 18 synthetic derivatives on cell viability and androgen-dependent cell proliferation, subcellular localisation and expression of androgen receptor (AR) and secretion of prostate-specific antigen (PSA) in LNCaP human hormone-dependent prostate cancer cells.

titre: Prostate cancer gene 3 and multiparametric magnetic resonance can reduce unnecessary biopsies: decision curve analysis to evaluate predictive models.
resume_court: To overcome the well-known prostate-specific antigen limits, several new biomarkers have been proposed. All patients underwent the PCA3 test and mMRI before a second transrectal ultrasound-guided prostate biopsy. mMRI increased the accuracy and sensitivity of the PCA3 test, and the use of the full model significantly improved the cost/benefit ratio, avoiding unnecessary biopsies.

titre: Validation study of ultrasound-based high-dose-rate prostate brachytherapy planning compared with CT-based planning.
resume_court: The use of transrectal ultrasound (TRUS) to both guide and plan high-dose-rate (HDR) brachytherapy (BT) for prostate is increasing. The coordinates of each needle tip were recorded from the Treatment Planning System for CT and US and compared. A total of 574 needle tip positions have been compared between TRUS and CBCT.

titre: Chemopreventive effect of quercetin, a natural dietary flavonoid on prostate cancer in in vivo model.

Antioxidant enzymes and apoptotic proteins were significantly decreased in cancer-induced animal and upon quercetin supplement its level was increased. The IGFIR, AKT, AR, cell proliferative and anti-apoptotic proteins were increased in cancer-induced group whereas supplement of quercetin decreased its expression.

titre: Pro-survival and pro-growth effects of stress-induced nitric oxide in a prostate cancer photodynamic therapy model.

Thus, photostress upregulation of NOS/NO elicited both a pro-survival and pro-growth response, both of which could compromise clinical PDT efficacy unless suppressed, e.g. by pharmacological intervention with a NOS2 inhibitor.

titre: IGF2 and cancer.
resume_court: Insulin-like growth factor 2 (IGF2) is a 7.5 ?kDa mitogenic peptide hormone expressed by liver and many other tissues. Recent advances in understanding of the pathophysiology of IGF2 in cancer have suggested much novel clinical utility for its measurement. Measurement of IGF2 in blood and genetic and epigenetic tests of the IGF2 gene may help assess cancer risk and prognosis.

titre: RTOG 0518: randomized phase III trial to evaluate zoledronic acid for prevention of osteoporosis and associated fractures in prostate cancer patients.

Median follow-up was 36.3 months for Arm 1 and 34.8 months for Arm 2.

titre: Exploratory analysis of the visceral disease subgroup in a phase III study of abiraterone acetate in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer.
resume_court: Visceral disease, non-nodal soft-tissue metastases predominantly involving the lung and liver, is a negative prognostic factor in patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC). Treatment effects in visceral disease (n=352) and non-visceral disease (n=843) subsets were examined using final data (775 OS events).

titre: Increased expression of CYP24A1 correlates with advanced stages of prostate cancer and can cause resistance to vitamin D3-based therapies.
resume_court: A major limitation of exogenous vitamin D3 administration for the treatment of prostate cancer is the marginal, if any, clinical efficacy. The use of CYP24A1 RNAi enhanced the cytostatic effects of vitamin D3 in human prostate cancer cells. CYP24A1 may be a predictive marker of vitamin D3 clinical efficacy in patients with advanced prostate cancer.

titre: Randomized trial to assess the impact of venlafaxine and soy protein on hot flashes and quality of life in men with prostate cancer.
resume_court: Hot flashes occur in approximately 80% of androgen-deprived men. In androgen-deprived men, neither venlafaxine nor soy proved effective in reducing hot flashes. Interventions that appear effective for decreasing hot flashes in women may not always turn out to be effective in men.

titre: Prostate cancer progression correlates with increased humoral immune response to a human endogenous retrovirus GAG protein.
resume_court: Human endogenous retroviruses (HERV) encode 8% of the human genome. Patient sera were analyzed for seroreactivity to GAG-HERV-K and other self-antigens by ELISA and seromics (protein array profiling). Presence of GAG-HERV-K serum antibody was correlated with worse survival of patients with prostate cancer, with a trend for faster biochemical recurrence in patients with antibodies to GAG-HERV-K.

titre: DNA fragmentation and apoptosis induced by safranal in human prostate cancer cell line.

The present study was designed to elucidate cytotoxic and apoptosis induction by safranal, the major coloring compound in saffron, in a human prostate cancer cell line (PC-3). 0.07 and 6.4 ?

titre: Evaluation of oxidative stress and DNA damage in benign prostatic hyperplasia patients and comparison with controls.
resume_court: In the present study, oxidative stress and lymphocytic DNA damage in both pre-op and post-op benign prostrate hyperplasia (BPH) patients with age >50 years was evaluated and compared with normal healthy subjects (controls- without any evidence of disease) of the same sex and age group. These values were compared with their respective control subjects of similar sex and age group.

titre: Modulatory effects of Crataeva nurvala bark against testosterone and N-methyl-N-nitrosourea-induced oxidative damage in prostate of male albino rats.
resume_court: Antioxidant properties of Crataeva nurvala bark contains a variety of the bioactive phytochemical constituents in medicinal plants which include flavonoids, phenolic compounds, tannins, anthracene derivatives, and essential oils. Hence, the study reveals that constituents present in Crataeva nurvala bark impart protection against androgen-induced oxidative injury in prostate.

titre: A chemogenomics based approach for deorphanization of testicular receptor 4: An orphan receptor of nuclear receptor superfamily.
resume_court: Orphan Receptor of Nuclear Receptor superfamily is the one with no known endogenous ligands. The Testicular Receptor 4 being negative modulator to other members of the nuclear receptor superfamily, is one of the Orphan members of this family and is associated with prostate cancer, breast cancer, sickle cell anemia and joint diseases.

titre: The use of vacuum erection devices in erectile dysfunction after radical prostatectomy.
resume_court: The risk of postoperative erectile dysfunction (ED) following radical prostatectomy (RP) is reported to be between 14% and 89%. Penile rehabilitation programs are increasingly used to facilitate the return of natural postoperative erections; the VED is an ideal therapy given that it increases blood flow and oxygenation to the corpora to reverse the changes that result in ED after RP.

titre: Controversies on individualized prostate cancer care: gaps in current practice.
resume_court: Prostate cancer (PCa) is a heterogeneous disease with a wide spectrum of aggressiveness. As such, the use of individualized, risk-adapted approaches to the management of PCa is indispensable. However, wide variation in treatment approaches observed for patients in practice suggests that there is an unmet need to improve the individualized approach towards patient care.

titre: Prostate cancer: current treatment and prevention strategies.
resume_court: Prostate cancer is one of the life threatening disorders of male. However, many adverse or side effects exist with these strategies. This review article summarizes some of the current treatment, and prevention strategies with the protection of prostate cancer, which may be helpful to control and prevent this highly frequent life threatening disease.

titre: Effects of scanning (routine health information exposure) on cancer screening and prevention behaviors in the general population.
resume_court: Research on health information exposure focuses primarily on deliberate information-seeking behavior and its effects on health. Also, among those reporting timely screening mammogram behavior at baseline, scanning predicted repeat mammography. These analyses provide substantial support for a claim that routine exposure to health content from nonmedical sources affects specific health behaviors.

titre: Chromosomal radiosensitivity analyzed by FISH in lymphocytes of prostate cancer patients and healthy donors.
resume_court: It is known that about 5-10% of cancer patients show severe clinical side effects during and after radiotherapy due to enhanced sensitivity to ionizing radiation. We compared the radiosensitivity of the chromosomes 2, 11 and 17 in prostate cancer patients with and without severe side effects after radiotherapy and in age-matched healthy donors. Each cohort consisted of at least 10 donors.

titre: Cigarette smoking and prostate cancer risk: negative results of the Seoul Male Cancer Cohort Study.
resume_court: We evaluated cigarette smoking as a risk factor for prostate cancer in a prospective, population-based cohort study. They were followed up between 1993 and 2008. The age-adjusted relative risks of past and current smokers at entry were 0.60 (95%CI: 0.34-1.06) and 0.70 (95%CI: 0.43-1.13), respectively, suggesting that cigarette smoking may not be a risk factor for prostate cancer.

titre: Intensity-modulated radiotherapy combined with endocrine therapy for intermediate and advanced prostate cancer: long-term outcome of Chinese patients.
resume_court: The aim of this study was to evaluate acute adverse events and efficacy of three-dimensional intensity- modulated radiotherapy (IMRT) combined with endocrine therapy for intermediate and advanced prostate cancer. IMRT combined with endocrine therapy demonstrated promising efficacy and was well tolerated in patients with intermediate and advanced prostate cancer.

titre: Subtypes of white blood cells in patients with prostate cancer or benign prostatic hyperplasia and healthy individuals.
resume_court: This study aimed to evaluate the baseline white blood cell (WBC), neutrophil, lymphocyte, monocyte, basophil, eosinophil count, total prostate-specific antigen (TPSA), free PSA (FPSA) level, neutrophil- to-lymphocyte and neutrophil-to-monocyte ratios among patients with prostate cancer and benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH), as well as healthy individuals.

titre: Meta-analysis of transperitoneal versus extraperitoneal robot-assisted radical prostatectomy for prostate cancer.
resume_court: To conduct a meta-analysis of studies that compared transperitoneal (TP) and extraperitoneal (EP) robot-assisted radical prostatectomy (RARP). There was no significant difference in margin positivity between EP and TP (odds ratio=1.023; 95% CI 0.656-1.573; P=.918). However, the oncologic outcome of margin positivity did not demonstrate a significant difference between the EP and TP approaches.

titre: Loss of PTEN is associated with aggressive behavior in ERG-positive prostate cancer.
resume_court: The associations of ERG overexpression with clinical behavior and molecular pathways of prostate cancer are incompletely known. Loss of PTEN expression was associated (P = 0.0085) with shorter progression-free survival in ERG-positive, but not in negative cases. Interaction of PTEN and ERG pathways warrants further studies.

titre: Anti-androgenic activity of hydroxyxanthones in prostate cancer LNCaP cells.
resume_court: Anti-androgens are used to treat prostate cancer. Here, we report that hydroxyxanthones from a plant extract act as anti-androgens in androgen receptor (AR)-positive prostate cancer LNCaP cells. Anti-androgenic activity of the ethanol extract from Garcinia subelliptica was observed in a luciferase assay using LNCaP/MMTV cells with a stably integrated mouse mammary tumor virus (MMTV) promoter.

titre: Lanthanide chelate complementation and hydrolysis enhanced luminescent chelate in real-time reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction assays for KLK3 transcripts.
