Our results provide indirect evidence that proximity to a cancer diagnosis may provide a teachable moment to improve dietary and smoking behaviors and that symptom burden may impede physical activity following diagnosis.

titre: Clinical evaluation of a computer-aided diagnosis system for determining cancer aggressiveness in prostate MRI.
resume_court: To investigate the added value of computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) on the diagnostic accuracy of PIRADS reporting and the assessment of cancer aggressiveness. Logistic regression combined the CAD prediction and radiologist PIRADS score into a combination score. Combining CAD prediction and PIRADS into a combination score has the potential to improve diagnostic accuracy.

titre: ERG protein expression over time: from diagnostic biopsies to radical prostatectomy specimens in clinically localised prostate cancer.
resume_court: We evaluated the consistency in ERG protein expression from diagnostic specimens through rebiopsies to radical prostatectomies in patients with clinically localised prostate cancer to investigate the validity of ERG status in biopsies. The concordance between FISH and IHC was 97.3% and IHC demonstrated a sensitivity and specificity for ERG rearrangement of 100% and 95.5%, respectively.

titre: Prostate Biopsy Using Transrectal Ultrasonography; The Optimal Number of Cores Regarding Cancer Detection Rate and Complications.
resume_court: Transrectal ultrasound guided biopsy of the prostate is the most common modality used to diagnose prostate cancer. Prostate cancer was diagnosed in 8 (13.3%), 21 (35%) and 24 (40%) patients in six, twelve and eighteen core biopsy groups, respectively. Twelve-core biopsy enhances the rate of prostate cancer detection with minimum adverse effects.

titre: Fast GPU-based Monte Carlo simulations for LDR prostate brachytherapy.
resume_court: The aim of this study was to evaluate the potential of bGPUMCD, a Monte Carlo algorithm executed on Graphics Processing Units (GPUs), for fast dose calculations in permanent prostate implant dosimetry. After appropriate calibration of the source, permanent prostate implant dose distributions were calculated for four patients and compared to an already validated Geant4 algorithm.

titre: GGEMS-Brachy: GPU GEant4-based Monte Carlo simulation for brachytherapy applications.
resume_court: In brachytherapy, plans are routinely calculated using the AAPM TG43 formalism which considers the patient as a simple water object. The performance of the proposed GGEMS-brachy platform allows envisaging the use of Monte Carlo simulation based dosimetry studies in brachytherapy compatible with clinical practice.

titre: Prostate Cancer: The Role of Multiparametric Magnetic Resonance Imaging.
resume_court: Multiparametric magnetic resonance imaging has been increasingly used for detection, localization and staging of prostate cancer over the last years. This article reviews the basic principles of prostatic mp-magnetic resonance imaging, emphasizing its role on detection, staging and active surveillance of prostate cancer.

titre: Aberrant Activation of the RANK Signaling Receptor Induces Murine Salivary Gland Tumors.
resume_court: Unlike cancers of related exocrine tissues such as the mammary and prostate gland, diagnosis and treatment of aggressive salivary gland malignancies have not markedly advanced in decades. Without knowledge of the critical signals that drive salivary gland tumorigenesis, tumor vulnerabilities cannot be exploited that allow for targeted molecular therapies.

titre: miR-141-3p regulates the expression of androgen receptor by targeting its 3'UTR in prostate cancer LNCaP cells
resume_court: To detect the target degradation of miR-141-3p on androgen receptor (AR) gene in LNCaP cells and demonstrate whether AR gene is a target of miR-141-3p. Double luciferase reporter system was employed to verify the potential target effect of miR-141-3p on pmiR-AR-3'UTR. Compared with control group, miR-141-3p transfection significantly inhibited the activity of luciferase of pmiR-AR-3'UTR.

titre: CyberKnife stereotactic radiotherapy for isolated recurrence in the prostatic bed.
resume_court: To report a clinical experience of stereotactic body radiation therapy (SBRT) for isolated recurrence in the prostatic bed from prostate cancer. At a median follow-up of 10 months (range 2-21 months), a significant biochemical response was found in all but one patient. Our experience shows that SBRT with CyberKnife for isolated nodal relapse is a safe and well-tolerated treatment.

titre: MicroRNA-26a/b directly regulate La-related protein 1 and inhibit cancer cell invasion in prostate cancer.
resume_court: Our past studies of microRNA (miRNA) expression signatures of cancers including prostate cancer (PCa) revealed that microRNA-26a and microRNA-26b (miR-26a and miR-26b) were significantly downregulated in cancer tissues. Our present data suggested that loss of tumor-suppressive miR-26a and miR-26b enhanced cancer cell invasion in PCa through direct regulation of oncogenic LARP1.

titre: The prolactin receptor as a therapeutic target in human diseases: browsing new potential indications.
resume_court: Prolactin (PRL) signaling has emerged as a relevant target in breast and prostate cancers. The authors briefly overview the two classes of PRLR blockers, which involve: i) PRL-core based analogs that have been validated as competitive antagonists in various preclinical models, and ii) anti-PRLR neutralizing antibodies that are currently in clinical Phase I for advanced breast and prostate cancers.

titre: Optimizing Patient Population for MP-MRI and Fusion Biopsy for Prostate Cancer Detection.
resume_court: The diagnosis and treatment of prostate cancer continue to evolve with advances in science and technology. With this new ability came the advancement of fusion biopsy platforms, which allow for direct targeting of these lesions. This review summarizes the current knowledge on how to best optimize which men undergo mp-MRI and fusion biopsies both in the screening and treatment settings.

titre: Long Noncoding RNAs in Digestive System Malignancies: A Novel Class of Cancer Biomarkers and Therapeutic Targets?
resume_court: High throughput methodologies have revealed the existence of an unexpectedly large number of long noncoding RNAs (lncRNAs). The unconventional role of lncRNAs in gene expression regulation and their broad implication in oncogenic and tumor suppressive pathways have introduced lncRNAs as novel biological tumor markers.

titre: NUDT11 rs5945572 polymorphism and prostate cancer risk: a meta-analysis.
resume_court: The association between the NUDT10 rs5945572 polymorphism and prostate cancer (PCa) was not clear. We thus conducted a meta-analysis to assess the association between NUDT10 rs5945572 polymorphism and PCa risk. In conclusion, this meta-analysis found a significant association between NUDT10 rs5945572 polymorphism and prostate cancer.

titre: Novel cyclotides from Hedyotis diffusa induce apoptosis and inhibit proliferation and migration of prostate cancer cells.
resume_court: Hedyotis diffusa is a well-known herb in traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) which is used to treat various cancers including prostate cancer. Currently, over 250 cyclotides have been discovered. The novel cyclotides extracted from H.Diffusa have anti-cancer effects, and they are potential bioactive ingredients in H.diffusa.

titre: Down-regulation of dual-specificity phosphatase 5 predicts poor prognosis of patients with prostate cancer.
resume_court: Dual-specificity phosphatase 5 (DUSP5), which specifically inactivates the extracellular signal-regulated kinase (ERK) 1/2 within the mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) signaling, has recently been considered to be a tumor suppressor. However, its role in prostate cancer is still elusive. The downregulation of DUSP5 may accurately predict poor prognosis in PCa patients.

titre: An inverse association of body mass index and prostate-specific antigen in northwest men of China: a population-based analysis.
resume_court: To examine the relationship between body mass index (BMI) and prostate-specific antigen (PSA) in Chinese men and to investigate whether this relationship was independent of other factors. Mean PSA level was calculated by categories (normal weight, overweight, and obesity) and age group (= 40, 41-59, = 60 years old). Mean PSA level increased with age at each BMI category.

titre: The Impact of Immune System in Regulating Bone Metastasis Formation by Osteotropic Tumors.
resume_court: Bone metastases are frequent and debilitating consequence for many tumors, such as breast, lung, prostate, and kidney cancer. This review summarizes the current knowledge on the interactions among bone, immune, and tumor cells aiming to provide an overview of the osteoimmunology field in bone metastasis from solid tumors.

titre: Prostatic and urothelial metastasis in the same lymph node: a case report.
resume_court: Collision metastasis is a rare phenomenon in which metastases of carcinoma from 2 separate primary tumors occur in the same lymph node. In a patient with simultaneous tumors it is important to remember that a part of lymph node metastases with histological polymorphic appearance may result from a collision metastasis.

titre: Sequencing of agents in castration-resistant prostate cancer.
resume_court: Until 2010, docetaxel was the only agent with proven survival benefit for castration-resistant prostate cancer. However, the absence of robust surrogates of survival and the lack of predictive biomarkers makes data for the sequential use of these agents difficult to obtain and interpret.

titre: A microRNA-activated molecular machine for non-enzymatic target recycling amplification detection of microRNA from cancer cells.
resume_court: The presence of the microRNA-141 target molecules activates the DNA molecular machine powered by the DNA fuel strands, leading to non-enzymatic target cyclic reuse of microRNA-141 and significantly amplified fluorescent signals for sensitive monitoring of microRNA-141 from low numbers of human prostate cancer cells.

titre: Identification and Partial Characterization of Two Populations of Prostasomes by a Combination of Dynamic Light Scattering and Proteomic Analysis.
resume_court: Prostasomes are vesicles secreted by prostate epithelial cells and are found in abundance in the semen. The different size and protein profile in the two subpopulations of prostasomes might support differential roles of the semen vesicles toward the target cells, and/or different secretion pathways from the organ of origin.

titre: Designing Normative Messages About Active Surveillance for Men With Localized Prostate Cancer.
resume_court: Active surveillance is increasingly recognized as a reasonable option for men with low-risk, localized prostate cancer, yet few men who might benefit from conservative management receive it. The authors examined the acceptability of normative messages about active surveillance as a management option for patients with low-risk prostate cancer.

titre: miR-137 Targets p160 Steroid Receptor Coactivators SRC1, SRC2, and SRC3 and Inhibits Cell Proliferation.
resume_court: Transfection of selected microRNA mimetics into breast cancer, uveal melanoma, and PC cells depleted SRC protein expression levels and exerted potent antiproliferative activity in these cell types. These results support the development and testing of microRNA-based therapies (in particular based on restoring miR-137 levels) for targeting the oncogenic family of p160 SRCs in cancer.

titre: Long-term Exposure to Testosterone Therapy and the Risk of High Grade Prostate Cancer.
resume_court: To our knowledge no population based studies have been done to examine whether long-term exposure to testosterone therapy is associated with an increased risk of high grade prostate cancer. In addition the risk of high grade disease did not increase according to the total number of testosterone injections (OR 1.00, 95% CI 0.98-1.01).

titre: 2,4-Dichlorophenoxyacetic acid and non-Hodgkin's lymphoma, gastric cancer, and prostate cancer: meta-analyses of the published literature.
resume_court: Despite evidence from experimental studies indicating that the herbicide, 2,4-dichlorophenoxyacetic acid (2,4-D), is not carcinogenic, several epidemiology studies have evaluated links between 2,4-D and cancer. We conducted subgroup and sensitivity analyses when possible. The epidemiology evidence does not support an association between 2,4-D and NHL, gastric cancer, or prostate cancer risk.

titre: Organized metabolic crime in prostate cancer: The coexpression of MCT1 in tumor and MCT4 in stroma is an independent prognosticator for biochemical failure.
resume_court: Lactate import or export over cell membranes is facilitated by monocarboxylate transporters (MCTs) 1 and 4. A total of 172 patients had a low expression of MCT1 in tumor and MCT4 in stroma. There were 232 patients who had a high expression of MCT1 and a low expression of MCT4 in stroma.

titre: Androgen pathway resistance in prostate cancer and therapeutic implications.
resume_court: Metastatic prostate cancer is an incurable disease that is treated with a variety of hormonal therapies targeting various nodes of the androgen receptor (AR) pathway. A literature search was performed to identify all published clinical trials related to androgen therapy mechanisms of drug resistance in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer.

titre: Evaluation of Multiparametric Magnetic Resonance Imaging in Detection and Prediction of Prostate Cancer.
resume_court: The median follow-up was 56.0 months (1-137 mo). In the cox model adjusted for age and baseline PSA level, for the detection rate of PCa, compared with PI-RADS 1-2 (reference), the hazard ratio was 6.43 (95% CI, 4.29-9.65) for PI-RADS 3, 18.58 (95% CI, 13.36-25.84) for PI-RADS 4-5 (p < 0.001). Prebiopsy MP-MRI with PI-RADS is demonstrated as a valuable diagnostic and predictive tool for PCa.

titre: RLIP76-dependent suppression of PI3K/AKT/Bcl-2 pathway by miR-101 induces apoptosis in prostate cancer.
resume_court: MicroRNA-101 (miR-101) participates in carcinogenesis and tumor progression in various cancers. Here, we demonstrate that miR-101 represents a critical role in regulating cell apoptosis in prostate cancer cells. Taken together, our results revealed that the effect of miR-101 on prostate cancer cell apoptosis was due to RLIP76 regulation of the PI3K/Akt/Bcl-2 signaling pathway.

titre: Polymorphisms in NFKB1 and NFKBIA Genes Modulate the Risk of Developing Prostate Cancer among Han Chinese.
resume_court: Nuclear factor kappa B (NF-?B) pathway proteins play an important role in modulating inflammation and other carcinogenic processes. Polymorphisms within NF-?B pathway genes may influence cancer risk. In conclusion, polymorphisms in NFKB1 and NFKBIA genes may modulate the risk of developing prostate cancer among Chinese.

titre: Inhibition of endogenous hydrogen sulfide production in clear-cell renal cell carcinoma cell lines and xenografts restricts their growth, survival and angiogenic potential.
resume_court: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC) is characterized by Von Hippel-Lindau (VHL)-deficiency, resulting in pseudohypoxic, angiogenic and glycolytic tumours. It was hypothesized that H2S levels are elevated in VHL-deficient ccRCC, contributing to survival, metabolism and angiogenesis.

titre: Accelerated migration and invasion of prostate cancer cells after a photodynamic therapy-like challenge: Role of nitric oxide.
resume_court: In the present study, we found that PC3 cells surviving an ALA/light insult not only proliferated faster than non-stressed controls, but migrated and invaded faster as well, these effects being abrogated by an iNOS inhibitor or NO scavenger. The MMP-9, TIMP-1, and integrin effects were strongly attenuated by iNOS inhibition, confirming NO's role in photostress-enhanced migration/invasion.

titre: The Childhood Solid Tumor Network: A new resource for the developmental biology and oncology research communities.
resume_court: Significant advances have been made over the past 25 years in our understanding of the most common adult solid tumors such as breast, colon, lung and prostate cancer. In a companion paper, we present the detailed characterization of an orthotopic xenograft of a pediatric solid tumor derived from sympathoadrenal lineage during development.

titre: An analysis of the association between prostate cancer risk loci, PSA levels, disease aggressiveness and disease-specific mortality.
resume_court: Genome-wide association studies have identified multiple single-nucleotide polymorphsims (SNPs) associated with prostate cancer (PCa). We investigated associations between 61 SNPs and disease-specific end points using multivariable analysis and also determined if SNPs were associated with PSA at diagnosis. We confirmed that rs17632542 in KLK3 is associated with PSA at diagnosis.

titre: Bloody otorrhea after robotically assisted laparoscopic prostatectomy.
resume_court: Bilateral bloody otorrhea is a rare complication of surgery and to our knowledge a previously unpublished event. Bloody discharge from bilateral auditory canals was noted upon removal of the surgical drapes. Otolaryngologic examination revealed bilateral anterior auditory canal hematomas without any loss of hearing.

titre: Risk of Colorectal Cancer by Subsite in a Swedish Prostate Cancer Cohort.
resume_court: The relationship between sex hormone-related treatment for prostate cancer and the risk of colorectal cancer is controversial. Patients with prostate cancer undergoing bilateral orchiectomy, prostatectomy, or other treatments, including antiandrogen therapy and radiation, may be at increased risk for colorectal adenocarcinoma.

titre: MRJF4, a novel histone deacetylase inhibitor, induces p21 mediated autophagy in PC3 prostate cancer cells.
resume_court: Autophagy is a cellular defense mechanism which occurs through degradation and recycling of cytoplasmic constituents and represents a caspase—independent alternative to cell death by apoptosis. The inhibition of cell proliferation through autophagy activation could be an important mechanism for many anti—tumor drugs.

titre: MRI of the Prostate in Germany: Online Survey among Radiologists.
resume_court: To assess structural, technical, and communicative aspects of dedicated MR examinations of the prostate (MRP) offered by radiologists in Germany. The survey represented board-certified radiologists in 128 institutions (63 HDs and 65 PPs) in 67/95 German postal regions (71%). MRP was a widely available, small-volume examination among radiologists in Germany in 2011.

titre: Effect of parallel radiofrequency transmission on arterial input function selection in dynamic contrast-enhanced 3 Tesla pelvic MRI.
resume_court: To evaluate whether parallel radiofrequency transmission (mTX) can improve the symmetry of the left and right femoral arteries in dynamic contrast enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (DCE-MRI) of prostate and bladder cancer. mTX can significantly improve left-to-right symmetry of femoral artery precontrast signal and contrast enhancement.

titre: Neuroendocrine Transdifferentiation in Human Prostate Cancer Cells: An Integrated Approach.
resume_court: Prostate cancer is highly sensitive to hormone therapy because androgens are essential for prostate cancer cell growth. Our findings provide direct biologic and molecular support for the concept that neuroendocrine transdifferentiation in prostate cancer cell populations influences the progression to androgen independence.

titre: Muscadine grape skin extract can antagonize Snail-cathepsin L-mediated invasion, migration and osteoclastogenesis in prostate and breast cancer cells.
resume_court: MSKE decreased Snail and pSTAT3 expression, and abrogated Snail-mediated CatL activity, migration and invasion. Overall, these novel findings suggest that Snail regulation of CatL may occur via STAT-3 signaling and can be antagonized by MSKE, leading to decreased cell invasion, migration and bone turnover.

titre: Recent discoveries concerning the involvement of transcription factors from the Grainyhead-like family in cancer.
resume_court: The Grainyhead-like (GRHL) family of transcription factors has three mammalian members, which are currently termed Grainyhead-like 1 (GRHL1), Grainyhead-like 2 (GRHL2), and Grainyhead-like 3 (GRHL3). Their patterns of expression are tissue and developmentally specific. Earlier studies of the GRHL proteins focused on their functions in mammalian development.

titre: ¹8F-DCFBC PET/CT for PSMA-Based Detection and Characterization of Primary Prostate Cancer.
resume_court: PSMA has been shown to be associated with higher Gleason grade and more aggressive disease. Although the sensitivity of (18)F-DCFBC for primary prostate cancer was less than MR imaging, (18)F-DCFBC PET was able to detect the more clinically significant high-grade and larger-volume tumors (Gleason score 8 and 9) with higher specificity than MR imaging.

titre: Prognostic Factors in Patients Treated with 223Ra: The Role of Skeletal Tumor Burden on Baseline 18F-Fluoride PET/CT in Predicting Overall Survival.
resume_court: The purpose of this study was to evaluate outcome after (223)Ra dichloride therapy ((223)Ra) and to determine whether skeletal tumor burden on whole-body (18)F-fluoride PET/CT can be used as a predictive biomarker of survival in patients treated with (223)Ra. Skeletal tumor burden on baseline fluoride PET/CT is a predictive biomarker of OS and the risk of an SRE in patients treated with (223)Ra.

titre: Combination of 5a-reductase inhibitor with combined androgen blockade (CAB) as a novel cytoreductive regimen before prostate brachytherapy: Ultra-CAB.
resume_court: We report a first case of using a 5a-reductase inhibitor (5ARI) and combined androgen blockade (CAB) as a cytoreductive regimen before prostate brachytherapy. Here, we describe this cytoreductive regimen used in a 63 year-old prostate cancer patient who became eligible to receive brachytherapy after dutasteride (0.5 mg daily) was added to CAB and prostate volume reduction of 57% was achieved.

titre: Active surveillance of prostate cancer: a questionnaire survey of urologists, clinical oncologists and urology nurse specialists across three cancer networks in the United Kingdom.
resume_court: Active surveillance is considered a mainstream strategy in the management of patients with low-risk prostate cancer. Only 40 % undertake a repeat biopsy at 12 months. Resources are not currently in place across the UK to support an active surveillance program and a national discussion and debate to plan resources is much required so that it can become a mainstream therapeutic strategy.

titre: Optimal sequence of bone target drugs in metastatic prostatic cancer.
resume_court: Breast, prostate, lung and kidney cancer all manifest with a high predilection for metastasis to bone, which is a prevalent cause of morbidity, increased risk of death and decreased quality of life for patients. Therapy with new drugs in prostate cancer has been shown to decrease the risk of skeletal-related complications and, therefore, provide an overall survival and quality of life benefit.

titre: Targeting geranylgeranylation reduces adrenal gland tumor burden in a murine model of prostate cancer metastasis.
resume_court: The isoprenoid biosynthetic pathway (IBP) is critical for providing substrates for the post-translational modification of proteins key in regulating malignant cell properties, including proliferation, invasion, and migration. Our findings detail a novel bisphosphonate compound capable of preferentially altering the IBP in tumor-burdened adrenal glands of a murine model of PCa metastasis.

titre: Gonadotropin-releasing hormone antagonist: A real advantage?
resume_court: Degarelix is a gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) antagonist that is approved for the treatment of prostate cancer. Moreover, the recent reports including pooled data analyses on degarelix suggest improved disease control, quality of life, and lower urinary tract symptoms and decreased risk of cardiovascular diseases when compared with GnRH agonists.

titre: Current Histopathologic and Molecular Characterisations of Prostate Cancer: Towards Individualised Prognosis and Therapies.
resume_court: Data on TMPRSS2-ERG and AR-V7 may pave the way for personalised therapy for prostate cancer (PCa) patients. Comprehensive molecular profiling can help identify multiple PCa subtypes and driving alterations. Translating these findings into clinical practice is still challenging.

titre: Dismiss Systematic Transrectal Ultrasound-guided and Embrace Targeted Magnetic Resonance Imaging-informed Prostate Biopsy: Is the Paradigm Ready to Shift?
resume_court: Multiparametric magnetic resonance imaging-informed prostate biopsy is attracting increasing interest among practicing urologists. Whether this will become the new gold standard in prostate cancer diagnosis and supplant systematic transrectal ultrasound-guided sampling remains to be determined. Here we present the main open questions and current concerns regarding this new approach.

titre: Comparison of digital image analysis and visual scoring of KI-67 in prostate cancer prognosis after prostatectomy.
resume_court: The tumor proliferative index marker Ki-67 was shown to be associated with clinically significant outcomes in prostate cancer, but its clinical application has limitations due to lack of uniformity and consistency in quantification. Our objective was to compare the measurements obtained with digital image analysis (DIA) versus virtual microscopy (visual scoring (VS)).

titre: Unravelling personalized dysfunctional gene network of complex diseases based on differential network model.
resume_court: In the conventional analysis of complex diseases, the control and case samples are assumed to be of great purity. The expression variance and expression covariance can address such a problem in a network manner. This DEVC-based differential expression network (DEVC-net) has been applied to the study of complex diseases for prostate cancer and diabetes.

titre: Genetic risk variants associated with in situ breast cancer.
resume_court: Breast cancer in situ (BCIS) diagnoses, a precursor lesion for invasive breast cancer, comprise about 20 % of all breast cancers (BC) in countries with screening programs. We found that five SNPs (CDKN2BAS-rs1011970, FGFR2-rs3750817, FGFR2-rs2981582, TNRC9-rs3803662, 5p12-rs10941679) were significantly associated with BCIS risk (P value adjusted for multiple comparisons <0.0016).

titre: Use of Hospital-Based Food Pantries Among Low-Income Urban Cancer Patients.
resume_court: To examine uptake of a novel emergency food system at five cancer clinics in New York City, hospital-based food pantries, and predictors of use, among low-income urban cancer patients. The main outcome was continued uptake of this food pantry intervention. Generalized estimating equation (GEE) statistical analysis was conducted to model predictors of pantry visit frequency.

titre: U.S. Food and Drug Administration Approval Summary: Enzalutamide for the Treatment of Patients With Chemotherapy-Naïve Metastatic Castration-Resistant Prostate Cancer.
resume_court: The U.S. At the prespecified interim analysis, a statistically significant improvement in overall survival was demonstrated for patients in the enzalutamide arm compared with patients in the placebo arm. The overall benefit-risk profile supports the expanded indication for enzalutamide.

titre: EGF Receptor Promotes Prostate Cancer Bone Metastasis by Downregulating miR-1 and Activating TWIST1.
resume_court: Dysregulation of the EGFR signaling axis enhances bone metastases in many solid cancers. Our findings support a model in which nuclear EGFR acts as a transcriptional repressor to constrain the tumor-suppressive role of miR-1 and sustain oncogenic activation of TWIST1, thereby leading to accelerated bone metastasis.

titre: SRRM4 Expression and the Loss of REST Activity May Promote the Emergence of the Neuroendocrine Phenotype in Castration-Resistant Prostate Cancer.
resume_court: The neuroendocrine phenotype is associated with the development of metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC). Only CHGA(+)/SYP(+) metastases had a neuroendocrine transcript signature. The neuronal transcriptional regulator SRRM4 transcript was associated with the neuroendocrine signature in CHGA(+)/SYP(+) metastases and all CHGA(+)/SYP(+) LuCaP xenografts.

titre: Autocrine Activation of CHRM3 Promotes Prostate Cancer Growth and Castration Resistance via CaM/CaMKK-Mediated Phosphorylation of Akt.
resume_court: Although a previous study reported nerve ending-derived acetylcholine promoted prostate cancer invasion and metastasis by regulating the microenvironment of cancer cells, the present study aims to determine whether there is autocrine cholinergic signaling in prostate epithelial cells that promotes prostate cancer growth and castration resistance.

titre: Drug Cost Avoidance in Prostate Cancer Clinical Trials.
resume_court: Economic impact of prostate cancer is increasing in relation to its increased incidence and increased patient survival. Total cost avoidance of 696,002€ and an average cost avoidance by clinical trial of 139,200€ were obtained. Average cost avoidance per patient was 5,118€.

titre: Manuscript title: Geospatial analysis of Cancer risk and residential proximity to coal mines in Illinois.
resume_court: Studies have indicated a population-level association between coal mining and cancer incidence and mortality, but few studies specifically examined residential proximity to this exposure using spatial analysis. Regression analyses indicated an association between recent coal production and colorectal cancer incidence (p=0.009) and mortality (p=0.035) and prostate cancer mortality (p=0.047).

titre: Radiation dose escalation or longer androgen suppression for locally advanced prostate cancer? Data from the TROG 03.04 RADAR trial.
resume_court: The relative effects of radiation dose escalation (RDE) and androgen suppression (AS) duration on local prostatic progression (LP) remain unclear. At 6.5 years, adjusted cumulative incidences were 22%, 15%, 13% and 7% respectively. RDE and increasing AS independently reduce LP and increase urethral strictures.

titre: Clinical Evaluation of ErbB-Targeted CAR T-Cells, Following Intracavity Delivery in Patients with ErbB-Expressing Solid Tumors.
resume_court: Adoptive cell therapy using gene-modified T-cells has achieved impressive results in the treatment of B-cell malignancies. Targeting of the extended ErbB network using CAR T-cells is supported by prevalence of ErbB dysregulation in diverse solid tumors and the clinical impact of monoclonal antibody therapy directed against members of this family.

titre: Histologic classification of prostate cancer.
resume_court: Apart from the typical acinar morphology observed in more than 90% of prostatic adenocarcinomas, a spectrum of morphological variants and prostate cancer subtypes exists. Two nosologically different groups can be distinguished: the variants of conventional acinar cancer and cancers with histological pattern, which are unusual for the prostate.

titre: Morphology of treatment-related changes in the prostate and prostatic cancer.
resume_court: Nonsurgical therapeutic options for prostatic diseases are divided into androgen action-related, with androgen action inhibition (AAI), or androgen action-unrelated strategies, such as radiotherapy (RT). An overview of treatment effects caused by AAI and RT is herein presented, with discussion on their importance in everyday practice.

titre: Mimickers of prostate cancer in needle biopsies.
resume_court: The diagnosis of prostate cancer is made based on the architecture of the glandular proliferation and nuclear atypia, but some normal structures (seminal vesicle, Cowper's glands, prostatic central zone) or nonneoplastic proliferative lesions can mimic carcinoma. The demonstration of basal cells can be the best method to identify these prostate cancer mimickers.

titre: Staging of prostate cancer: a review with reference for further refinement.
resume_court: Staging of prostate carcinoma provides a standardized method for tumor classification which is based on involvement of the prostate gland, adjacent local structures, regional lymph nodes, and distant sites. T2 tumors are confined to the organ, are subdivided by involvement in one or both lobes, and are determined by radical prostatectomy procedure.

titre: Assessing the impact of mass media public health campaigns. Be Clear on Cancer 'blood in pee': a case in point.
resume_court: To assess the impact on suspected cancer referral burden and new cancer diagnosis of Public Health England's recent Be Clear on Cancer 'blood in pee' mass media campaign. A retrospective cohort study design was used. Over the campaign period and the subsequent 3 months, the number of haematuria referrals increased by 92% (P = 0.013) when compared with the same period a year earlier.

titre: A microRNA code for prostate cancer metastasis.
resume_court: Although the development of bone metastasis is a major detrimental event in prostate cancer, the molecular mechanisms responsible for bone homing and destruction remain largely unknown. Here we show that loss of miR-15 and miR-16 in cooperation with increased miR-21 expression promote prostate cancer spreading and bone lesions.

titre: CXCR4 pharmacogical inhibition reduces bone and soft tissue metastatic burden by affecting tumor growth and tumorigenic potential in prostate cancer preclinical models.
resume_court: The majority of prostate cancer (Pca) patient morbidity can be attributed to bone metastatic events, which poses a significant clinical obstacle. In this study we studied if two CXCR4 receptor antagonists, Plerixafor and CTE9908, may affect bone metastatic disease induced by Pca in preclinical experimental models Bone-derived Pca cells express higher CXCR4 levels than other Pca cell lines.

titre: Use of non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs and prostate cancer survival in the Finnish prostate cancer screening trial.
resume_court: Growing evidence suggests that aspirin is associated with decreased prostate cancer (PCa) mortality. The effect of other NSAID use on risk of PCa death remains controversial. We examined prostate cancer survival among aspirin and other NSAID users in the Finnish Prostate Cancer Screening Trial.

titre: Using Clinical Risk Models for Lung Nodule Classification.
resume_court: Evaluation and diagnosis of indeterminate pulmonary nodules is a significant and increasing burden on our health care system. Additional work is needed to develop decision support tools that will facilitate the use of these models in clinical practice, to complement the clinician's judgment and enhance shared decision making with the patient at the bedside.

titre: Impact of prostate volume on oncologic, perioperative, and functional outcomes after radical prostatectomy.
resume_court: The impact of prostate volume (PV) on oncologic, perioperative and functional outcomes after radical prostatectomy (RP) remains controversial, as recent studies present inconsistent results. In multivariate analysis, continence at 1 week, 3 months and 12 months was significantly worse in patients with glands =70?ml, while potency was not influenced by PV in multivariate analysis.

titre: Orthotopic tumorgrafts in nude mice: A new method to study human prostate cancer.
resume_court: In vivo model systems in prostate cancer research that authentically reproduce tumor growth are still sparse. Balb/c nude mice were used to graft fresh prostate tumor tissue by renal subcapsular and orthotopic implantation. Animals were tracked by means of 30 MHz ultrasound to monitor tumor engraftment and growth.

titre: Laparoscopic extended pelvic lymph node (LN) dissection as validation of the performance of [(11) C]-acetate positron emission tomography/computer tomography in the detection of LN metastasis in intermediate- and high-risk prostate cancer.
resume_court: To evaluate the accuracy of the radiopharmaceutical [(11) C]-acetate combined with positron emission tomography/computer tomography (acetate-PET/CT) in lymph node (LN) staging in newly diagnosed prostate cancer cases. The sensitivity, specificity and accuracy of acetate-PET/CT were calculated. The acetate-PET/CT positive cases have a very high burden of LN spread.

titre: Selenium and Human Health: Witnessing a Copernican Revolution?
resume_court: In humans, selenium was hypothesized to lower the risk of several chronic diseases, mainly due to the antioxidant activity of selenium-containing proteins. Biochemical studies indicate that selenium may exert a broad pattern of toxic effects at unexpectedly low concentrations. In conclusion, toxic effects of selenium species occur at lower concentrations than previously believed.

titre: miR-130a activates apoptotic signaling through activation of caspase-8 in taxane-resistant prostate cancer cells.
resume_court: The acquisition of drug resistance is one of the most malignant phenotypes of cancer and identification of its therapeutic target is a prerequisite for the development of novel therapy. Our results suggested that reduced expression of miR-130a may be involved in the paclitaxel-resistance and that miR-130a could be a therapeutic target for taxane-resistant prostate cancer patients.

titre: Dose-dependent effect of androgen deprivation therapy for localized prostate cancer on adverse cardiac events.
resume_court: To investigate the dose-dependent effect of androgen deprivation therapy (ADT) on adverse cardiac events in elderly men with non-metastatic prostate cancer (PCa) stratified according to life expectancy. Exposure to ADT with GnRH agonists is associated with an increased risk of cardiac events in elderly men with localized PCa and a decent life expectancy.

titre: Clinical Implications and Prognostic Values of Prostate Cancer Susceptibility Candidate Methylation in Primary Nonmuscle Invasive Bladder Cancer.
resume_court: DNA methylation is the most common and well-characterized epigenetic change in human cancer. Enhanced methylation status of PRAC was positively associated with a high rate of recurrence and progression in NMIBC patients, suggesting that PRAC methylation may be a promising prognostic marker of NMIBC.

titre: Estrogen-Related Receptors in Breast Cancer and Prostate Cancer.
resume_court: Estrogen-signaling pathways are implicated in the development of breast cancer and prostate cancer. Various studies have focused on additional signaling pathways, mediated by estrogen-related receptors (ERRs). ERRs are constitutively active receptors that share a high degree of homology with the classical estrogen receptors (ERs).

titre: Cosuppression of Sprouty and Sprouty-related negative regulators of FGF signalling in prostate cancer: a working hypothesis.
resume_court: Deregulation of FGF receptor tyrosine kinase (RTK) signalling is common in prostate cancer. Normally, to moderate RTK signalling, induction of Sprouty (SPRY) and Sprouty-related (SPRED) antagonists occurs. These findings demonstrate the importance of negative regulators of receptor tyrosine signalling, such as Spry, in the clinical setting, and highlight their importance for future pharmacopeia.

titre: Advanced prostate cancer: Every Voice Matters.
resume_court: Heather Payne speaks to Gemma Westcott, Commissioning Editor: Heather Payne was appointed as a consultant in Clinical Oncology at University College Hospital (London, UK) in 1997. Further to this, she is a trustee of the Prostate Cancer Research Centre and clinical lead for the National Prostate Cancer Audit.

titre: Corrigendum.
resume_court: This should have been presented as: Medical Oncology Unit 1; Department of Clinical & Experimental Oncology, Istituto Oncologico Veneto IOV IRCCS, Padova Italy. The authors and editors of Future Oncology would like to sincerely apologize for any inconvenience or confusion this may have caused.

titre: Pim Kinases Promote Migration and Metastatic Growth of Prostate Cancer Xenografts.
resume_court: Pim family proteins are oncogenic kinases implicated in several types of cancer and involved in regulation of cell proliferation, survival as well as motility. We show here that tumorigenic growth of both subcutaneously and orthotopically inoculated prostate cancer xenografts is enhanced by stable overexpression of either Pim-1 or Pim-3.

titre: Metformin induces ER stress-dependent apoptosis through miR-708-5p/NNAT pathway in prostate cancer.
resume_court: Although the antitumor role of metformin has been widely reported, the molecular mechanism of this biguanide agent in the inhibition of tumor progression remains unclear. Taken together, our findings clearly demonstrate that metformin stimulates increased expression of miR-708-5p to target the NNAT-mediated response to ER stress and apoptosis.

titre: TRAIL-Based High Throughput Screening Reveals a Link between TRAIL-Mediated Apoptosis and Glutathione Reductase, a Key Component of Oxidative Stress Response.
resume_court: A high throughput screen for compounds that induce TRAIL-mediated apoptosis identified ML100 as an active chemical probe, which potentiated TRAIL activity in prostate carcinoma PPC-1 and melanoma MDA-MB-435 cells. In accordance with the role of GSR in the TRAIL pathway, GSR gene silencing potentiated TRAIL activity in MDA-MB-435 cells but not in human hepatocytes.

titre: Prostate Biopsy Specimens With Gleason 3+3=6 and Intraductal Carcinoma: Radical Prostatectomy Findings and Clinical Outcomes.
resume_court: The aim of this study was to investigate clinical outcomes and radical prostatectomy (RP) findings in patients with Gleason 3+3=6 and IDC-P on biopsy or TURP. As a minority of men may only have Gleason 6 invasive cancer at RP and a favorable prognosis, we recommend that IDC-P on biopsy/TURP be reported separately and not assigned a Gleason score.

titre: Pten Regulates Epithelial Cytodifferentiation during Prostate Development.
resume_court: Gene expression and functional studies have indicated that the molecular programmes involved in prostate development are also active in prostate cancer. This study provides novel insight into the role of Pten in prostate development as part of the process of coordinating the differentiation and proliferation of cell types in time and space to form a functional organ.

titre: Characterization of a Gene Expression Signature in Normal Rat Prostate Tissue Induced by the Presence of a Tumor Elsewhere in the Organ.
resume_court: To investigate this response further, we compared prostate morphology and the gene expression profile of tumor-bearing normal rat prostate tissue (termed tumor-instructed/indicating normal tissue (TINT)) with that of prostate tissue from controls. None of the controls showed morphological TINT-changes. Quantitative RT-PCR analysis verified key TINT-changes, and they were not detected in controls.

titre: Sexual Health Concerns Among Cancer Survivors: Testing a Novel Information-Need Measure Among Breast and Prostate Cancer Patients.
resume_court: While it is recognized that cancer treatment can contribute to problems in sexual function, much less is currently known about the specific sexual health concerns and information needs of cancer survivors. This study tested a new instrument to measure cancer survivors' sexual health concerns and needs for sexual information after cancer treatment. Areas of concern differed by cancer type.

titre: Proteomics in diagnosis of prostate cancer.
resume_court: (Full text is available at http://www.manu.edu.mk/prilozi). This review is focused on the overall analysis of expression proteomics studies in the PCa field investigating all types of human samples in the search for diagnostics biomarkers. Key words: Prostate cancer, benign prostate hyperplasia, diagnostics biomarkers, comparative proteomics, gel-based proteomics, shotgun proteomics.

titre: Effects of Testosterone Level on Lower Urinary Tract Symptoms.
resume_court: Lower urinary tract symptoms (LUTS) are common in older men and are frequently associated with benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH). In conclusion, endogenous TT levels did not correlate with LUTS or prostate size, and these findings support the saturation theory in which TT is not able to induce further androgen-stimulated prostate tissue growth due to receptor saturation.

titre: Update on Testosterone Replacement Therapy in Hypogonadal Men.
resume_court: Late-onset male hypogonadism has long been recognized as a treatable medical condition; however, misconceptions about the use of testosterone replacement therapy (TRT) have often led urologists away from its more mainstream use. Various formulations of TRT, each with its own risks and benefits, are also detailed.

titre: Comparison of Patients Undergoing PVP Versus TURP for LUTS/BPH.
resume_court: Transurethral resection of the prostate (TURP) and photoselective vaporization of the prostate (PVP) are currently the two most commonly performed procedures for the treatment of benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH). The primary objective of this article is to summarize the comparative research of PVP and TURP and the implications on differences between patients who undergo either procedure.

titre: Testosterone Replacement Therapy on the Natural History of Prostate Disease.
resume_court: The physiology of testosterone production and action are closely related to prostatic disease. Proposed in this review are some theories as to how testosterone interacts to potentially ameliorate these conditions. Further research is needed, but we feel our proposed points are valid given the review of the literature.

titre: Implementation of Multi-parametric Prostate MRI in Clinical Practice.
resume_court: While initial implementations of prostate MRI suffered from suboptimal performance in tumor detection, technological advances over the past decade have allowed modern multi-parametric prostate MRI (mpMRI) to achieve high diagnostic accuracy for detection, localization, and staging and thereby impact patient management.

titre: DNA methylation as a dynamic regulator of development and disease processes: spotlight on the prostate.
resume_court: Prostate development, benign hyperplasia and cancer involve androgen and growth factor signaling as well as stromal-epithelial interactions.

titre: Insulin receptor variants and obesity-related cancers in the Framingham Heart Study.
resume_court: The insulin-signaling pathway plays a pivotal role in cancer biology; however, evidence of genetic alterations in human studies is limited. Participants who provided consent were genotyped. Nineteen single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) in the INSR gene were investigated in relation to risk of obesity-related cancers combined and breast, prostate and colorectal cancers.

titre: Improved detection of anterior fibromuscular stroma and transition zone prostate cancer using biparametric and multiparametric MRI with MRI-targeted biopsy and MRI-US fusion guidance.
resume_court: Detection rates of SBs and TBs were assessed for all PC and sPC patients defined by Gleason score (GS)?3+4 and GS?4+3. MRI-targeted biopsies detected significantly more anteriorly located sPC compared with SBs in the repeat-biopsy setting. The more cost-efficient bpMRI was statistically not inferior to mpMRI in sPC detection in TZ/AFMS.

titre: Effects of resistance training frequency on physical functioning and quality of life in prostate cancer survivors: a pilot randomized controlled trial.
resume_court: Resistance training (RT) improves muscular strength, physical functioning and quality of life in prostate cancer survivors, but the optimal frequency of RT is unknown. Prostate cancer survivors (N=30) were randomized to 12 weeks of supervised RT performed either 3 days per week (n=16) or 2 days per week (n=14).

titre: Phase I/II clinical trial of dendritic-cell based immunotherapy (DCVAC/PCa) combined with chemotherapy in patients with metastatic, castration-resistant prostate cancer.
resume_court: We conducted an open-label, single-arm Phase I/II clinical trial in metastatic CRPC (mCRPC) patients eligible for docetaxel combined with treatment with autologous mature dendritic cells (DCs) pulsed with killed LNCaP prostate cancer cells (DCVAC/PCa). The long-term administration of DCVAC/PCa led to the induction and maintenance of PSA specific T cells.

titre: Stability Assessment of Candidate Reference Genes in Urine Sediment of Prostate Cancer Patients for miRNA Applications.
resume_court: We aimed at assessing the stability of candidate reference genes in urine sediments of men subjected to digital rectal examination for suspected prostate cancer (PCa). In conclusion, we recommend the use of miR-191 for normalization purposes in post-DRE urine sediments.

titre: Incidence of kidney, bladder, and prostate cancers in Korea: An update.
resume_court: The incidence of cancer is sharply increasing. In this study, which was based on the Korea National Cancer Incidence Database, annual incident cases, age-standardized incidence rates, annual percentage change (APC), and distribution by age group were examined in kidney, bladder, and prostate cancers, respectively. Bladder and prostate cancers occurred mostly in the 70- to 74-year-old age group.

titre: Two-dimensional neovascular complexity is significantly higher in nontumor prostate tissue than in low-risk prostate cancer.
resume_court: Prostate cancer is the most frequent cancer in men in Europe. A total of 280 prostate biopsy sections from a homogeneous series of 70 patients with low-risk prostate cancer (Gleason score 3+3, prostate-specific antigen [PSA]<10 ng/mL, and clinical stage T1c) who underwent systematic biopsy sampling and subsequent radical prostatectomy were analyzed.

titre: Effect of patient position on pain scales during transrectal ultrasound-guided prostate biopsy.
resume_court: Transrectal ultrasound (TRUS)-guided prostate biopsy is the most useful technique for the diagnosis of prostate cancer; however, many patients describe the procedure as uncomfortable and painful. Pain was assessed by using visual analogue scale (VAS) scores from 0 to 10. We suggest that the lithotomy position may be the proper way to reduce pain during TRUS-guided prostate biopsy.

titre: Antibiotic prophylaxis with intravenous ceftriaxone and fluoroquinolone reduces infectious complications after transrectal ultrasound-guided prostatic biopsy.
resume_court: To assess the rates of infectious complications before and after the change of prophylactic antibiotic regimens in prostate needle biopsy. Two patients in group 1 required intensive care because of septic shock. Antibiotic prophylaxis with ceftriaxone and fluoroquinolone before prostate needle biopsy decreased the risk of potentially serious infectious complications.

titre: Using circulating tumor cells to inform on prostate cancer biology and clinical utility.
resume_court: Substantial advances in the molecular biology of prostate cancer have led to the approval of multiple new systemic agents to treat men with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC). Here, we review technologies used to detect and characterize CTCs, and the potential biological and clinical utility of CTC molecular profiling in men with metastatic prostate cancer.

titre: Cancer survival differences between South Asians and non-South Asians of England in 1986-2004, accounting for age at diagnosis and deprivation.
resume_court: South Asian migrants show lower cancer incidence than their host population in England for most major cancers. We observed survival advantage in South Asians in earlier periods. Considering recent survival trends, appropriate action is required to avoid deficits in cancer survival among South Asians in the near future.

titre: Leupaxin stimulates adhesion and migration of prostate cancer cells through modulation of the phosphorylation status of the actin-binding protein caldesmon.
resume_court: The focal adhesion protein leupaxin (LPXN) is overexpressed in a subset of prostate cancers (PCa) and is involved in the progression of PCa. In conclusion, we demonstrate that LPXN directly influences cytoskeletal dynamics via interaction with the actin-binding protein CaD and regulates CaD phosphorylation by recruiting ERK to highly dynamic structures within PCa cells.

titre: PRUNE2 is a human prostate cancer suppressor regulated by the intronic long noncoding RNA PCA3.
resume_court: Prostate cancer antigen 3 (PCA3) is the most specific prostate cancer biomarker but its function remains unknown. These results establish PCA3 as a dominant-negative oncogene and PRUNE2 as an unrecognized tumor suppressor gene in human prostate cancer, and their regulatory axis represents a unique molecular target for diagnostic and therapeutic intervention.

titre: Precision medicine path for prostate cancer.
resume_court: Almost 90% of patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer have a clinically actionable genetic alteration, according to a recently published study. Among these patients, researchers found that 65% had genetic changes that could be targeted by investigational or FDA-approved drugs currently used for other cancers, leading to new individualized treatment strategies.

titre: miR-195 Inhibits Tumor Progression by Targeting RPS6KB1 in Human Prostate Cancer.
resume_court: To investigate the involvement of hsa-miRNA-195-5p (miR-195) in progression and prognosis of human prostate cancer. Its clinical significance was statistically analyzed. The newly identified miR-195-RPS6KB1 axis partially illustrates the molecular mechanism of prostate cancer progression and represents a novel potential therapeutic target for prostate cancer treatment.

titre: A Novel Triazole Nucleoside Suppresses Prostate Cancer Cell Growth by Inhibiting Heat Shock Factor 1 and Androgen Receptor.
resume_court: A novel triazole nucleoside analogue was discovered to exhibit potent anticancer activity in prostate cancer cells via down-regulating heat shock factor 1 (HSF1) and related heat shock proteins, along with the consequential inhibition of androgen receptor (AR) expression and transactivation, arresting the cell cycle in AR-governed phase.

titre: Emodin inhibits the proliferation of PC3 prostate cancer cells in vitro via the Notch signaling pathway.
resume_court: The aim of the present study was to examine the anticarcinogenic effects of emodin on the Notch signaling pathway and vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) in the PC3 androgen-independent prostate cancer cell line in vitro. Flow cytometry demonstrated that emodin induced apoptosis in the PC3 cells and arrested the cell cycle of the PC3 cells at the G2/M phase.

titre: YM155 exerts a growth inhibitory effect on human osteosarcoma in vitro and in vivo.
resume_court: YM155, a novel small-molecule inhibitor of survivin, is known to exert antitumor effects on various cancers, including breast, prostate and lung cancer. We also found that YM155 suppressed Mcl-1 and survivin expression without affecting the expression of anti-apoptotic proteins X-linked inhibitor of apoptosis (XIAP) and Bcl-2.

titre: The International Society for Sexual Medicine's Process of Care for the Assessment and Management of Testosterone Deficiency in Adult Men.
resume_court: In 2014, the International Society for Sexual Medicine (ISSM) convened a panel of experts to develop an evidence-based process of care for the diagnosis and management of testosterone deficiency (TD) in adult men. This article contains the report of the ISSM TD Process of Care Committee. We recommend that this process of care be reevaluated and updated by the ISSM in 4 years.

titre: Capsaicin causes inactivation and degradation of the androgen receptor by inducing the restoration of miR-449a in prostate cancer.
resume_court: Capsaicin, a novel antitumor agent extracted from chili peppers, has been proven to induce growth inhibition in various types of cancer including prostate cancer. In addition, increased expression of miR-449a may facilitate the sensitivity of prostate cancer to capsaicin treatment. Thus, capsaicin may be developed as a novel anti-AR drug for the therapy of prostate cancer.

titre: FOXM1 and its Oncogenic Signaling in Gastric Cancer.
resume_court: The transcription factor FOXM1 is overexpressed in many human cancers, including liver, stomach, prostate, brain, breast, lung, colon, pancreas, cervix, ovary and nervous system. Recent data have demonstrated that FOXM1 is involved in cell initiation, progression, and metastasis and in responses to anticancer drugs.

titre: Persistent low expression of hZip1 in mucinous carcinomas of the ovary, colon, stomach and lung.
resume_court: Mucinous carcinomas from different organs are morphologically similar and might share similarities at the molecular and biochemical levels that may illuminate their pathogenesis and influence management. hZip1 is consistently decreased in mucinous carcinomas from a variety of organs.

titre: Cancer risk among patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus: a population-based prospective study in China.
resume_court: Evidence indicates an increased cancer risk among type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) patients, yet studies in mainland China are scarce. Overall cancer risk was found significantly increased with an SIR of 1.15 (95% CI 1.12-1.19) and 1.25 (95% CI 1.21-1.30) in males and females, respectively. We suggested an increased cancer risk among T2DM patients.

titre: A randomised non-comparative phase II trial of cixutumumab (IMC-A12) or ramucirumab (IMC-1121B) plus mitoxantrone and prednisone in men with metastatic docetaxel-pretreated castration-resistant prostate cancer.
resume_court: Cixutumumab, a human monoclonal antibody (HuMAb), targets the insulin-like growth factor receptor. Median cPFS was 4.1 months (95% confidence interval (CI), 2.2-5.6) for cixutumumab and 6.7 months (95% CI, 4.5-8.3) for ramucirumab. Median time to radiographic progression was 7.5 months for cixutumumab and 10.2 months for ramucirumab, with a median OS of 10.8 and 13.0 months, respectively.

titre: Role of chemotherapy in the treatment of metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer patients who have progressed after abiraterone acetate.
resume_court: Abiraterone acetate is a novel irreversible inhibitor of CYP17 that was recently approved for men with post-chemotherapy or chemo-naive castration-resistant prostate cancer. Here, we review the first clinical studies in which castration-resistant prostate cancer patients received chemotherapy with D or C after progression during abiraterone acetate treatment.

titre: Steroid Receptor Coactivator 1 Promotes Human Hepatocellular Carcinoma Progression by Enhancing Wnt/ß-Catenin Signaling.
resume_court: Steroid receptor coactivator 1 (SRC-1) is a transcriptional coactivator not only for steroid receptors, such as androgen receptor and estrogen receptor, but also for other transcription factors. Our results demonstrate that SRC-1 promotes HCC progression by enhancing Wnt/ß-catenin signaling and suggest that SRC-1 is a potential therapeutic molecular target for HCC.

titre: Rationale for a Multimodality Strategy to Enhance the Efficacy of Dendritic Cell-Based Cancer Immunotherapy.
resume_court: Dendritic cells (DC), master antigen-presenting cells that orchestrate interactions between the adaptive and innate immune arms, are increasingly utilized in cancer immunotherapy. These include antibody-based targeted molecular therapies, immune checkpoint inhibitors, therapies that inhibit immunosuppressive cellular elements, conventional cytotoxic modalities, and immune potentiating adjuvants.

titre: Changes in Skeletal Tumor Activity on (18)F-choline PET/CT in Patients Receiving (223)Radium Radionuclide Therapy for Metastatic Prostate Cancer.
resume_court: Radium-223 dichloride is an alpha-emitting radiopharmaceutical shown to prolong survival in patients with castrate-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC) and symptomatic skeletal metastases. Further research is needed to determine the predictive value of serial F-18 choline PET/CT imaging in patients receiving radium-223 dichloride for CRPC.

titre: Tumour spectrum in non-BRCA hereditary breast cancer families in Sweden.
resume_court: Approximately 30 % of all breast cancer is at least partly attributed to hereditary factors. The aim of this study was to compare cancer proportions in familial non-BRCA hereditary breast cancer compared to the general population in search of putative new breast cancer syndromes. In conclusion, we found an overrepresentation of endometrial cancer in our cohort of hereditary non-BRCA families.

titre: Self-adjuvanted mRNA vaccination in advanced prostate cancer patients: a first-in-man phase I/IIa study.
resume_court: CV9103 is a prostate-cancer vaccine containing self-adjuvanted mRNA (RNActive®) encoding the antigens PSA, PSCA, PSMA, and STEAP1. Three dose levels of total mRNA were tested in Phase I in cohorts of 3-6 patients to determine a recommended dose. In phase II, 32 additional patients were treated at the recommended dose.

titre: Repeat Targeted Prostate Biopsy under Guidance of Multiparametric MRI-Correlated Real-Time Contrast-Enhanced Ultrasound for Patients with Previous Negative Biopsy and Elevated Prostate-Specific Antigen: A Prospective Study.
resume_court: Target lesions were determined by fusion of mpMRI and CEUS. Core-based CaDR was higher in TB (17.92%, 38 of 212 cores) than in SB (6.15%, 31 of 504 cores) (p < 0.0001; GLIMMIX). The mpMRI-CEUS correlated TB technique for the repeat prostate biopsy of patients with prior negative biopsy can improve CaDR based on the number of cores taken.

titre: Small-Molecule-Mediated Degradation of the Androgen Receptor through Hydrophobic Tagging.
resume_court: Androgen receptor (AR)-dependent transcription is a major driver of prostate tumor cell proliferation. These results suggest that selective AR degradation may be an effective therapeutic prostate tumor strategy in the context of AR mutations that confer resistance to second-generation AR antagonists.

titre: Discovery of mammalian target of rapamycin (mTOR) kinase inhibitor CC-223.
resume_court: We report here the synthesis and structure-activity relationship (SAR) of a novel series of mammalian target of rapamycin (mTOR) kinase inhibitors. The improved PK properties of this series allowed for exploration of in vivo efficacy and ultimately the selection of CC-223 for clinical development.

titre: Quality assessment of prostate cancer reports to the Danish Cancer Registry.
resume_court: The Danish Cancer Registry (DCR) is the oldest nationwide population-based cancer registry in the Nordic countries. At the time of the study the DCR recorded date of diagnosis, tumor stage and initial treatment. According to hospital records a total of 242 patients were confirmed having distant metastases (M1) at diagnosis but only 139 of these cases (57%) were reported to the DCR as such.

titre: Advance in studies on anti-cancer activity and mechanism of flavonoids
resume_court: Flavonoids are natural products that are ubiquitous in the natural world, with wide physiological activities and low toxic and side effects. This article focuses on the advance in domestic and foreign studies on anti-cancer activity and mechanism of flavonoids, in order to provide theoretical basis and research ideas for the further development and clinical application of flavonoids.

titre: Exploiting biological and physical determinants of radiotherapy toxicity to individualize treatment.
resume_court: The recent advances in radiation delivery can improve tumour control probability (TCP) and reduce treatment-related toxicity. Daily image guidance scans can be used to identify the position of normal tissue structures and potentially to compute the daily delivered dose. Some of this difference may be the result of differences between the planned dose and the accumulated dose (DA).

titre: GLIPR1-?TM synergizes with docetaxel in cell death and suppresses resistance to docetaxel in prostate cancer cells.
resume_court: Docetaxel is the first chemotherapy agent approved for treatment of metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC). Our data suggested that addition of GLIPR1-?TM treatment in PCa cells increases the efficacy of docetaxel and may inhibit the emergence of drug resistance; potentially permitting a decrease of docetaxel dose for patients with mCRPC eliminating its systemic toxicities.

titre: Involvement of ALAD-20S Proteasome Complexes in Ubiquitination and Acetylation of Proteasomal a2 Subunits.
resume_court: In the present study, this ALAD-proteasome complex was further characterized in cultured prostate cancer cells and the effects of SAHA treatment on the regulation of ALAD were investigated. Thus, the results of this study suggest that ALAD may play a regulatory role in a previously unreported post-translational modification of proteasomal a subunits.

titre: Global public awareness of venous thromboembolism.
resume_court: Data on public awareness about thrombosis in general and venous thromboembolism (VTE) in particular are limited. On a global level, public awareness about thrombosis overall, and VTE in particular, is low. Campaigns to increase public awareness about VTE are needed to reduce the burden from this largely preventable thrombotic disorder.

titre: Oncolytic virus carrying shRNA targeting SATB1 inhibits prostate cancer growth and metastasis.
resume_court: Recent studies suggest that SATB1 is a promising therapeutic target for prostate cancer. ZD55-SATB1 effectively inhibited the viability and invasion of DU145 and LNCaP cells in vitro and inhibited prostate cancer growth and metastasis in xenograft nude mice. In conclusion, replicative oncolytic adenovirus armed with SATB1 shRNA exhibits effective antitumor effect in human prostate cancer.

titre: Testing for treatment-biomarker interaction based on local partial-likelihood.
resume_court: In clinical trials, patients with different biomarker features may respond differently to the new treatments or drugs. The test method is called local partial-likelihood bootstrap (LPLB) and is developed by bootstrapping the martingale residuals. We use data from a breast cancer and a prostate cancer clinical trial to illustrate the proposed LPLB test.

titre: Transglutaminase 4 as a prostate autoantigen in male subfertility.
resume_court: Autoimmune polyendocrine syndrome type 1 (APS1), a monogenic disorder caused by AIRE gene mutations, features multiple autoimmune disease components. Infertility is common in both males and females with APS1. Collectively, our findings in APS1 patients and Aire-deficient mice reveal prostate autoimmunity as a major manifestation of APS1 with potential role in male subfertility.

titre: Circulating Leptin and Risk of Pancreatic Cancer: A Pooled Analysis From 3 Cohorts.
resume_court: Adiposity is associated with pancreatic cancer; however, the underlying mechanism(s) is uncertain. A total of 731 pancreatic adenocarcinoma cases that occurred between 1986 and 2010 were included (maximum follow-up, 23 years). Overall, serum leptin was not associated with pancreatic cancer (quintile 5 vs. quintile 1: odds ratio = 1.13, 95% confidence interval: 0.75, 1.71; Ptrend = 0.38).

titre: A chemogenomic screening identifies CK2 as a target for pro-senescence therapy in PTEN-deficient tumours.
resume_court: Enhancement of cellular senescence in tumours triggers a stable cell growth arrest and activation of an antitumour immune response that can be exploited for cancer therapy. Mechanistically, we show that Pten loss increases CK2 levels by activating STAT3. Taken together, our screening strategy has identified a novel STAT3-CK2-PML network that can be targeted for pro-senescence therapy for cancer.

titre: Preventing Overdiagnosis and Overtreatment: Just the Next Step in the Evolution of Breast Cancer Care.
resume_court: The problem of overdiagnosis and overtreatment has been highlighted in breast cancer and many other cancer types, most notably prostate cancer. Addressing this problem presents an opportunity to continue the evolution of breast cancer care. This approach will allow continual improvement and ultimately result in providing the right treatment for each patient.

titre: Serial Next-Generation Sequencing of Circulating Cell-Free DNA Evaluating Tumor Clone Response To Molecularly Targeted Drug Administration.
resume_court: We evaluated whether next-generation sequencing (NGS) of circulating cell-free DNA (cfDNA) could be used for patient selection and as a tumor clone response biomarker in patients with advanced cancers participating in early-phase clinical trials of targeted drugs. Targeted NGS of cfDNA has potential clinical utility to monitor the delivery of targeted therapies.

titre: Extended pelvic lymph node dissection at the time of robot-assisted radical prostatectomy: Impact of surgical volume on efficacy and complications in a single-surgeon series.
resume_court: We assessed the impact of surgical volume on perioperative outcomes and complications of robotic extended pelvic lymph node dissection (ePLND). Complications potentially related to ePLND were documented. A learning curve of 60 cases is suggested for optimal lymph node yield.

titre: Serum follicle-stimulating hormone levels predict time to development of castration-resistant prostate cancer.
resume_court: Treatment of advancing prostate cancer focuses on blocking the activation of the androgen receptor with resultant prolonged perturbation of the hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal axis. For each patient on treatment and with castrate levels of testosterone, the maximum FSH value between ADT commencement and CRPC was identified and recorded. FSH was analyzed as a continuous and categorical variable.

titre: Redistribution of Free- and Cell-Surface-Bound DNA in Blood of Benign and Malignant Prostate Tumor Patients.
resume_court: A direct correlation between the concentration of cell-free and cell-surface-bound circulating DNA (cfDNA and csbDNA, respectively) was demonstrated. The possibility of DNA redistribution between cfDNA and csbDNA indicates that the total pool of circulating DNA (cfDNA + csbDNA) should be used for a correct analysis of marker DNA concentrations and data standardization.

titre: Neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio may be associated with the outcome in patients with prostate cancer.
resume_court: Evidences have shown that neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR) has a prognostic value in patients with cancer. Pre-treatment percentage of neutrophils and NLR were considered, and correlated with patients data and recurrence free survival. NLR was not correlated with baseline total PSA, with Gleason score and with pathological stage; patients with a NLR >3 has a higher incidence of recurrence.

titre: Role of Phytosterols in Cancer Prevention and Treatment.
resume_court: Plant sterols or phytosterols have been shown to be effective in improving blood lipid profile and thereby protective against cardiovascular disease. Phytosterols have been reported to alleviate cancers of breast, prostate, lung, liver, stomach and ovary. Reductions in growth of various cancer cells including liver, prostate and breast by phytosterols treatment have been demonstrated.

titre: Using personal health insurance numbers to link the Canadian Cancer Registry and the Discharge Abstract Database.
resume_court: Linking cancer registry and administrative data can reveal health care use patterns among cancer patients. At least 98% of tumours diagnosed from 2005 through 2008 had valid HINs in the CCR or obtained through probabilistic linkages. Deterministically linking the CCR and DAD using personal HINs is a feasible and valid approach to obtaining hospitalization information about cancer patients.

titre: DNA Methylation-Guided Prediction of Clinical Failure in High-Risk Prostate Cancer.
resume_court: Prostate cancer (PCa) is a very heterogeneous disease with respect to clinical outcome. Hypermethylation of APC, CCND2, GSTP1, PTGS2 and RARB was highly cancer-specific. Classification of primary high-risk tumors into three subtypes based on DNA methylation can be combined with clinico-pathological parameters for a more informative risk-stratification of these PCa patients.

titre: Robot-assisted radical prostatectomy: recent advances.
resume_court: Robot assisted radical prostatectomy (RARP) represents the leading application of robotic surgery in the urologic field and it has become the main treatment option for localized prostate cancer (PCa) in the USA In the present review we summarized and critically analyzed the literature of the past five years about this widely used robotic procedure.

titre: Low testosterone level is an independent risk factor for high-grade prostate cancer detection at biopsy.
resume_court: To investigate the relationship between low testosterone levels and prostate cancer detection risk in a biopsy population. Among 681 men, 86 men (12.6%) had low testosterone levels, 143 (32.7%) had a positive biopsy, and 99 (14.5%) had high-grade prostate cancer. Low testosterone level is an independent risk factor for high-grade prostate cancer detection at biopsy.

titre: Regulation of migration and invasion by Toll-like receptor-9 signaling network in prostate cancer.
resume_court: Toll-like receptors (TLRs) play an important role in tumorigenesis and progress of prostate cancer. However, the function and mechanism of Toll-like receptor-9 (TLR9) in prostate cancer is not totally understood. This study provided the foundation to discover the new molecular mechanism in signaling networks of invasion and metastasis in prostate cancer.

titre: Long noncoding RNAs and neuroblastoma.
resume_court: Neuroblastoma is a disease that affects infants and despite intense multimodal therapy, high-risk patients have low survival rates (<50%). The roles of lncRNAs in neuroblastoma have just begun to be elucidated. This novel way of thinking about both neuroblastoma and lncRNAs brings a new perspective to the prognosis and treatment of high-risk patients.

titre: Tubulo-squamous polyp of the vagina
resume_court: To decribe a case of rare type of vaginal polyp. Tubulo-squamous polyp is rare type of vaginal polyp first described in 2007, with only up to 20 cases have been reported in the literature so far. This theory is supported by the fact that some cases show expression of prostate specific acid phosphatase (PSAP) and/or prostate specific antigen (PSA).

titre: The economic burden of cancer in the UK: a study of survivors treated with curative intent.
resume_court: We aim to describe the economic burden of UK cancer survivorship for breast, colorectal and prostate cancer patients treated with curative intent, 1 year post-diagnosis. The average monthly societal cost was $ US 409 (95%CI: $ US 316-$ US 502) [mean: £ 260, 95%CI: £ 198-£ 322] and was incurred by 92% of patients. Multivariate analyses showed higher societal costs for breast cancer patients.

titre: Effect of the USPSTF Grade D Recommendation against Screening for Prostate Cancer on Incident Prostate Cancer Diagnoses in the United States.
resume_court: In October 2011 the USPSTF (U.S. We evaluated the effect of the USPSTF guideline on the number and distribution of new prostate cancer diagnoses in the United States. Incident monthly prostate cancer diagnoses decreased by -1,363 cases (12.2%, p<0.01) in the month after the USPSTF draft guideline and continued to decrease by 164 cases per month relative to baseline (-1.8%, p<0.01).

titre: Hypoxia induces triglycerides accumulation in prostate cancer cells and extracellular vesicles supporting growth and invasiveness following reoxygenation.
resume_court: Hypoxia is an independent prognostic indicator of poor outcome in several malignancies. This is likely a survival response to hypoxic stress as accumulated lipids could support growth following reoxygenation. Furthermore, COX2 inhibitor celecoxib strongly reduced growth and invasiveness following hypoxic PCA cells reoxygenation, and inhibited invasiveness induced by hypoxic PCA EVs.

titre: Compliance to exercise-oncology guidelines in prostate cancer survivors and associations with psychological distress, unmet supportive care needs, and quality of life.
resume_court: The purpose of this study was to determine prevalence of Australian prostate cancer survivors meeting contemporary exercise-oncology guidelines and identify associations with distress, unmet supportive care needs, and quality of life. Total Supportive Care Needs and International Prostate Cancer Symptom scores were higher in inactive than insufficiently and sufficiently active men (p?<?0.05).

titre: CRISPR/Cas9-mediated gene knockout of NANOG and NANOGP8 decreases the malignant potential of prostate cancer cells.
resume_court: NANOG expression in prostate cancer is highly correlated with cancer stem cell characteristics and resistance to androgen deprivation. These results indicate that NANOG and NANOGP8 proteins are expressed in prostate cancer cell lines, and NANOG and NANOGP8 equally contribute to the high malignant potential of prostate cancer.

titre: Effect of compound Chinese traditional medicine PC-SPES II in inhibiting proliferation of human prostate cancer cell LNCaP and on expressions of AR and PSA
resume_court: To investigate the effect of compound Chinese traditional medicine PC-SPES II I in inhibiting proliferation of human prostate cancer cell LNCaP based on the androgen receptor (AR) signaling pathway. The effect of PC-SPES II on LNCaP cell proliferation was detected by MTT assay. Besides, compared with 25 mg x L(-1) Bic, 480 mg x L(-1) PC-SPES II significantly reduced the cell secretion of PSA.

titre: State-of-the-art imaging of prostate cancer.
resume_court: Prostate cancer is the most common cancer in men. Multiparametric magnetic resonance imaging can be used for detection and localization of prostate cancer and to evaluate for disease recurrence. Recent advancements in ultrasound, multiparametric magnetic resonance imaging, and scintigraphic imaging have the potential to change the way prostate cancer is diagnosed and managed.

titre: Genome-wide detection of allelic genetic variation to predict advanced-stage prostate cancer after radical prostatectomy using an exome SNP chip.
resume_court: Genetic variations among patients with prostate cancer (PCa) who underwent radical prostatectomies were evaluated to predict advanced stage above T3 using an exome single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) chip array. The exome array analysis indicated that 5 SNPs (rs6804162, rs8055236, rs56335308, rs6104, and rs12618769) were significant for predicting T3 stage after RP in patients with PCa.

titre: Hydroxamic Acid and Benzoic Acid-Based STAT3 Inhibitors Suppress Human Glioma and Breast Cancer Phenotypes In Vitro and In Vivo.
resume_court: STAT3 offers an attractive target for cancer therapy, but small-molecule inhibitors with appealing pharmacologic properties have been elusive. Both inhibitors blocked STAT3 DNA-binding activity in vitro and in human glioma, breast, and prostate cancer cells and in v-Src-transformed murine fibroblasts. Cancer Res; 76(3); 652-63. ©2015 AACR.
