titre: Assessing the clinical benefit of a nomogram to predict specimen-confined disease at radical prostatectomy in patients with high-risk prostate cancer: An external validation.
resume_court: To investigate the SCD model?s performance, the previously reported regression coefficients of the SCD nomogram were applied. Finally, decision curve analysis (DCA) to assess the clinical value of the SCD nomogram was performed. Nevertheless, in the absence of superior tools, the SCD nomogram represents a useful clinical decision aid.

titre: Which, when and why? Rational use of tissue-based molecular testing in localized prostate cancer.
resume_court: An increased molecular understanding of localized prostate cancer and the improved ability for molecular testing of pathologic tissue has led to the development of multiple clinical assays. A review of the currently available data suggests clinical scenarios for which each of these tests may have the greatest utility.

titre: Investigation of cancer mortality inequalities between rural and urban areas in South Korea.
resume_court: Little is known about rural-urban cancer disparities, particularly in South Korea, and this study is to identify cancer-specific mortality inequalities between the rural and urban areas of the country. For the first time ever, significant rural-urban disparity patterns in cancer mortality rates in South Korea have been identified in this paper.

titre: Direct dynamic measurement of intracellular and extracellular lactate in small-volume cell suspensions with (13)C hyperpolarised NMR.
resume_court: Hyperpolarised (HP) (13)C NMR allows enzymatic activity to be probed in real time in live biological systems. The increased conversion of pyruvate to lactate in cancer cells has been well studied with HP (13)C NMR. We deduced a lactate export rate of 0.3 s(-1) and observed a decrease in lactate transport on addition of the lactate transport inhibitor a-cyano-4-hydroxycinnamic acid.

titre: Refractory hypocalcaemia complicating metastatic prostatic carcinoma.
resume_court: A 72-year-old man with a background of ischaemic heart disease was referred to the accident and emergency department with a 1-week history of worsening dyspnoea and lethargy. Laboratory investigations confirmed severe hypocalcaemia, significant vitamin D deficiency and relative hypoparathyroidism. Severe hypocalcaemia persisted despite treatment and he succumbed after 60 days of hospitalisation.

titre: Trends in Prostate-specific Antigen Screening, Prostate Biopsies, Urology Visits, and Prostate Cancer Treatments From 2000 to 2012.
resume_court: To determine whether the rates of prostate-specific antigen (PSA) screening, related biopsies and subsequent prostate cancer utilization decreased between 2000 and 2012 in a large, managed care organization. However, the number of elevated PSA tests remained largely unchanged in all groups except in men aged =75 years (45% decrease).

titre: Sector analysis provides additional spatial information on the permanent prostate brachytherapy learning curve.
resume_court: To evaluate the permanent prostate brachytherapy (PPB) learning curve using postimplant multisector dosimetric analysis and to assess the correlation between sector -specific dosimetry and patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs). Dose to posterior midgland sectors correlated with rectal D0.1cc dose but not bowel PROMs. Furthermore, sector analysis correlated with urinary PROMs and rectal dose.

titre: PEP Talk: Prostate Education Program, "Cutting Through the Uncertainty of Prostate Cancer for Black Men Using Decision Support Instruments in Barbershops".
resume_court: The objective of this study was to investigate the effectiveness of using decision support instruments (DSI) to assist African-American (AA) men in making a prostate cancer (CaP) screening decision. Participants' degree of certainty in their decision-making process with regard to CaP screening increased following the culturally tailored DSI (p?<?.001).

titre: Assessment of the anticancer mechanism of ferulic acid via cell cycle and apoptotic pathways in human prostate cancer cell lines.
resume_court: Studies on genetic changes underlying prostate cancer and the possible signaling pathways are getting increased day by day, and new treatment methods are being searched for. Also, it was observed that FA suppressed the invasion in PC-3 and LNCaP cells. In conclusion, it has been observed that FA may lead to cell cycle arrest in PC-3 cells while it may cause apoptosis in LNCaP cells.

titre: PI3K therapy reprograms mitochondrial trafficking to fuel tumor cell invasion.
resume_court: Molecular therapies are hallmarks of "personalized" medicine, but how tumors adapt to these agents is not well-understood. Blocking oxidative phosphorylation prevents adaptive mitochondrial trafficking, impairs membrane dynamics, and suppresses tumor cell invasion.

titre: Sex hormone-dependent tRNA halves enhance cell proliferation in breast and prostate cancers.
resume_court: Sex hormones and their receptors play critical roles in the development and progression of the breast and prostate cancers. These results have unveiled a novel tRNA-engaged pathway in tumorigenesis of hormone-dependent cancers and implicate SHOT-RNAs as potential candidates for biomarkers and therapeutic targets.

titre: miR-93/miR-106b/miR-375-CIC-CRABP1: a novel regulatory axis in prostate cancer progression.
resume_court: Capicua (CIC) has been implicated in pathogenesis of spinocerebellar ataxia type-1 (SCA1) neurodegenerative disease and some types of cancer; however, the role of CIC in prostate cancer remains unknown. Here we show that CIC suppresses prostate cancer progression. Altogether, we suggest miR-93/miR-106b/miR-375-CIC-CRABP1 as a novel key regulatory axis in prostate cancer progression.

titre: Molecular Mechanism(s) Involved in 25-Hydroxyvitamin D's Antiproliferative Effects in CYP27B1-transfected LNCaP Cells.
resume_court: 1a,25(OH)2D has been shown to induce cell-cycle regulation, apoptosis and differentiation in prostate cancer cells. LNCaP cells were stably transfected with CYP27B. 1a,25(OH)2D3-treated LNCaP cells and 25(OH)D3-treated stably-transfected 1a-OHase LNCaP cells demonstrated an increased G1 phase accumulation and apoptosis, while 25(OH)D3 treatment had no effect in LNCaP cells.

titre: SPINK1 Promoter Variants Are Associated with Prostate Cancer Predisposing Alterations in Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia Patients.
resume_court: Several studies reported that patients with benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH) experienced a 10% increased incidence of prostate cancer (PCa) after the first 5 years of diagnosis. We investigated the association between single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) in the promoter of Serine Protease Inhibitor Kazal Type 1 (SPINK1) and the increased risk of BPH and PCa.

titre: Protective Effect of Leuprorelin on Radiation-induced Intestinal Toxicity.
resume_court: Patients with prostate cancer treated with neoadjuvant androgen ablation experience less radiation-induced intestinal toxicity, mostly due to a reduction of the volume of normal tissue exposed to high radiation doses. Leuprorelin protects mice from radiation-induced intestinal injury, likely through a reduction of tissue oxidative stress.

titre: Several Site-specific Cancers are Increased in the Volcanic Area in Sicily.
resume_court: Worldwide, thyroid cancer incidence is increased in many volcanic areas. Etna (where thyroid cancer is very high) with adjacent non-volcanic areas. Several, but not all types of cancers are significantly increased in the volcanic area of Sicily, indicating that an active volcanic environment may be a risk factor for cancer other than thyroid cancer.

titre: Contemporary Incidence and Mortality Rates of Neuroendocrine Prostate Cancer.
resume_court: The purpose of the study was to provide an update ever the incidence and mortality for neuroendocrine prostate cancer (NEPC) in the United States. AAIR of NEPC continues to rise in recent years (2004-2011:+6.8%/year, p>0.05). The AAIR of SCC is increasing with no change in the MR of NEPC over the past 20 years.

titre: Image-guided Intensity-modulated Radiotherapy for Prostate Cancer Employing Hypofractionation and Simultaneous Integrated Boost: Results of a Consecutive Case Series with Focus on Erectile Function.
resume_court: To report on clinical outcomes of prostate cancer patients treated with hypofractionated radiotherapy employing a simultaneous integrated boost strategy. Hypofractionation delivered with intensity-modulated radiotherapy and a simultaneous integrated boost approach proved to be a safe and effective treatment option for patients with prostate cancer.

titre: Plasma Tumor M2-Pyruvate Kinase Levels in Different Cancer Types.
resume_court: Tumor M2-pyruvate kinase (M2-PK) is up-regulated in proliferating tissues. The aim of the study was to determine and compare plasma tumor M2-PK levels in different cancer types. The different cancer types found in the study were: 60 colorectal, 43 breast, 8 lung, 5 prostatic, 4 ovarian and the remaining 19 cases were other uncommon tumor types.

titre: Measuring PI3K Activation: Clinicopathologic, Immunohistochemical, and RNA Expression Analysis in Prostate Cancer.
resume_court: Assessing the extent of PI3K pathway activity in cancer is vital to predicting sensitivity to PI3K-targeting drugs, but the best biomarker of PI3K pathway activity in archival tumor specimens is unclear. In addition, the PI3K activation score was compared with mRNA expression profiling data for a large subset of men.

titre: 3,3'-Diindolylmethane (DIM) and its ring-substituted halogenated analogs (ring-DIMs) induce differential mechanisms of survival and death in androgen-dependent and -independent prostate cancer cells.
resume_court: We recently reported that novel ring-substituted analogs of 3,3'-diindolylmethane (ring-DIMs) induce apoptosis and necrosis in androgen-dependent and -independent prostate cancer cells. The ring-DIMs induced ER stress and autophagy, but these processes were not necessary for ring-DIM-mediated cell death.

titre: Concurrent Diabetes Mellitus may Negatively Influence Clinical Progression and Response to Androgen Deprivation Therapy in Patients with Advanced Prostate Cancer.
resume_court: To determine if a concurrent diagnosis of diabetes mellitus is associated with worse outcomes in advanced prostate cancer (PC). With a median follow-up of 29?months, time to castration resistance did not differ significantly between patients with and without diabetes who underwent ADT. Further study is necessary to fully elucidate the effect of diabetes on PC outcomes.

titre: Malignancies in systemic lupus erythematosus: a 2015 update.
resume_court: Patients with systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) have altered incidences of certain malignancies as compared with the general population. This review summarizes the recent literature on risk of malignancy in SLE and proposed mechanisms for these altered susceptibilities. Recent data confirm previously reported altered malignancy rates in SLE.

titre: Predictive value of Cyclooxygenase-2 over expression for identifying prostate cancer from benign prostatic hyperplasia in prostate biopsy specimens.
resume_court: We studied Cox-2 immunohistochemical staining intensity both in prostatic biopsy and surgical samples of patients with prostate cancer to determine if it might provide prognostic information for the decision of re-biopsy indication. The rate of agreement in Cox-2 receptor staining of biopsy samples and radical prostatectomy samples was 76% in same patients (p=0,54).

titre: Do Prostate Cancer Patients With Markedly Elevated PSA Benefit From Radiation Therapy?: A Population-based Study.
resume_court: Patients with clinically localized prostate cancer but markedly elevated prostate-specific antigen (PSA) are often treated with systemic agents alone. Four-year cancer-specific survival was 93.8% in those receiving radiation treatments versus 76.5% in those who did not receive any local treatment. Survival was significantly improved by radiotherapy for localized prostate cancer.

titre: The genomic evolution of human prostate cancer.
resume_court: Prostate cancers are highly prevalent in the developed world, with inheritable risk contributing appreciably to tumour development. We evaluate recurrent prostate-specific mutations prior to discussing the mutational events that are shared both in prostate cancer and across multiple cancer types. From these data, we construct a putative overview of the genomic evolution of human prostate cancer.

titre: Expression and significance of S100P, CD147, and OCT4 in different prostate cancer tissue TNM stages.
resume_court: The aim of this project was to investigate the expression and significance of S100P, CD147, and OCT4 in prostate cancer tissue at different TNM stages. The positive rate of S100P in stage V was 0, which was significantly lower than in stages I (37.50%) and II (35.71%) (P ? In contrast, the positive rate of OCT4 in patients with distant metastasis was 92%.

titre: Analysis of postoperative PSA changes after ultrasound-guided permanent [125I] seed implantation for the treatment of prostate cancer.
resume_court: The aim of this study was to explore postoperative changes in prostate-specific antigen (PSA) levels and risk factors that influence the clinical effects of ultrasound-guided permanent [(125)I] seed implantation in the treatment of prostate cancer. During treatment, age was shown to be a risk factor for group A (P = 0.0027, P < 0.01).

titre: Gonorrhea and Prostate Cancer Incidence: An Updated Meta-Analysis of 21 Epidemiologic Studies.
resume_court: The association between gonorrhea and prostate cancer risk has been investigated widely, but the results remain inconsistent and contradictory. The association between gonorrhea and prostate cancer was stronger in African American males (OR 1.32, 95% CI 1.06-1.65) than in Whites (OR 1.05, 95% CI 0.90-1.21).

titre: Pelvic lymph node displacement in high-risk prostate cancer patients treated with image guided intensity modulated radiation therapy with 2 independent target volumes.
resume_court: To evaluate the displacement of the pelvic lymph node (PLN) target when using cone beam computed tomography (CBCT) for localization of the prostate in patients treated with simultaneous integrated boost. GM was found in 7 of the 600 CBCT slices, all in different patients. Four GMs occurred on the middle slice and 3 on the superior slice.

titre: Gradient maintenance: A new algorithm for fast online replanning.
resume_court: Clinical use of online adaptive replanning has been hampered by the unpractically long time required to delineate volumes based on the image of the day. The PCRs are used in the daily optimization objective function. The newly proposed GM replanning algorithm, requiring only target delineation, not full delineation of OARs, substantially increased planning speed for online adaptive replanning.

titre: Evaluation of the 'Prostate Interdisciplinary Communication and Mapping Algorithm for Biopsy and Pathology' (PIC-MABP).
resume_court: This study evaluated the accuracy of the PIC-MABP system. Cancer lesions, which were found suspicious on mpMRI, were assigned to the according PIC-MABP sectors by a radiologist. PIC-MABP seems to be a reliable system to communicate the location of mpMRI findings >0.5 cc between different disciplines and can be a useful guidance for cognitive mpMRI/TRUS fusion biopsy.

titre: Epigenetically altered miR-193b targets cyclin D1 in prostate cancer.
resume_court: Micro-RNAs (miRNA) are important regulators of gene expression and often differentially expressed in cancer and other diseases. In 22Rv1 PC cells with low endogenous miR-193b expression, the overexpression of miR-193b reduced CCND1 mRNA levels and cyclin D1 protein levels. Taken together, our data demonstrate that miR-193b targets cyclin D1 in prostate cancer.

titre: Development of a Standardized Set of Patient-centered Outcomes for Advanced Prostate Cancer: An International Effort for a Unified Approach.
resume_court: There are no universally monitored outcomes relevant to men with advanced prostate cancer, making it challenging to compare health outcomes between populations. Measures gathered from clinical data include measures of disease control. Our international group has recommended a standardized set of patient-centered outcomes to be followed during routine care for all men with advanced prostate cancer.

titre: Male Urinary Incontinence: Associated Risk Factors and Electromyography Biofeedback Results in Quality of Life.
resume_court: The session durations were 30 minutes (118 work/rest cycles of pelvic muscles). These results support that male UI is significantly associated with urological and abdominal surgery (including radical prostatectomy) and that EMG-BFB for PFMT improves incontinence and quality of life (social embarrassment, limiting behavior, and psychosocial impact) in the three types of UI on an overall basis.

titre: Pathologic Outcomes in Men with Low-risk Prostate Cancer Who Are Potential Candidates for Contemporary, Active Surveillance Protocols.
resume_court: The purpose of this study was to determine whether contemporary active surveillance (AS) protocols could sufficiently discriminate significant from indolent tumors in men with low-risk prostate cancer. A total of 82.0% of the patients met the inclusion criteria of at least one protocol, and 18% did not meet any criteria of published AS protocols.

titre: Lower Levels of Human MOB3B Are Associated with Prostate Cancer Susceptibility and Aggressive Clinicopathological Characteristics.
resume_court: Mps one binder (MOB) proteins are integral components of signaling pathways that control important cellular processes, such as mitotic exit, centrosome duplication, apoptosis, and cell proliferation. In conclusion, low levels of hMOB3B are closely associated with aggressive clinicopathologic features in patients with PCa. Our results suggest that hMOB3B may act as a tumor suppressor in human PCa.

titre: MiR-29a suppresses prostate cell proliferation and induces apoptosis via KDM5B protein regulation.
resume_court: Small regulatory RNAs, known as microRNAs, regulate gene expression at the post-transcriptional level; such as protein translation inhibition or mRNA degradation. KDM5B was highly expressed in PCa cancer cells. This study revealed that the aberrant expression of miR-29a in PCa cells regulated KDM5B expression levels associated with tumor dissemination.

titre: PTEN genomic deletion defines favorable prognostic biomarkers in localized prostate cancer: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
resume_court: PTEN (10q23.3) is a negative regulator of the phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase (PIK3)/Akt survival pathway and a tumor suppressor frequently deleted in prostate cancer. Further studies should be conducted in order to investigate the effect of PTEN genomic deletion on clinical outcomes in different histological types of prostate cancer or its function in castration-resistant prostate cancer.

titre: Prostate calculi can higher urinary retention probability and worsen uncomfortable feeling after prostate biopsy but not predict cancer.
resume_court: To investigate whether prostatic calculi might influence the urinary retention (UR) probability, the quality of life (QOL) and the positive rate of cancer after prostate biopsy in middle-aged and old male with PSA higher than normal. 2012 to Sept. To these people, prostate volumes (PV) were recorded by TRUS and prostatic calculi were defined as present or absent.

titre: Transrectal real-time elastography-guided transperineal prostate biopsy as an improved tool for prostate cancer diagnosis.
resume_court: The aim of this study is to determine the utility of transrectal real-time elastography (TRTE)-guided prostate biopsies in patients subjected to transrectal ultrasound (TRUS)-guided transperineal prostate biopsies. The overall detection rate for PCa was 49.1% (53/108). TRTE-guided targeted biopsy could be used as a complement to significantly improve the detection rate for PCa in clinical setting.

titre: Effectiveness of inhibitor rapamycin, saracatinib, linsitinib and JNJ-38877605 against human prostate cancer cells.
resume_court: To investigate the effect of different concentrations of inhibitors rapamycin, saracatinib, linsitinib and JNJ-38877605 on PC-3 cells with CCK-8 assay, respectively. The proliferation of PC-3 cells was examined by CCK-8. Rapamycin treatment at low concentration can inhibit the proliferation of PC-3 cells, while saracatinib, linsitinib and JNJ-38877605 do not inhibit PC-3 cell proliferation.

titre: Androgen-deprivation therapy and bone loss in prostate cancer patients: a clinical review.
resume_court: Androgen-deprivation therapy (ADT) has become a standard of care in the management of advanced prostate cancer or as an adjunct therapy. However, ADT is associated with a well-known deleterious effect on bone health, resulting in a decrease in bone-mass density (BMD) and increased risk for fracture. Therefore, adequate screening, prevention and treatment of BMD loss is paramount.

titre: Incidence of Second Primary Malignancies Following Colorectal Cancer: A Distinct Pattern of Occurrence Between Colon and Rectal Cancers and Association of Co-Morbidity with Second Primary Malignancies in a Population-Based Cohort of 98,876 Patients in Taiwan.
resume_court: The purpose of this study is to determine the features of second primary malignancies (SPMs) among patients with prior colorectal cancer (CRC) using a nationwide population-based dataset.Patients with CRC newly diagnosed between 1996 and 2011, and >1 year of follow-up were recruited from the Taiwan National Health Insurance database. The median duration of follow-up was 4.03 years.

titre: eNOS Genetic Polymorphisms and Cancer Risk: A Meta-Analysis and a Case-Control Study of Breast Cancer.
resume_court: The association between endothelial nitric oxide synthase (eNOS) polymorphisms (intron 4a/b, -786T>C and 894G>T) and cancer risk remains elusive. In consistent with our meta-analysis results, a case-control study in Chinese Han population showed significant associations of eNOS -786T>C and 894G>T polymorphisms with the increased risk of breast cancer.

titre: Likert score 3 prostate lesions: Association between whole-lesion ADC metrics and pathologic findings at MRI/ultrasound fusion targeted biopsy.
resume_court: To assess associations between whole-lesion apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) metrics and pathologic findings of Likert score 3 prostate lesions at MRI/ultrasound fusion targeted biopsy. Biopsy history, whole-lesion mean ADC, whole-lesion ADC10-25 , and whole-lesion ADC25-50 were each significantly associated with tumor or GS?>?6 tumor at fusion biopsy (P?=?0.047).

titre: Novel Role for p110ß PI 3-Kinase in Male Fertility through Regulation of Androgen Receptor Activity in Sertoli Cells.
resume_court: The organismal roles of the ubiquitously expressed class I PI3K isoform p110ß remain largely unknown. We now report that p110ß also plays a germ cell-extrinsic role in the Sertoli cells (SCs) that support the developing sperm, with p110ß inactivation dampening expression of the SC-specific Androgen Receptor (AR) target gene Rhox5, a homeobox gene critical for spermatogenesis.

titre: No reduced risk of overall, colorectal, lung, breast, and prostate cancer with metformin therapy in diabetic patients: database analyses from Germany and the UK.
resume_court: In observational studies, a lower cancer risk was reported for patients with diabetes using metformin. Throughout all analyses, hazard ratios were close to the null for comparisons of metformin use with sulfonylurea and insulin use. This study provides evidence that metformin has no protective effect on the incidence of cancer in persons with diabetes.

titre: Improved Confidence Intervals for the Youden Index.
resume_court: The Youden Index is a summary measurement of the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve for the accuracy of a diagnostic test with ordinal or continuous endpoints. The bootstrap confidence interval based on the adjusted proportion estimate was shown to have satisfactory performance among the existing confidence intervals, including the parametric interval via the delta method.

titre: Cold Atmospheric Plasma Treatment Induces Anti-Proliferative Effects in Prostate Cancer Cells by Redox and Apoptotic Signaling Pathways.
resume_court: Vitamin C could not counteract the CAP induced effects on cell growth. Therefore, it is important to understand the mode of CAP related cell death and clarify and optimize CAP as cancer therapy. We assume that the general intracellular redox homeostasis, especially the levels of cellular GSH and peroxidases such as peroxiredoxins affect the outcome of the CAP treatment.

titre: Copper-64 Labeled Macrobicyclic Sarcophagine Coupled to a GRP Receptor Antagonist Shows Great Promise for PET Imaging of Prostate Cancer.
resume_court: The gastrin-releasing peptide receptor (GRPr) is an important molecular target for the visualization and therapy of tumors and can be targeted with radiolabeled bombesin derivatives. Both Cu(II) conjugates have high affinity for GRPr (IC50: natCu-LE1, 1.4±0.1 nM; natCu-LE2, 3.8±0.6 nM). This study demonstrates the high affinity of the MeCOSar-PEGx-bombesin conjugates to GRPr.

titre: Online adaptation and verification of VMAT.
resume_court: This work presents a method for fast volumetric modulated arc therapy (VMAT) adaptation in response to interfraction anatomical variations. The impact of the adaptation on the plan parameters (QA) was assessed by comparison with prediction intervals (PI) derived from a statistical model of the typical variation of these parameters in a population of VMAT prostate plans (n = 63).

titre: The negative impact of tobacco smoking on survival after prostate cancer diagnosis.
resume_court: Tobacco smoking has been found to increase prostate cancer (PCa) mortality in cohorts of healthy men, but its effects on prognosis of men with PCa are still unclear. This study investigated the role of smoking on long-term survival after PCa diagnosis. Current smoking at PCa diagnosis negatively impacted PCa-specific, long-term survival, regardless of Gleason score.

titre: Tadalafil modulates aromatase activity and androgen receptor expression in a human osteoblastic cell in vitro model.
resume_court: Cells were tested for viability upon TAD exposure, which increased cell proliferation. Exposure of cells to increasing concentrations of TAD (10(-8)-10(-7) M) decreased PDE5 mRNA and protein expression. Also, TAD inhibited ARO mRNA and protein expression leading to an increase in testosterone levels in the supernatants.

titre: First Report: Robot-Assisted Total Pelvic Exenteration for Locally Advanced Prostate Cancer.
resume_court: Pelvic exenteration is used in the treatment of several pelvic cancers, including those of the rectum, uterus, and bladder. We report the first case of robotic pelvic exenteration for the treatment of symptomatic prostate cancer involving the rectum and bladder. Thus pelvic exenteration is a feasible alternative for highly symptomatic prostate cancer involving adjacent pelvic organs.

titre: Sulforaphane inhibits invasion by phosphorylating ERK1/2 to regulate E-cadherin and CD44v6 in human prostate cancer DU145 cells.
resume_court: Advanced prostate cancer has highly invasive potential, which may lead to metastasis associated with poor prognosis. The results showed that SFN inhibited invasion and we characterized the underlying mechanisms in human DU145 prostate cancer cells. Therefore, SFN is a prospective therapeutic agent that may be used to prevent invasion in prostate cancer.

titre: Clinical intervals and diagnostic characteristics in a cohort of prostate cancer patients in Spain: a multicentre observational study.
resume_court: Little is known about the healthcare process for patients with prostate cancer, mainly because hospital-based data are not routinely published. 470 patients with prostate cancer were included. The median interval between first consultation and diagnosis was 89 days (IQR:123.5) with no statistically significant variability between centres.

titre: High pressure balloon dilation for vesicourethral anastomotic strictures after radical prostatectomy.
resume_court: Vesicourethral anastomotic stricture (VAS) is a rare but serious complication following radical prostatectomy (RP), and various types of managements for VAS have been proposed. We investigated the efficacy of transurethral balloon dilation in the management of VAS after RP. High pressure balloon dilation is a highly effective and minimally invasive procedure for treating VAS.

titre: The emergence of extracellular vesicles in urology: fertility, cancer, biomarkers and targeted pharmacotherapy.
resume_court: Extracellular vesicles (EV) are small membrane-bound vesicles enriched in a selective repertoire of mRNA, miRNA, proteins and cell surface receptors from parental cells and are actively involved in the transmission of inter and intracellular signals. In this report, we review the current literature on EV in the setting of genitourinary fertility and malignancy.

titre: Synthetic siRNAs effectively target cystein protease 12 and a-actinin transcripts in Trichomonas vaginalis.
resume_court: The flagellated protozoan Trichomonas vaginalis (T. vaginalis) causes trichomoniasis, a reproductive tract infection, in humans. This finding is helpful in that it demonstrates the potential of using extrinsically induced RNAi in studies on molecular biology of T. vaginalis such as those aiming at identifying new drug targets.

titre: Metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer: targeting the mechanisms of resistance to abiraterone acetate and enzalutamide.
resume_court: Persistent androgen receptor (AR) axis is a functionally important pathway for prostate cancer cells and it is currently regarded as a critical therapeutic target. Understanding how the AR is activated may have clinical implications in defining which patients will respond to existing therapeutic agents and provide a proof for making novel strategies.

titre: What kind of prostate cancers do we miss on multiparametric magnetic resonance imaging?
resume_court: To analyse the characteristics of prostate cancers (PrCa) detected following negative multiparametric magnetic resonance imaging (mpMRI). • The majority of missed prostate cancers were low grade and organ-confined. • In patients with a negative mpMRI a biopsy may be postponed. • mpMRI had a negative predictive value of 95.4 % for high-grade prostate cancer.

titre: Determination of Skeletal Tumor Burden on 18F-Fluoride PET/CT.
resume_court: The purpose of this study was to define a method to assess skeletal tumor burden with 18F-labeled sodium fluoride PET/CT (18F-fluoride PET/CT) and evaluate the reproducibility of these measurements. The mean normal SUVmax for all 543 sites was 5.32±0.99. Using an SUVmax threshold of 10 excludes nearly all normal bone activity from volumetric calculations.

titre: HOXA1 enhances the cell proliferation, invasion and metastasis of prostate cancer cells.
resume_court: HOXA1, a member of the HOX gene family, has been implicated in tumor progression. Our in vitro data showed that knockdown of HOXA1 attenuated the growth, invasion and migration of prostate cancer DU-145 and PC-3 cells. Our in vivo data revealed that knockdown of HOXA1 suppressed the growth and metastasis of prostate cancer cells.

titre: The Use of Unidirectional Barbed Suture for Urethrovesical Anastomosis during Robot-Assisted Radical Prostatectomy: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Efficacy and Safety.
resume_court: Unidirectional barbed suture (UBS) has been widely used for surgery in recent years, especially for urethrovesical anastomosis (UVA) during robot-assisted radical prostatectomy (RARP). Three RCTs and six observational studies including 786 cases were identified. No significant difference was found in PL rate, EBL, LOC, or continence rates at 4-6 weeks, 3 months and 6-12 months after surgery.

titre: A Review on Chemical Profile of Coumarins and their Therapeutic Role in the Treatment of Cancer.
resume_court: Coumarin class of organic compounds consists of 1,2-benzopyrone ring system as a basic parent scaffold. Among these properties, the present review article compiles the detailed research findings of coumarins as anti-cancer agents. Furthermore, a detailed overview of various clinical trials conducted on coumarin class of compounds tested for various types of malignancies has been described.

titre: Fluorescence-guided surgery of human prostate cancer experimental bone metastasis in nude mice using anti-CEA DyLight 650 for tumor illumination.
resume_court: The present report demonstrates efficacy of fluorescence-guided surgery (FGS) to resect and prevent recurrence of experimental skeletal metastasis in a nude-mouse model of human prostate cancer. Thirteen mice underwent FGS and 12 mice underwent bright-light surgery (BLS). The extent of residual tumor after BLS was 13-fold greater than after FGS (p?<?0.001).

titre: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Three Gene Variants Association with Risk of Prostate Cancer: An Update.
resume_court: Prostate cancer (PCa) is one of the most commonly diagnosed male malignancies. For XPC 939A/C polymorphism, no significant association was found with PCa risk in the whole population (P > .05). For MDM2 -309T/G mutation, the G allele was not as­sociated with the increased risk of PCa in total population and subgroup analysis by ethnicity as well.

titre: Laparoscopic Radical Prostatectomy after Previous Transurethral Resection of the Prostate in Clinical T1a and T1b Prostate Cancer: A Matched-Pair Analysis.
resume_court: To analyze and compare surgical, oncological and functional outcomes of laparoscopic radi­cal prostatectomy (LRP) in patients with and without previous transurethral resection of the prostate (TURP). TURP had been performed previously in 35 of these patients (TURP group). LRP is feasible but challenging after TURP.

titre: Tissue Chromogranin A Expression during Prostate Cancer Progression: Prediction of Chemosensitivity.
resume_court: Immunostaining of CgA was performed using prostate biopsy samples obtained at the initial PCa diagnosis, during androgen deprivation therapy, at the time of CRPC diagnosis, and after 2 cycles of DEC therapy. The mean percentage of CgA-positive PCa cells increased in a stepwise manner until CRPC development and then significantly decreased after DEC therapy.

titre: High Frequency of JCV DNA Detection in Prostate Cancer Tissues.
resume_court: Prostate cancer (PC) represents the most frequently diagnosed cancer in men. Our data demonstrated the presence of JCV DNA in 14/24 (58.3%) cancerous prostatic tissue specimens, confirming the results obtained in a previous study, in which JCV has been defined as common inhabitant of the prostate, and opening the discussion about its potential role in PC.

titre: Bone-targeted agents in the treatment of lung cancer.
resume_court: These data have led to the development of drugs to prevent osteoclast-mediated bone breakdown, such as zoledronic acid and denosumab, which are now licensed for use in patients with bone metastases from solid tumours. In addition, denosumab improved survival in patients with lung cancer compared with zoledronic acid. These agents require further evaluation in patients with lung cancer.

titre: High plasma levels of oxidatively modified low-density lipoproteins are associated with the suppressed expression of immunomodulatory molecules in patients with hematological malignancies.
resume_court: Dyslipidemia is a common feature in immunosuppressed patients, such as kidney and bone marrow transplantation recipients and patients with breast, prostate or gynecological carcinoma or acute lymphoblastic leukemia. There are, however, no reports on the association between the serum oxLDL levels and the expression of important immunomodulatory molecules in patients with hematological disorders.

titre: Vav3 oncogene is upregulated and a poor prognostic factor in breast cancer patients.
resume_court: The Vav3 oncogene is overexpressed and has a significant role in the tumorigenesis of prostate cancer and glioblastoma. The multivariate Cox analysis revealed that Vav3 was a prognostic factor of survival. Overall, Vav3 was overexpressed in human breast cancer cells and this correlated with a shorter survival time, indicating that Vav3 is a biomarker of a poor prognosis for breast cancer patients.

titre: Renal-type clear cell carcinoma of the prostate: A case report.
resume_court: Renal-type clear cell carcinoma of the prostate is a rare and novel tumor that has only been identified in recent years. Clear cell carcinoma was identified throughout the prostate, with surrounding regions of ordinary-type prostatic adenocarcinoma (Gleason score, 4+4). It was therefore concluded that the tumor represented a primary renal-type clear cell carcinoma that had arisen in the prostate.

titre: Lactotransferrin expression is downregulated and affects the mitogen-activated protein kinase pathway in gastric cancer.
resume_court: Gastric cancer (GC) is the second leading cause of cancer-associated mortality worldwide. However, the mechanism of the tumor suppressor function of LTF in GC remains unclear. The present study demonstrates that LTF expression is downregulated in GC tissues and that LTF may serve an important role in the dysregulation of the MAPK signaling pathway.

titre: Rana catesbeiana ribonuclease induces cell apoptosis via the caspase-9/-3 signaling pathway in human glioblastoma DBTRG, GBM8901 and GBM8401 cell lines.
resume_court: Human glioblastoma multiforme is one of the most aggressive malignant brain tumor types, and the mean survival time of patients with a brain tumor is <2 years when traditional therapies are administered. In addition, frog Onconase has been applied as a treatment in clinical trials. Overall, the present study indicates that RC-RNase may be a potential agent for the treatment of human glioblastoma.

titre: Amplification and protein expression of androgen receptor gene in prostate cancer cells: Fluorescence in situ hybridization analysis.
resume_court: Prostate cancer (PCa) is the most frequently diagnosed non-skin cancer and the second highest cause of cancer-related mortality in adult males worldwide. This study demonstrated an influential role of AR in tumor growth and progression even after the deprivation of androgen, as well as showing the potential contribution of AR amplification to AR activation even in the relative absence of androgen.

titre: Prostate cancer incorrectly diagnosed as a rectal tumor: A case report.
resume_court: Colorectal cancer is the third most commonly diagnosed type of cancer in the world. The common metastatic locations of prostate cancer are the bone, lung and liver. In the present study we report a case of solitary metastasis of a prostate adenocarcinoma with the prostatic capsule intact, which initially led to an incorrect diagnosis.

titre: Overexpression of cofilin 1 in prostate cancer and the corresponding clinical implications.
resume_court: Cofilin 1 (CFL1) is a cytoskeletal protein and overexpression of the protein has been associated with aggressiveness in certain types of malignancies. The results of the present study indicated that CFL1 may specifically predict the development of PCa, and that the expression of CFL1 in the mesenchyme may be closely associated with the development of lymph node metastasis.

titre: Relative mRNA expression of prostate-derived E-twenty-six factor and E-twenty-six variant 4 transcription factors, and of uridine phosphorylase-1 and thymidine phosphorylase enzymes, in benign and malignant prostatic tissue.
resume_court: Prostate cancer is the most frequent urological tumor, and the second most common cancer diagnosed in men. PDEF and ETV4 exhibited a significantly higher relative expression level in the tumor samples compared with their benign counterparts. The relative expression of TP was moderately and significantly correlated with the expression of ETV4 in the benign tissues.

titre: Enhanced central memory cluster of differentiation 8(+) and tumor antigen-specific T cells in prostate cancer patients receiving repeated in situ adenovirus-mediated suicide gene therapy.
resume_court: The high relapse rate of prostate cancer following radical prostatectomy is clinically problematic, and various neoadjuvant therapies aimed at reducing the rate have been examined. However, details of the immune responses following this form of gene therapy remain unclear. In three patients, tumor antigen-specific T cells were clearly increased following HSV-tk + GCV treatment.

titre: Evaluation of the European Society of Urogenital Radiology (ESUR) PI-RADS scoring system for assessment of extra-prostatic extension in prostatic carcinoma.
resume_court: To evaluate extra-prostatic extension (EPE) comparing PI-RADS to non-standardized reporting. Area under ROC curve for EPE using PI-RADS was 0.62 and optimal sensitivity/specificity was achieved with PI-RADS score = 3. Diagnostic accuracy was better among experienced radiologists without PI-RADS (p=0.005); however, there was no difference in accuracy by reader experience using PI-RADS (p=0.24).

titre: Discovery of ODM-201, a new-generation androgen receptor inhibitor targeting resistance mechanisms to androgen signaling-directed prostate cancer therapies.
resume_court: Activation of androgen receptor (AR) is crucial for prostate cancer growth. We report here the pharmacological profile of ODM-201, a novel AR inhibitor that showed significant antitumor activity and a favorable safety profile in phase 1/2 studies in men with CRPC. ODM-201 is currently in a phase 3 trial in CRPC.

titre: Androgen Deprivation Therapy for Prostate Cancer and the Risk of Venous Thromboembolism.
resume_court: Few observational studies have investigated the association between androgen deprivation therapy (ADT) and venous thromboembolism (VTE) in patients with prostate cancer (PCa). In the secondary analysis, most types of ADT were associated with a high risk of VTE. The use of ADT was associated with an overall 84% increased risk of VTE, with the risk elevated for most ADT types.

titre: Immediate versus delayed radical prostatectomy: updated outcomes following active surveillance of prostate cancer.
resume_court: Biopsy progression on active surveillance (AS) for prostate cancer (PCa) often reflects failure of the initial biopsy to detect cancer present at enrollment. Of 157 ASE men who underwent delayed RP after AS, 54 were upgraded to Gleason 3+4 before surgery. We found that men who underwent delayed surgery had similar outcomes to men who underwent immediate prostatectomy.

titre: Risk and timing of biochemical recurrence in pT3aN0/Nx prostate cancer with positive surgical margin - A multicenter study.
resume_court: Positive surgical margins (PSM) after radical prostatectomy have been shown to be associated with impaired outcome. In multivariate analysis, Gleason score was the only independent prognostic factor (p<0.001) for BCR. In pT3aN0/NxR1 patients with no adjuvant/neoadjuvant treatment, Gleason Score permits independent prediction of the risk for BCR.

titre: Genetic determinants of telomere length and risk of common cancers: a Mendelian randomization study.
resume_court: Epidemiological studies have reported inconsistent associations between telomere length (TL) and risk for various cancers. The weighted TL SNP score was not associated with other cancer types or subtypes. Under Mendelian randomization assumptions, our finding suggests that longer TL increases lung adenocarcinoma risk.

titre: Plakophilin 1-deficient cells upregulate SPOCK1: implications for prostate cancer progression.
resume_court: Plakophilin (PKP) 1 is frequently downregulated in prostate cancer and therefore may play a tumor-suppressive role. Moreover, we analyzed the gene expression profile of the PKP1-deficient BPH-1 cells. Our findings support the hypothesis that PKP1 may have a tumor-suppressive function and suggest an important role of SPOCK1 in prostate tumor progression.

titre: Men's use of networks to manage communication tensions related to a potential diagnosis of prostate cancer.
resume_court: This study used relational dialectics theory to explore the communication tensions experienced by men who were on a prostate biopsy waiting list and how they managed these tensions using their communication networks. These tensions were predominantly managed by vacillation.

titre: Concurrent Hepsin overexpression and adenomatous polyposis coli deletion causes invasive prostate carcinoma in mice.
resume_court: A clinical need to better categorize patients with prostate cancer exists. However, no metastasis occurrs in this model. To determine whether the overexpression of the prostate oncogene Hepsin could cause prostate cancer progression, we crossed a prostate-specific Hepsin overexpression model to a prostate-specific Apc-deletion model and classified the observed phenotype.

titre: Immuno-based detection of extracellular vesicles in urine as diagnostic marker for prostate cancer.
resume_court: Extracellular vesicles (including the subclass exosomes) secreted by cells contain specific proteins and RNA that could be of interest in determining new markers. Exosomes can be measured in medium from 37 cell lines and in urine. This TR-FIA enabled us to measure exosomes with high sensitivity directly from urine and cell medium.

titre: Incidence of cancer in Nairobi, Kenya (2004-2008).
resume_court: Cancer incidence rates are presented for the Nairobi Cancer Registry, a population-based cancer registry (PBCR) covering the population of the capital city of Kenya (3.2 million inhabitants in 2009). Prostate cancer was the most common cancer in men (ASR 40.6 per 100,000) while breast cancer was the most common among women (ASR 51.7 per 100,000).

titre: Cobalt Zinc Ferrite Nanoparticles as a Potential Magnetic Resonance Imaging Agent: An In vitro Study.
resume_court: Magnetic Nanoparticles (MNP) have been used for contrast enhancement in Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI). The results show that bare and coated MNPs are suitable as T2-weighted MR imaging contrast agents. Also, the obtained r2/r1 values (59.3 and 50) for bare and coated MNPs were in agreement with the results of other previous relevant works.

titre: Ability of community-based prostate cancer screening to target an appropriate and underserved population.
resume_court: Screening is not universally beneficial due to over- and under-diagnosis, and false positives that beget additional testing and associated adverse events and expense. Based on these data, mass community-based prostate cancer screening does not appear to identify and screen at-risk men. Future efforts at mass screening should more carefully target men most likely to benefit.

titre: Ablative therapy for people with localised prostate cancer: a systematic review and economic evaluation.
resume_court: For people with localised prostate cancer, active treatments are effective but have significant side effects. For primary therapy, the ablative therapies were cryotherapy, HIFU, brachytherapy and other ablative therapies. For salvage therapy, the ablative therapies were cryotherapy and HIFU.

titre: Giant Cardiac Cavernous Hemangioma.
resume_court: We report the case of an asymptomatic giant cardiac cavernous hemangioma in a 71-year-old man. The intracardiac mass was discovered incidentally during surveillance for his prostate cancer; however, the patient initially declined intervention. We discuss the diagnostic workup, treatment, and characteristics of this rare cardiac tumor.

titre: Upregulated expression of polycomb protein Ring1 contributes to poor prognosis and accelerated proliferation in human hepatocellular carcinoma.
resume_court: Ring finger protein 1 (Ring1) have recently been reported to be closely related to aggressive tumor features in multiple cancer types, including prostate cancer, non-small-cell lung cancer, and bladder cancer. On the basis of these results, we proposed that the expression of Ring1 protein may be a novel indicator of HCC prognosis.

titre: Long-term outcomes of intensity-modulated radiation therapy combined with neoadjuvant androgen deprivation therapy under an early salvage policy for patients with T3-T4N0M0 prostate cancer.
resume_court: Adjuvant ADT (A-ADT) was not provided for any patient following the completion of IMRT. The median PSA value at the initiation of S-ADT was 5.7 ng/ml. High-dose IMRT, combined with NA-ADT for LAPC, was associated with favorable long-term disease-specific and overall survival outcomes, despite non-provision of A-ADT under the early S-ADT provision policy.

titre: Primary care characteristics and stage of cancer at diagnosis using data from the national cancer registration service, quality outcomes framework and general practice information.
resume_court: Survival from cancer is worse in England than in some European countries. We assessed whether primary care characteristics were associated with later stage cancer at diagnosis (stages 3/4 versus 1/2) for female breast, lung, colorectal and prostate cancer. No organisational characteristics were associated with prostate cancer stage.

titre: Inflammation and Cancer: What Can We Therapeutically Expect from Checkpoint Inhibitors?
resume_court: Programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) is a cell surface protein which is mainly expressed on immune cells as well as on cancer cells and functions as a co-stimulatory molecule for T lymphocytes. It is capable of inducing apoptosis in T-cells via PD-1 which leads to impaired cytokine production and loss of cytotoxicity of activated T-cells. This represents a possible escape mechanism for cancer cells.

titre: Relevance to family practice of English-language guidelines on breast, colorectal and prostate cancer: a review.
resume_court: GPs regard cancer guidelines as useful yet criticise their limited applicability to the primary care setting. To determine the extent to which English-language breast, colorectal and prostate cancer guidelines contain recommendations that are relevant to GPs and to find out which of the GPs' roles in cancer care the recommendations refer to.

titre: Hybrid compounds with two redox centres: modular synthesis of chalcogen-containing lapachones and studies on their antitumor activity.
resume_court: Chalcogen-containing ß-lapachone derivatives were synthesized using a straightforward methodology and evaluated against several cancer cell lines (leukaemia, human colon carcinoma, prostate, human metastatic prostate, ovarian, central nervous system and breast), showing, in some cases, IC50 values below 1 µM.

titre: Impact of a Genomic Classifier of Metastatic Risk on Postprostatectomy Treatment Recommendations by Radiation Oncologists and Urologists.
resume_court: To evaluate how a genomic classifier (GC) that predicts the risk of metastasis after prostatectomy would impact adjuvant treatment recommendations made by radiation oncologists and urologists. The GC test results altered 35% and 45% of treatment recommendations made by radiation oncologists and urologists, respectively.

titre: Added Value of Multiparametric Ultrasonography in Magnetic Resonance Imaging and Ultrasonography Fusion-guided Biopsy of the Prostate in Patients With Suspicion for Prostate Cancer.
resume_court: The mpUS score was also investigated for PCa and PI-RADS score prediction. MRI-US fusion-guided PBX detects more clinically significant PCa compared with conventional TRUS. The mpUS score correlates with PI-RADS in PCa prediction.

titre: Pre-diagnosis employment status and financial circumstances predict cancer-related financial stress and strain among breast and prostate cancer survivors.
resume_court: Cancer may have a significant financial impact on patients, but the characteristics that predispose patients to cancer-related financial hardship are poorly understood. Of the respondents, 48 % reported cancer-related financial stress and 32 % cancer-related financial strain. Cancer-related financial stress and strain are common.

titre: Disabled homolog 2 is required for migration and invasion of prostate cancer cells.
resume_court: Disabled homolog 2 (DAB2) is frequently deleted or epigenetically silenced in many human cancer cells. DAB2 overexpression or knockdown effects in LNCaP and PC3 cell lines were verified to address the biological functions of DAB2 in PCa progression and metastasis. Therefore, DAB2 may play an important role in PCa progression and metastasis.

titre: AKT and cytosolic phospholipase A2a form a positive loop in prostate cancer cells.
resume_court: Conversely, an induction of cPLA2a expression led to an increase in pAKT levels in PTEN-mutated or deleted prostate cancer cells, while silencing of cPLA2a expression or pharmacological blocking cPLA2a action decreased pAKT levels. The stimulatory effect of arachidonic acid on pAKT levels was lessened by inhibiting the production of arachidonic acid metabolites.

titre: Acute toxicity of robotic ultrahypofractionated radiotherapy CyberKnifeTM in prostate cancer patients.
resume_court: Our purpose was to evaluate the toxicity of CyberKnifeTM based fractionated stereotactic radiotherapy (FSRT) in prostate cancer patients. In 25% and 3% of patients, respectively, grade 1 and 2 acute gastrointestinal toxicity was observed. In 16% and 1% of patients late GU toxicity in grade 1 and 2, respectively, was presented.

titre: The STAT3 Inhibitor Galiellalactone Effectively Reduces Tumor Growth and Metastatic Spread in an Orthotopic Xenograft Mouse Model of Prostate Cancer.
resume_court: Signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3) is known to be involved in the progression of prostate cancer (PCa) and is a key factor in drug resistance and tumor immunoescape. We studied the effects of the STAT3 inhibitor galiellalactone (GL) on tumor growth and metastatic spread in vitro and in vivo. GL has potential for treating advanced metastatic PCa.

titre: Clinical endocrinological evaluation of the gonadal axis (testosterone, LH and FSH) in prostate cancer patients switched from a GnRH antagonist to a LHRH agonist.
resume_court: To investigate the levels of testosterone, luteinizing hormone (LH), follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH), and prostate-specific antigen (PSA) in prostate cancer patients before and after the switch from degarelix to leuprolide treatments. LH and FSH levels were significantly higher 1 month after administration compared with 2 or 3 months after degarelix administration.

titre: Cellular Plasticity in Prostate Cancer Bone Metastasis.
resume_court: Purpose. The aim of this review was to appraise the clinical evidence for the role of cellular plasticity in prostate cancer (PC) bone metastasis. Clinical findings support the role of cellular plasticity in PC bone metastasis and suggest that epithelial and mesenchymal states cannot be taken in isolation when targeting PC bone metastasis.

titre: In vitro and in vivo model systems used in prostate cancer research.
resume_court: New incidence of prostate cancer is a major public health issue in the Western world, and has been rising in other areas of the globe in recent years. The introduction of the genetically engineered mouse in biomedical research has allowed the development of murine models that allow for the investigation of tumorigenic and metastatic processes.

titre: Lifestyle Factors in Cancer Survivorship: Where We Are and Where We Are Headed.
resume_court: Advances in early detection and curative therapies have led to an increased number of cancer survivors over the last twenty years. There is increasing evidence linking these factors to the risk of developing cancer and likely cancer-related outcomes. Our article aims to review the evidence that links lifestyle factors to cancer outcomes and provides clinical recommendations for cancer survivors.

titre: Down-regulation of prostate stem cell antigen (PSCA) by Slug promotes metastasis in nasopharyngeal carcinoma.
resume_court: Distant metastasis and local recurrence are still the major causes for failure of treatment in patients with nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC), making it urgent to further elicit the molecular mechanisms of NPC metastasis. PSCA may be a potential diagnostic marker and therapeutic target for patients with NPC.

titre: Proteomic Comparison and MRM-Based Comparative Analysis of Metabolites Reveal Metabolic Shift in Human Prostate Cancer Cell Lines.
resume_court: One of the major challenges in prostate cancer therapy remains the development of effective treatments for castration-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC), as the underlying mechanisms for its progression remain elusive. However, due to the heterogeneous expression and activity status of AR in PCa cells, it remains a challenge to investigate the links between AR status and metabolic alterations.

titre: Changes in Estrogen Receptor ERß (ESR2) Expression without Changes in the Estradiol Levels in the Prostate of Aging Rats.
resume_court: Although the prostate is androgen-dependent, it is also influenced by estrogens, which act via the estrogen receptors ERa and ERß. Therefore, we aimed to investigate ERß expression in the prostatic lobes of aging Wistar rats (3 to 24 months). This paper is a pioneering study that reveals focal ERß reduction in the prostate of aging rats and indicates a potential disorder in the ERß pathway.

titre: Association of MnSOD AA Genotype with the Progression of Prostate Cancer.
resume_court: To investigate whether manganese superoxide dismutase (MnSOD) genetic polymorphism is associated with the clinical significance of prostate cancer. MnSOD polymorphism is strongly associated with the clinical significance of prostate cancer in men older than 69 years, but not in men younger than 70 years suggesting that oxidative stress may be involved in the progression of the disease.

titre: Resistance Exercise Reduces Body Fat and Insulin During Androgen-Deprivation Therapy for Prostate Cancer.
resume_court: To determine whether exercise could reduce biomarkers of cancer progression in prostate cancer survivors (PCSs) on androgen-deprivation therapy (ADT). Loss of total and trunk fat each mediated the relationship between groups and one-year change in insulin (p < 0.05). Resistance and impact exercise may reduce body fat among PCSs undergoing ADT, in turn exerting an insulin-lowering effect.

titre: A Qualitative Study Exploring the Perceptions of Sedentary Behavior in Prostate Cancer Survivors Receiving Androgen-Deprivation Therapy.
resume_court: To describe and understand the perceptions of sedentary behavior (SED) and the interests and preferences for a SED intervention of men on androgen-deprivation therapy (ADT) within a two-phase (formative and intervention research) feasibility study. 27 men on ADT. Oncology nurses may serve as a motivational factor in encouraging men on ADT to reduce SED.

titre: Living with the Elekta Compact: Limitations and ways around them.
resume_court: Elekta AB, Sweden has recently propagated the Elekta Compact--a low-cost, small-footprint, single energy (6MV), linear accelerator, in India. For prostate cancers, we have developed a forward-planned IMRT protocol to routinely deliver 76-80 Gy to the prostate, with margins, while conforming to the same rectal dose-volume constraints as in inverse IMRT.

titre: An NKX3.1 binding site polymorphism in the l-plastin promoter leads to differential gene expression in human prostate cancer.
resume_court: The L-plastin gene is involved in the invasion and metastasis of prostate cancer. In this study, we identified a single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) at position -1,687 in the L-plastin promoter by genotype sequencing. SNP -1,687 (T/T) led to an increase in the affinity of NKX3.1 for L-plastin promoter, resulted in lower levels of L-plastin RNA and protein expression.

titre: Fruit and vegetables and cancer risk: a review of southern European studies.
resume_court: High intakes of fruit and vegetables may reduce the risk of cancer at several sites. A reduced risk of cancers of the digestive tract and larynx was found for high consumption of citrus fruit. In conclusion, data from our series of case-control studies suggested a favourable role of high intakes of fruit and vegetables in the risk of many common cancers, particularly of the digestive tract.

titre: Clinical Characteristics and Outcome of Gleason Score 10 Prostate Cancer on Core Biopsy Treated by External Radiotherapy and Hormone Therapy.
resume_court: To evaluate the clinical characteristics and outcomes of patients with Gleason score 10 prostate cancer treated by external radiotherapy and hormone therapy. Six patients' pre-treatment prostate-specific antigen (PSA) levels were lower than 20.0 µg/L and three patients' pre-treatment PSA levels were higher than 70.0 µg/L. Three cases were assessed as N1 stage.

titre: Applying precision medicine to the active surveillance of prostate cancer.
resume_court: The recent introduction of a variety of molecular tests will potentially reshape the care of patients with prostate cancer. There is a wide range of possible applications of these tests to different clinical scenarios in patient populations managed with active surveillance. Cancer 2015;121:3435-43. © 2015 American Cancer Society.

titre: Prostate Cancer in the Arab World: A View From the Inside.
resume_court: The rates of prostate cancer vary by more than 50-fold across different international populations. Several factors come into play to explain this difference. In conclusion, the study of prostate cancer in the Arab world represents a challenge with the currently available cancer care systems and the increase in the burden of the disease.

titre: Efficacy and safety of second-line agents for treatment of metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer progressing after docetaxel. A systematic review and meta-analysis.
resume_court: We performed a systematic review of the literature to assess the efficacy and the safety of second-line agents targeting metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) that has progressed after docetaxel. The primary outcome of the review was overall survival. Agents targeting the androgen axis (enzalutamide, abiraterone, orteronel) significantly prolonged rPFS, compared to placebo.

titre: What is the correct staging and treatment strategy for locally advanced prostate cancer extending to the bladder?
resume_court: In locally advanced prostate cancer with bladder invasion, frequently encountered problems such as bleeding, urinary retention, hydronephrosis, and pain create distress for the patients. Survival times of these patients can range between 5 and 8 years. The treatment outcomes of locally advanced prostate cancer into the bladder are currently debatable.

titre: Influence of antiplatelet-anticoagulant drugs on the need of blood components transfusion after vesical transurethral resection.
resume_court: The effect of the antithrombotic preventive therapy on haemorrhage keeps uncertain. ASA100mg did not influence the transfusion's requirements in VTUR due to BTCC. Tumour stage and higher grade have a greater influence in transfusion's requirements than concomitant AP/AC treatment.

titre: Extraintestinal gastrointestinal stromal tumor of undetermined origin: Is the mass resection a wrong approach? A case report and review of the literature.
resume_court: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST) was first defined by Mazur et al. in 1983. GIST is evaluated among tumoral lesions that can be acquired or congenital. Herein, we present a case with EGIST in a 65-year-old male patient located in intrapelvic and retroprostatic area which had no connection with gastrointestinal system as assessed by radiological methods and we discuss its treatment.

titre: ECRG4 expression in normal rat tissues: expression study and literature review.
resume_court: The Esophageal Cancer Related Gene 4 (ECRG4) is a highly conserved tumour suppressor gene encoding various peptides (augurin, C?16 augurin, ecilin, argilin, C?16 argilin) which can be processed and secreted. In the present work, we examined ECRG4 expression and location in a wide range of rat organs and reviewed the available literature.

titre: The role of periostin in neoplastic processes.
resume_court: Periostin, also called osteoblast-specific factor 2 (OSF-2), is a multifunctional glycoprotein that belongs to the group of matricellular proteins. Many groups have recently reported on periostin's key role in tumor progression, which suggests that periostin can be considered a potential therapeutic target.

titre: Strategies to Circumvent Testosterone Surge and Disease Flare in Advanced Prostate Cancer: Emerging Treatment Paradigms.
resume_court: The testosterone surge and disease flare is a feared complication from initiation of gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) agonist treatment in advanced prostate adenocarcinoma. This article reports on 3 cases of impending oncologic emergencies in advanced prostate adenocarcinoma treated promptly with degarelix and ketoconazole without any disease flare related to testosterone surge.

titre: BRCA 1/2 gene mutation and gastrointestinal stromal tumours: a potential association.
resume_court: Mutations of the BRCA1/2 genes have been described in association with a number of malignancies including cancers of the breast, ovary, prostate and stomach, but have never been described in relation to gastrointestinal stromal tumours (GIST). We describe a patient with a BRCA2 8642del3insC mutation who developed prostate cancer, breast cancer and GIST.

titre: What benefit could be derived from on-line adaptive prostate radiotherapy using rectal diameter as a predictor of motion?
resume_court: This study investigated a relationship between rectum diameter and prostate motion during treatment with a view to reducing planning target volume (PTV) margins for an adaptive protocol. A threshold rectum diameter was used to model the impact of an adaptive PTV margin on rectum and bladder dose. An average dose escalation of 4.2 Gy may be possible with an adaptive prostate radiotherapy protocol.

titre: Role of Surgery in locally advanced prostate cancer.
resume_court: A significant proportion of patients present with locally advanced prostate cancer with inherent higher risk of local recurrence and systemic relapse after initial treatment. RP as a part of multi-modality treatment (with neo-adjuvant hormonal therapy (HT) and with adjuvant or salvage radiation therapy (RT)/HT) can provide long term overall and cancer specific survival.

titre: Efficacy and Safety of Abiraterone Acetate in Elderly (75 Years or Older) Chemotherapy Naïve Patients with Metastatic Castration Resistant Prostate Cancer.
resume_court: Metastatic castration resistant prostate cancer primarily affects elderly men. Specific adverse events with abiraterone-prednisone were similar between the age subgroups. Abiraterone acetate demonstrated clinical benefit and was well tolerated in elderly and younger men with chemotherapy naïve, metastatic castration resistant prostate cancer.

titre: Platelet-Synthesized Testosterone in Men with Prostate Cancer Induces Androgen Receptor Signaling.
resume_court: Platelets have been long postulated to play a critical role in the pathogenesis of prostate cancer, although relatively little is known regarding the precise mechanisms involved. In this study, we examined the role of platelet-derived androgens in vitro using platelets from men with CRPC, men with high-risk prostate cancer, and healthy male donors.

titre: Decrease in Prostate Cancer Testing Following the US Preventive Services Task Force (USPSTF) Recommendations.
resume_court: To assess changes of prostate-specific antigen (PSA) testing following recent US Preventive Services Task Force (USPSTF) prostate cancer screening recommendations using 2005 to 2013 National Health Interview Survey data. For white and black men, the PSA testing percentages were highest in 2008 and decreased significantly in 2013.

titre: Regional hyperthermia and moderately dose-escalated salvage radiotherapy for recurrent prostate cancer. Protocol of a phase II trial.
resume_court: Current studies on salvage radiotherapy (sRT) investigate timing, dose-escalation and anti-hormonal treatment (ADT) for recurrent prostate cancer. If the phase II study is found to be safe and feasible, a multicenter phase III study is planned to test whether the addition of regional hyperthermia to dose-intensified sRT improves biochemical control.

titre: Recepteur d'origine nantais (RON), more than a kinase: Role in castrate-resistant prostate cancer.
resume_court: Prostate cancer (PCA) is the second leading cause of cancer-related deaths in men in the United States. Reactivation of androgen receptor (AR) signaling partly contributes to the emergence of CRPC. We further discuss activation of RON as an alternate mechanism in the development of CRPC and available therapeutic approaches for clinical management of CRPC by combined inhibition of RON and AR.

titre: Functional Characterization of a WWP1/Tiul1 Tumor-derived Mutant Reveals a Paradigm of Its Constitutive Activation in Human Cancer.
resume_court: Although E3 ubiquitin ligases are deemed to play key roles in normal cell function and homeostasis, whether their alterations contribute to cancer pathogenesis remains unclear. Upon binding of WWP1 to Smad7, this functional interplay is disabled, switching its monoubiquitination activity toward a polyubiquitination activity, thereby driving its own degradation and that of TßRI as well.

titre: Hypofractionated Helical Tomotherapy for Older Aged Patients With Prostate Cancer: Preliminary Results of a Phase I-II Trial.
resume_court: In our center, the feasibility and related acute toxicities of hypofractionated helical tomotherapy have been evaluated in older aged patients with prostate cancer . In the cohort 1, the incidences of grade 1 and 2 genitourinary and gastrointestinal toxicities were 45.5% and 45.4%, respectively, and without grade 3 and 4 toxicities.

titre: Reconsideration of the clinical and histopathological significance of angiogenesis in prostate cancer: Usefulness and limitations of microvessel density measurement.
resume_court: Angiogenesis plays important roles in tumor growth and cancer cell dissemination in almost all cancers. Therefore, knowledge regarding the pathological significance of microvessel density - based on understanding of the advantages and limitations of microvessel density determination methods - is important.

titre: Trends in mortality after cancer diagnosis: A nationwide cohort study over 45 years of follow-up in Sweden by country of birth.
resume_court: Survival has steadily improved for major cancer types in most parts of the world. Among them 33,595 men and 34,174 women were born abroad. At the time of diagnosis, patients born abroad were on average 4 years younger than patients born in Sweden.

titre: Prostatic adenocarcinoma presenting as isolated inguinal lymphadenopathy.
resume_court: Prostatic adenocarcinoma (CaP) is the most common cancer in males and approximately 50% of patients have metastases at presentation, most commonly spreading to the bones and regional lymph nodes. As inguinal lymphadenopathy may also be due to other causes, biopsy is useful and meticulous clinical examination is a must in these patients.

titre: The polyphosphate-factor XII pathway drives coagulation in prostate cancer-associated thrombosis.
resume_court: Cancer is a leading cause of thrombosis. Targeting polyphosphate or factor XII conferred resistance to prostate cancer-driven thrombosis in mice, without increasing bleeding. The data illustrate a critical role for polyphosphate/factor XII-triggered coagulation in prostate cancer-associated thrombosis with implications for anticoagulation without therapy-associated bleeding in malignancies.

titre: Metastatic Prostate Cancer and the Bone: Significance and Therapeutic Options.
resume_court: Skeletal involvement is common in metastatic prostate cancer (PCa) and is associated with skeletal-related events (SREs). The literature pertaining to bone metastases in prostate cancer (PCa) was reviewed, and the current understanding of the biology of PCa having spread to bone and the agents available to reduce skeletal complications was discussed.

titre: PSMA expression is highly homogenous in primary prostate cancer.
resume_court: Prostate-specific membrane antigen (PSMA) is a suggested target for antibody-based therapy of prostate cancer, potentially involved in the regulation of cell migration. PSMA expression was analyzed by immunohistochemistry. High homogeneity of PSMA expression is a strong argument for a high utility of PSMA as a prostate cancer drug target.

titre: Progesterone receptor modulates ERa action in breast cancer.

titre: The Impact of Magnetic Resonance Imaging on Prediction of Extraprostatic Extension and Prostatectomy Outcome in Patients with Low-, Intermediate- and High-Risk Prostate Cancer: Try to Find a Standard.

titre: The AhR Ligand, TCDD, Regulates Androgen Receptor Activity Differently in Androgen-Sensitive versus Castration-Resistant Human Prostate Cancer Cells.

titre: Synergistic anticancer activity of biologicals from green and black tea on DU 145 human prostate cancer cells.

titre: Trial watch: Naked and vectored DNA-based anticancer vaccines.

titre: Improving clinical benefit for prostate cancer patients through the combination of androgen deprivation and immunotherapy.
resume_court: Androgen-deprivation therapy (ADT) induces prostate cancer immunogenic modulation (IM) by reducing human tumor cell expression of anti-apoptotic genes thus facilitating increased sensitivity to immune-mediated lysis. Through its stimulation of IM, ADT has been shown to synergize with active immunotherapy thereby significantly improving overall survival in a mouse model of prostate cancer.

titre: Clinical examination of cases of radiation proctitis after intensity-modulated radiation therapy for prostate cancer
resume_court: In our series of 366 patients who received intensity-modulated radiation therapy (IMRT) for prostate cancer, radiation proctitis developed in 24 patients. We examined the endoscopic evidence and clinical characteristics of radiation proctitis in these patients. The incidence of radiation proctitis decreased, and the clinical and endoscopic findings showed only mild radiation proctitis after IMRT.

titre: Three linked nomograms for predicting biochemical failure in prostate cancer treated with radiotherapy plus androgen deprivation therapy.
resume_court: Nomograms were established to predict biochemical recurrence (BCR) after radiotherapy (RT) with a low weight of the characteristic variables of RT and androgen deprivation therapy (ADT). Univariate association between predictor variables and BCR was assessed by the log-rank test, and three linked nomograms were created for multivariate prognosis of BCR-free survival.

titre: DWI-associated entire-tumor histogram analysis for the differentiation of low-grade prostate cancer from intermediate-high-grade prostate cancer.
resume_court: To investigate diagnostic efficiency of DWI using entire-tumor histogram analysis in differentiating the low-grade (LG) prostate cancer (PCa) from intermediate-high-grade (HG) PCa in comparison with conventional ROI-based measurement. DWI-associated histogram analysis had higher specificity, Az, Youden index, and LR+ for differentiation of PCa Gleason grade than ROI-based approach.

titre: Matriptase activation and shedding through PDGF-D-mediated extracellular acidosis.
resume_court: Activation of ß-platelet-derived growth factor receptor (ß-PDGFR) is associated with prostate cancer (PCa) progression and recurrence after prostatectomy. Taken together, these novel findings reveal a new paradigm in matriptase activation involving PDGF-D-specific signal transduction leading to extracellular acidosis.

titre: Overexpression of FGF9 in prostate epithelial cells augments reactive stroma formation and promotes prostate cancer progression.
resume_court: Bone metastasis is the major cause of morbidity and mortality of prostate cancer (PCa). However, the mechanism by which overexpression of FGF9 promotes PCa progression and metastasis is still unknown. Collectively, our data demonstrated that overexpressing FGF9 in PCa cells augmented the formation of reactive stroma and promoted PCa initiation and progression.

titre: Inferring interaction type in gene regulatory networks using co-expression data.
resume_court: Knowledge of interaction types in biological networks is important for understanding the functional organization of the cell. This paper describes a novel algorithm, "Signing of Regulatory Networks" (SIREN), which can infer the regulatory type of interactions in a known gene regulatory network (GRN) given corresponding genome-wide gene expression data.

titre: Treatment Sequences and Pharmacy Costs of 2 New Therapies for Metastatic Castration-Resistant Prostate Cancer.
resume_court: The approval of new therapies for metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC), including the oral agents abiraterone acetate and enzalutamide, has altered the standard of care for patients with mCRPC. The concomitant use of corticosteroids was observed in patients receiving first-line abiraterone acetate and in patients receiving first-line enzalutamide in all 3 data sets.

titre: A pilot study to investigate if New Zealand men with prostate cancer benefit from a Mediterranean-style diet.
resume_court: Carcinoma of the prostate is the most commonly diagnosed malignancy and the third leading cause of mortality in New Zealand men, making it a significant health issue in this country. Prostate-specific antigen, C-reactive protein and DNA damage were evaluated at baseline and after three months of following the diet. These findings warrant further exploration in a longer trial, with a larger cohort.

titre: A reproducible approach to high-throughput biological data acquisition and integration.
resume_court: Modern biological research requires rapid, complex, and reproducible integration of multiple experimental results generated both internally and externally (e.g., from public repositories). To enable efficient and reproducible integration of diverse experimental results, we developed a novel approach for standardized acquisition and analysis of high-throughput and heterogeneous biological data.

titre: Prostate-specific antigen kinetics after primary stereotactic body radiation therapy using CyberKnife for localized prostate cancer.

The median PSA nadir was 0.31 ng/mL after a median 23 months. Also, SBRT using CyberKnife leads to long-term favorable BCR-free survival in localized prostate cancer.

titre: Predictors of survival in prostate cancer patients with bone metastasis and extremely high prostate-specific antigen levels.

titre: Efficacy and safety of degarelix in Korean patients with prostate cancer requiring androgen deprivation therapy: Open-label multicenter phase III study.
