Combined, these findings reveal unexpected DNA-PKcs functions, identify DNA-PKcs as a potent driver of tumor progression and metastases, and nominate DNA-PKcs as a therapeutic target for advanced malignancies.

titre: A Phase I/II Study for Analytic Validation of 89Zr-J591 ImmunoPET as a Molecular Imaging Agent for Metastatic Prostate Cancer.
resume_court: Standard imaging for assessing osseous metastases in advanced prostate cancer remains focused on altered bone metabolism and is inadequate for diagnostic, prognostic, or predictive purposes. Compared with all CIMs combined, (89)Zr-J591 detected an additional 99 osseous sites. The overall accuracy of (89)Zr-J591 was 95.2% (20 of 21) for osseous lesions and 60% (15 of 25) for soft-tissue lesions.

titre: Multiparametric magnetic resonance imaging for prostate cancer: A review and update for urologists.
resume_court: During the last decade, the role of mpMRI has been expanded in prostate cancer detection, staging, and targeting or guiding prostate biopsy. More specifically, we state the role of mpMRI in prostate biopsy, active surveillance, high-risk prostate cancer, and detection of recurrence after radical prostatectomy.

titre: Expression levels of heat shock protein 27 and cellular FLICE-like inhibitory protein in prostate cancer correlate with Gleason score sum and pathologic stage.
resume_court: Heat shock protein (HSP) 27 protects the cell by controlling apoptosis and immune reactions, and c-FLIP (cellular-FLICE inhibitory protein) inhibits apoptosis by inhibiting caspase-8 activity. HSP27 expression was correlated with GSS and prostate cancer stage. HSP27 expression had a higher correlation with prostate cancer stage and GSS than c-FLIP expression did.

titre: Tumor microenvironment promotes dicarboxylic acid carrier-mediated transport of succinate to fuel prostate cancer mitochondria.
resume_court: Prostate cancer cells reprogram their metabolism, so that they support their elevated oxidative phosphorylation and promote a cancer friendly microenvironment. The mechanism of succinate influx via NaDC3 in metastatic prostate cancer cells could yield a novel target for anti-cancer therapy and has the potential to be used for imaging-based diagnostics to detect non-glycolytic tumors.

titre: AGE/RAGE/Akt pathway contributes to prostate cancer cell proliferation by promoting Rb phosphorylation and degradation.
resume_court: Metabolomic research has revealed that metabolites play an important role in prostate cancer development and progression. We report, for the first time, that AGE-RAGE interaction enhances prostate cancer cell proliferation by phosphorylation of Rb via the PI3K/Akt signaling pathway.

titre: Tumor-suppressive microRNA-497 targets IKKß to regulate NF-?B signaling pathway in human prostate cancer cells.
resume_court: Prostate cancer (PCa) is one of the most prevalent malignant tumors, PCa-related death is mainly due to the high probability of metastasis. Subsequently, IKKß is confi rmed as a target of miR-497. Taken together, our results show evidence that miR-497 may function as a tumor suppressor genes by regulating IKK-ß in PCa, and may provide a strategy for blocking PCa metastasis.

titre: Integrin-linked kinase regulates senescence in an Rb-dependent manner in cancer cell lines.
resume_court: Anti-integrin-linked kinase (ILK) therapies result in aberrant mitosis including altered mitotic spindle organization, centrosome declustering and mitotic arrest. Taken together these results indicate that the oncosuppressive outcomes for anti-ILK therapies in vitro, depend on the expression of the tumor suppressor Rb, a known G1 checkpoint and senescence regulator.

titre: Chemically Modified Plastic Tube for High Volume Removal and Collection of Circulating Tumor Cells.
resume_court: In this preliminary effort, we use a commercially available and chemically modified tube to selectively capture circulating tumor cells (CTCs) from the blood stream by immobilizing human anti-EpCAM antibodies on the tube's interior surface. We also found that the percentage of cells captured was dependent on the tube's length and also the number of cancer cells present.

titre: Poly (A) Binding Protein Cytoplasmic 1 Is a Novel Co-Regulator of the Androgen Receptor.
resume_court: The androgen receptor (AR) is a member of the steroid receptor superfamily that regulates gene expression in a ligand-dependent manner. The NTD of the AR plays a key role in AR transactivation including androgen-independent activation of the AR in castration-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC) cells. 50-250 of the AR.

titre: Selective Low-Dose Spinal Anesthesia for Transrectal Prostate Biopsy: A Prospective and Randomized Study.
resume_court: To evaluate the use of spinal anesthesia by reducing anesthetic agent dose to provide better analgesia with minimal side effects without sacrificing the outpatient setting for prostate biopsy. Patient procedure-related overall satisfaction level was significantly higher in the spinal anesthesia group (P?<?0.001). In the spinal anesthesia group, no motor blockade was observed.

titre: Botulinum toxin (OnabotulinumtoxinA) in the male non-neurogenic overactive bladder: clinical and quality of life outcomes.
resume_court: To assess the efficacy of OnabotulinumtoxinA (BTXA) injections in men with drug-refractory non-neurogenic overactive bladder (NNOAB). A total of 43 men received BTXA injections for NNOAB from 2004 to 2012. Amongst men who have had prior prostate surgery, men who have had RP experience a greater benefit than men who have had TURP, both in regards to PGI-I score and pad use.

titre: Predictors of prostate cancer specific mortality after radical prostatectomy: 10 year oncologic outcomes from the Victorian Radical Prostatectomy Registry.
resume_court: To identify the ability of multiple variables to predict prostate cancer specific mortality (PCSM) in a whole of population series of all radical prostatectomies (RP) performed in Victoria, Australia. A total of 2154 open RPs were performed in Victoria between July 1995 and December 2000. Gleason score 3 + 4 = 7 was not at this time a significant predictor of PCSM (P = 0.08, SHR 1.84).

titre: The state of TRUS biopsy sepsis: readmissions to Victorian hospitals with TRUS biopsy-related infection over 5 years.
resume_court: To describe the incidence, morbidity and mortality of men who developed infectious complications requiring hospital admission following TRUS prostate biopsy in Victoria, Australia. Infection following TRUS biopsy was associated with a readmission rate for infection of 1 in 57 biopsies, an excess of 3 686 bed days required over 5 years with a cost of $1 256 AUD per day.

titre: Identification of Two Novel HOXB13 Germline Mutations in Portuguese Prostate Cancer Patients.
resume_court: The HOXB13 germline variant G84E (rs138213197) was recently described in men of European descent, with the highest prevalence in Northern Europe. Three different patients were found to carry in their germline DNA two novel missense variants, which were not identified in 132 control subjects. No somatic mutations were found.

titre: Individualized Comprehensive Lifestyle Intervention in Patients Undergoing Chemotherapy with Curative or Palliative Intent: Who Participates?
resume_court: Knowledge about determinants of participation in lifestyle interventions in cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy, particularly with palliative intent, remains poor. 100 of 161 invited patients participated. In multivariate logistic regression analyses, age (Odds Ratio 0.94, 95% Confidence Interval 0.91, 0.97) and smoking (0.42, 0.18, 0.99) were negatively associated with participation.

titre: EphA2 Is a Potential Player of Malignant Cellular Behavior in Non-Metastatic Renal Cell Carcinoma Cells but Not in Metastatic Renal Cell Carcinoma Cells.
resume_court: To investigate the role of EphA2 in malignant cellular behavior in renal cell carcinoma (RCC) cells and whether FAK/RhoA signaling can act as downstream effectors of EphA2 on RCC cells. In non-metastatic RCC cells, FAK siRNA significantly attenuated the invasiveness, resistance to apoptosis, as well as expression of membrane-bound RhoA protein without changing protein expression of EphA2.

titre: Metabolic response of prostate cancer to nicotinamide phophoribosyltransferase inhibition in a hyperpolarized MR/PET compatible bioreactor.
resume_court: Metabolic shifts in disease are of great interest for the development of novel therapeutics. This study demonstrated the feasibility of a MR/PET compatible bioreactor approach to efficiently explore cell and tissue metabolism, the understanding of which is critical for developing clinically translatable biomarkers of disease states and responses to therapeutics.

titre: Prediction of individual genetic risk to prostate cancer using a polygenic score.
resume_court: Polygenic risk scores comprising established susceptibility variants have shown to be informative classifiers for several complex diseases including prostate cancer. Initially 65 established prostate cancer susceptibility variants were selected. Inclusion of additional genetic variants from established prostate cancer susceptibility regions improves disease prediction.

titre: Establishment of primary patient-derived xenografts of palliative TURP specimens to study castrate-resistant prostate cancer.
resume_court: Fresh patient specimens of castrate-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC) are invaluable for studying tumor heterogeneity and responses to current treatments. To improve the efficiency and quality of PDXs, we investigated the factors that determine the initial engraftment of patient tissues derived from TURP specimens. Primary PDXs of CRPC can be established from TURP specimens with modest success.

titre: Laparoscopic radical prostatectomy after previous transurethral resection of prostate using a catheter balloon inflated in prostatic urethra: Oncological and functional outcomes from a matched pair analysis.
resume_court: To explore the surgical, oncological and functional outcomes of laparoscopic radical prostatectomy in patients who have undergone transurethral resection of the prostate, using a catheter balloon inflated in the prostatic urethra. Two matched pairs analyses were carried out to identify the 12 (control A) and 13 (control B) surgery-naïve patients.

titre: Drug Delivery Nanocarriers from a Fully Degradable PEG-Conjugated Polyester with a Reduction-Responsive Backbone.
resume_court: The remarkably high intracellular concentration of reducing agents is an excellent endogenous stimulus for designing nanocarriers programmed for intracellular delivery of therapeutic agents. The reduction-responsive nanoparticles display a fast payload release rate in response to the intracellular reducing environment, which translates into superior anticancer activity towards PC-3 cells.

titre: Identification of pathologically favorable disease in intermediate-risk prostate cancer patients: Implications for active surveillance candidates selection.
resume_court: Intermediate-risk prostate cancer (PCa) represents a heterogeneous disease, where a non-negligible proportion of patients harbor favorable pathologic characteristics and are potentially eligible for active surveillance (AS). Overall, 10.0% of all intermediate risk patients had favorable disease. One out of ten intermediate-risk patients harbors favorable disease at RP.

titre: PTEN loss and ERG protein expression are infrequent in prostatic ductal adenocarcinomas and concurrent acinar carcinomas.
resume_court: Prostatic ductal adenocarcinoma is an unusual and aggressive morphologic subtype of prostate cancer. A group of 34 stage and grade-matched pure acinar adenocarcinoma cases was studied as a control. Based on PTEN and ERG, ductal adenocarcinomas and their concurrent acinar carcinomas may be clonally related in some cases and show important molecular differences from pure acinar carcinoma.

titre: Testicular orphan nuclear receptor 4 is associated with the radio-sensitivity of prostate cancer.
resume_court: It is well known that a significant number of prostate cancers (PCa) showed different extents of radio-resistance and the tumor may recur after treatment. This study provides a novel approach to manipulate radio-sensitivity of PCa cells, and may bring a promoted therapeutic outcome of radiotherapy to battle PCa in future.

titre: The prevalence, severity, and correlates of psychological distress and impaired health-related quality of life following treatment for testicular cancer: a survivorship study.
resume_court: This study aimed to establish the prevalence, severity, and correlates of psychological distress and impaired generic health-related quality of life (HRQOL) in testicular cancer (TC) survivors. There is a need to identify TC survivors at risk of poorer outcomes and for interventions to target the areas of greatest impairment (i.e., psychological distress and mental HRQOL).

titre: Radium-223 in Bone-Metastatic Prostate Cancer: Current Data and Future Prospects.
resume_court: Ra-223 (radium-223) is an alpha particle-emitting radiopharmaceutical with targeted uptake in areas of osteoblastic lesions. The combination of targeted skeletal uptake, short tissue-penetration range, and high energy of alpha particles allows for targeted cell killing and a low toxicity profile. Adverse events were limited but included both gastrointestinal and hematologic effects.

titre: Active surveillance for prostate cancer: when to recommend delayed intervention.
resume_court: There are no agreed upon guidelines for placing patients on active surveillance (AS). Furthermore, published nomograms designed to predict indolent prostate cancer do not perform well when used to predict progression. Newer biomarkers have also not performed well to predict progression.

titre: Relapse of prostate cancer from the viewpoint of total gland volume kinetics theory.
resume_court: In many cases of prostate cancer, changes of prostate volume were measured very frequently after castration by means of transrectal ultrasound. Based upon these observations, a schematic analysis of prostate cancer relapse was shown.

titre: Prostate-specific antigen density predicts favorable pathology and biochemical recurrence in patients with intermediate-risk prostate cancer.
resume_court: This study was designed to identify clinical predictors of favorable pathology and biochemical recurrence (BCR) in patients with intermediate-risk prostate cancer (IRPCa). Favorable pathology was defined as Gleason score =6 and organ-confined cancer as detected by surgical pathology. Overall, 38 patients (18.7%) had favorable pathology after RARP.

titre: Optimal management of prostate cancer with lethal biology--state-of-the-art local therapy.
resume_court: Defining prostate cancer with lethal biology based upon clinical criteria is challenging. The optimal management of high-risk prostate cancer is not known as there are not prospective studies comparing surgery to radiation therapy (RT). Local therapy for high-risk disease does appear to be beneficial.

titre: Everolimus combined with gefitinib in patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer: Phase 1/2 results and signaling pathway implications.
resume_court: The effects of mammalian target of rapamycin (mTOR) inhibition are limited by feedback reactivation of receptor tyrosine kinase signaling in phosphatase and tensin homolog-null tumors. In phase 1, 12 patients (10 with CRPC and 2 with glioblastoma) received daily gefitinib (250 mg) with weekly everolimus (30, 50, or 70 mg). In phase 2, 27 CRPC patients received gefitinib with everolimus (70 mg).

titre: Occurrence and fate of selected anticancer, antimicrobial, and psychotropic pharmaceuticals in an urban river in a subcatchment of the Yodo River basin, Japan.
resume_court: Pollution status of six anticancer agents in the river water and effluents of sewage treatment plants (STPs) in Japan was surveyed with comparative analysis of the levels of four microbial and one psychotropic pharmaceuticals widely used for therapeutic medication. Ozonation at sewage treatment plants was effective in removing these compounds.

titre: Non-ocular primary malignancies in patients with uveal melanoma: the Liverpool experience.
resume_court: To identify the prevalence of self-reported non-ocular primary malignancies in patients at the time of diagnosis with uveal melanoma (UM) and to describe the cohort's characteristics. A total of 5042 (2563 males, 50.8%) patients with UM were found in the database; of whom, 216 (4.3%) had at least one other primary non-ocular malignancy. Of these 216 patients, 119 were males (55.1%).

titre: Regulation of microtubule dynamics by DIAPH3 influences amoeboid tumor cell mechanics and sensitivity to taxanes.
resume_court: Taxanes are widely employed chemotherapies for patients with metastatic prostate and breast cancer. Here, we show that loss of Diaphanous-related formin-3 (DIAPH3), frequently associated with metastatic breast and prostate cancers, correlates with increased sensitivity to taxanes. Silencing of DIAPH3 increased the cytotoxic response to taxanes in prostate and breast cancer cell lines.

titre: Influence of learning curve in the diagnosis of prostate cancer by ultrasound guided biopsy.
resume_court: Median age was 67 years (42-90). 300 biopsies (38%) were positive for prostate cancer. On univariate analysis, regarding cancer detection rate, the variables surgeon, PSA, DRE, ultrasound result, prostate volume, number of cores and groups of 75 showed statistically significant differences, this latter showing 32% in the first 75 biopsies and 43.2% in the last group.

titre: Differences in Prostatic Specific Antigen request patterns in Primary Care setting: A Pilot study in Spain.
resume_court: The objective was to compare the inter-practice and inter-regional variability in total and free PSA (tPSA and fPSA) requests by General Practitioners (GPs). Test requests per 1,000 inhabitants and fPSA/tPSA request ratio were calculated. tPSA/1,000 inhabitants ranged from 8.2 to 92.7.

titre: Repurposing of phentolamine as a potential anticancer agent against human castration-resistant prostate cancer: A central role on microtubule stabilization and mitochondrial apoptosis pathway.
resume_court: Drug repurposing of phentolamine, an a-adrenoceptor antagonist, as an anticancer agent has been studied in human castration-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC). Furthermore, combination between phentolamine and paclitaxel induces a synergistic apoptotic cell death. Optimization of phentolamine structure may also be a potential approach for further development.

titre: CT Imaging Findings of Metastatic Spindle Cell Sarcoma of Prostate: A Case Report and Review of the Literature.
resume_court: Sarcomas of the prostate are rare tumors. Imaging plays an important role in the management and diagnosis of patients with prostate sarcomas. Herein, we present a rare case of metastatic spindle cell sarcoma of prostate with computed tomography imaging findings.

titre: Biomarkers of Dietary Polyphenols in Cancer Studies: Current Evidence and Beyond.
resume_court: Polyphenols, commonly contained in fruits and vegetables, have long been associated with a protective role against multiple diseases and adverse health effects. Isoflavone is the only widely studied polyphenol. More evidence should be collected by utilizing biomarkers of exposure for polyphenols in future epidemiological studies before a clear conclusion can be made.

titre: Potential Effects of Pomegranate Polyphenols in Cancer Prevention and Therapy.
resume_court: Cancer is the second leading cause of death and is becoming the leading one in old age. However, the genotoxicity reported for pomegranate raised certain concerns over its safety and an accurate assessment of the risk/benefit should be performed before suggesting the use of pomegranate or its polyphenols for cancer-related therapeutic purposes.

titre: Prognostic Factors for Prostate Cancer Endpoints Following Biochemical Failure: A Review of the Literature.
resume_court: A search of PubMed from 1980 to 2013 yielded 999 studies that examined prognostic factors predictive for PCSS, MFS, and/or OS in prostate cancer patients with BCF following primary treatment. Our systematic literature review has identified PSADT, TTBF, pGS, and age as the leading prognostic factors for the prediction of PCSS, MFS, and OS after BCF.

titre: Development of ProCaRS Clinical Nomograms for Biochemical Failure-free Survival Following Either Low-Dose Rate Brachytherapy or Conventionally Fractionated External Beam Radiation Therapy for Localized Prostate Cancer.
resume_court: Multivariable Cox regression analysis for BFFS was performed separately for each cohort and used to generate clinical nomograms predictive of 5-year BFFS. Clinical nomograms examining 5-year BFFS were developed for patients receiving either LDR brachytherapy or conventionally fractionated EBRT and may assist clinicians in predicting an outcome.

titre: Ultrasound Imaging in Radiation Therapy: From Interfractional to Intrafractional Guidance.
resume_court: External beam radiation therapy (EBRT) is included in the treatment regimen of the majority of cancer patients. More recently, several research groups have introduced concepts for intrafractional US guidance systems leveraging robotic probe placement technology and real-time soft tissue tracking software.

titre: Difference in Association of Obesity With Prostate Cancer Risk Between US African American and Non-Hispanic White Men in the Selenium and Vitamin E Cancer Prevention Trial (SELECT).
resume_court: African American men have the highest rates of prostate cancer incidence and mortality in the United States. Understanding underlying reasons for this disparity could identify preventive interventions important to African American men. Additional research is needed to elucidate the mechanisms underlying the differential effects of obesity in African American and non-Hispanic white men.

titre: Intracellular oxygen determined by respiration regulates localization of Ras and prenylated proteins.
resume_court: Reduction of mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) content induces the reduction of oxidative phosphorylation and dependence on fermentative glycolysis, that is, the Warburg effect. Prelamin A/C was translocated to the nuclear membrane and formed a proper nuclear envelope. These results demonstrate that intracellular oxygen concentration regulates the localization and activation of prenylated proteins.

titre: Androgen Receptor Splice Variant 7 and Efficacy of Taxane Chemotherapy in Patients With Metastatic Castration-Resistant Prostate Cancer.
resume_court: Of 37 taxane-treated patients enrolled, 17 (46%) had detectable AR-V7 in CTCs. In AR-V7-positive patients, PSA responses were higher in taxane-treated vs enzalutamide- or abiraterone-treated men (41% vs 0%; P?<?.001), and PSA PFS and PFS were significantly longer in taxane-treated men (HR, 0.19 [95% CI, 0.07-0.52] for PSA PFS, P?=?.001; HR, 0.21 [95% CI, 0.07-0.59] for PFS, P?=?.003).

titre: Whole-Exome Sequencing of Metastatic Cancer and Biomarkers of Treatment Response.
resume_court: Understanding molecular mechanisms of response and resistance to anticancer therapies requires prospective patient follow-up and clinical and functional validation of both common and low-frequency mutations. The establishment of a clinical trial for WES of metastatic tumors with prospective follow-up of patients can help identify candidate predictive biomarkers of response.

titre: The Global Burden of Cancer 2013.
resume_court: Cancer is among the leading causes of death worldwide. Prostate cancer was the leading cause for cancer incidence (1.4 million) for men and breast cancer for women (1.8 million). For women, breast cancer was the leading cause of DALYs (13.1 million).

titre: A combination of desmopressin and docetaxel inhibit cell proliferation and invasion mediated by urokinase-type plasminogen activator (uPA) in human prostate cancer cells.
resume_court: This study was designed to assess the effectiveness of a combination treatment using both desmopressin and docetaxel in prostate cancer treatment. In this study, we investigated the anti-tumor effect of desmopressin in combination with docetaxel in vitro and in vivo. The combination of desmopressin and docetaxel resulted in a significant inhibition of PC3 and LNCaP cell proliferation (p < 0.01).

titre: A Phase 1, Open-Label Study of the Biodistribution, Pharmacokinetics, and Dosimetry of 223Ra-Dichloride in Patients with Hormone-Refractory Prostate Cancer and Skeletal Metastases.
resume_court: The ranges of absorbed doses delivered to the red marrow were 177-994 and 1-5 mGy/MBq from activity on the bone surfaces and from activity in the blood, respectively. The lack of adverse myelotoxicity implies that the absorbed dose delivered from the circulating activity may be a more relevant guide to the potential for marrow toxicity than that due to activity on the bone surfaces.

titre: Auger Radiopharmaceutical Therapy Targeting Prostate-Specific Membrane Antigen.
resume_court: Auger electron emitters such as (125)I have a high linear energy transfer and short range of emission (<10 µm), making them suitable for treating micrometastases while sparing normal tissues. PSMA-targeted radiopharmaceutical therapy with the Auger emitter (125)I-DCIBzL yielded highly specific antitumor efficacy in vivo, suggesting promise for treatment of prostate cancer micrometastases.

titre: Multimodal Partial-Volume Correction: Application to 18F-Fluoride PET/CT Bone Metastases Studies.
resume_court: (18)F-fluoride PET/CT offers the opportunity for accurate skeletal metastasis staging, compared with conventional imaging methods. When compared with standard PET images, the phantom experiments showed a bias reduction of 14% in activity and 1.3 cm(3) in volume estimates for PSF images and up to 20% and 2.5 cm(3) for the SFS-RR images.

titre: Novel perspectives in cancer therapy: Targeting ion channels.
resume_court: By controlling ion fluxes at multiple time scales, ion channels shape rapid cell signals, such as action potential and synaptic transmission, as well as much slower processes, such as mitosis and cell migration. Long-term in vitro work has established that inhibition of these ion channels impairs the growth of cancer cells. A paradigmatic case is offered by Kv11.1 (hERG1) channels.

titre: Targeting stromal-induced pyruvate kinase M2 nuclear translocation impairs oxphos and prostate cancer metastatic spread.
resume_court: Cancer associated fibroblasts (CAFs) are key determinants of cancer progression. In prostate carcinoma (PCa), CAFs induce epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) and metabolic reprogramming of PCa cells towards oxidative phosphorylation (OXPHOS), promoting tumor growth and metastatic dissemination.

titre: The FORECAST Study - Focal Recurrent Assessment and Salvage Treatment for Radiorecurrent Prostate Cancer.
resume_court: One-third of men may experience biochemical failure by 8years following radical radiotherapy for localised prostate cancer. In order to deliver FST, distant disease must be ruled-out and intra-prostatic disease must be accurately detected, localised and characterised. In order to deliver FST, intra- and extra-prostatic disease must be detected early and localised accurately.

titre: A pilot, multisite, randomized controlled trial of a self-directed coping skills training intervention for couples facing prostate cancer: accrual, retention, and data collection issues.
resume_court: To examine the acceptability of the methods used to evaluate Coping-Together, one of the first self-directed coping skill intervention for couples facing cancer, and to collect preliminary efficacy data. Two couples withdrew from MEC, none from Coping-Together. Trends in favor of Coping-Together were noted for both patients and their partners.

titre: Chronic baseline prostate inflammation is associated with lower tumor volume in men with prostate cancer on repeat biopsy: Results from the REDUCE study.
resume_court: Chronic, acute inflammation, and both were detected in 531 (60%), 12 (1%), and 84 (9%) baseline biopsies, respectively. Acute and chronic inflammation were significantly associated with each other (P?<?0.001). In a cohort of men with 2-year repeat prostate biopsy positive for PC after a negative baseline biopsy, baseline chronic inflammation was associated with lower PC volume.

titre: Reactive stroma in the prostate during late life: The role of microvasculature and antiangiogenic therapy influences.
resume_court: Prostate cancer is associated to a reactive stroma microenvironment characterized by angiogenic processes that are favorable for tumor progression. Thus, we investigated the occurrence of reactive stroma in the mouse prostate during advanced age as well as the effects of antiangiogenic and androgen ablation therapies on reactive stroma recruitment.

titre: Trends of prostate cancer incidence and mortality in Shanghai, China from 1973 to 2009.
resume_court: The incidence and mortality of prostate cancer (PCa) were historically low in China but have increased considerably in recent years. This study aimed to describe the detailed trend of PCa incidence and mortality in Shanghai, China. The incidence and mortality of PCa have increased significantly in Shanghai, China over the past four decades.

titre: Clinical significance of proliferative inflammatory atrophy finding in prostatic biopsies.
resume_court: Proliferative inflammatory atrophy (PIA) has been involved in prostatic carcinogenesis. Overall incidence of PIA and HGPIN was 30.3% and 54%. PCa was found in 27.5% PBs with PIA and 42.7% of those without PIA, P < 0.001.

titre: Androgen deprivation of prostate cancer: Leading to a therapeutic dead end.
resume_court: Androgen deprivation therapy (ADT) is considered as the standard therapy for men with de novo or recurrent metastatic prostate cancer. In this review, we describe molecular alterations in tumor cells during ADT, which lead to deregulation of different signaling pathways and castration-resistance, and how they might interfere with the clinical outcome of different second-line therapeutics.

titre: Fibulin-1 functions as a prognostic factor in lung adenocarcinoma.
resume_court: Fibulin-1 is a member of the fibulin gene family, characterized by tandem arrays of epidermal growth factor-like domains and a C-terminal fibulin-type module. However, whether fibulin-1 also acts as a tumor suppressor gene in lung adenocarcinoma remains unknown. The results supported our hypothesis that fibulin-1 can act as a prognostic factor in lung adenocarcinoma progression.

titre: Correlation of High Body Mass Index With More Advanced Localized Prostate Cancer at Radical Prostatectomy Is Not Reflected in PSA Level and PSA Density but Is Seen in PSA Mass.
resume_court: Prostate cancer screening algorithms and preoperative nomograms do not include patients' body mass index (BMI). Median PSA mass increased with increasing BMI: 15.9 vs 17.4 vs 19.4 µg (P < .001). Median prostate weight increased with increasing BMI: 44 vs 45 vs 49 g (P < .001).

titre: Localization and upregulation of survivin in cancer health disparities: a clinical perspective.
resume_court: Survivin is one of the most important members of the inhibitors of apoptosis protein family, as it is expressed in most human cancers but is absent in normal, differentiated tissues.

titre: Association between EHBP1 rs721048(A>G) polymorphism and prostate cancer susceptibility: a meta-analysis of 17 studies involving 150,678 subjects.
resume_court: EHBP1 rs721048(A) was first identified as a prostate cancer (PCa) risk in Caucasians by genome-wide association study, but subsequent replication studies involving Caucasian and other ethnicities did not produce consistent results. The aim of this study was to obtain a more definite association between rs721048(A) and PCa risk.

titre: Anticancer Effect of a Novel Proteasome Inhibitor, YSY01A, via G2/M Arrest in PC-3M Cells in vitro and in vivo.
resume_court: YSY01A is a new tripeptideboronic acid and an analog of PS341. YSY01A arrested PC-3M cells in the G2/M phase of the cell cycle by flow cytometry (FCM). The mechanism of the YSY01A-mediated antitumor effect is that the cell cycle is arrested at the G2/M stage.

titre: Human Stromal Cells in the Peripheral Zone of the Prostate Promote Tumorigenesis of Prostatic Cancer Stem Cells through Up-regulation of C-Kit Expression.
resume_court: Most prostate cancers originate from the prostatic peripheral zone (PZ). The volume and weight of tumors were significantly higher in mice transplanted with DU145 and stromal cells from PZ. The purified DU145 cells isolated from the tumors with DU145 and stromal cells in PZ had increased ability to migrate and proliferate, and had increased expression of C-Kit.

titre: Cellular prostatic acid phosphatase (cPAcP) serves as a useful biomarker of histone deacetylase (HDAC) inhibitors in prostate cancer cell growth suppression.
resume_court: Prostate cancer (PCa) is the most commonly diagnosed solid tumor and the second leading cancer death in the United States, and also one of the major cancer-related deaths in Chinese. cPAcP protein level was increased by HDAC inhibitor treatment. Further, HDAC inhibitor pretreatments increased androgen responsiveness as demonstrated by PSA protein level quantitation.

titre: Immature Colon Carcinoma Transcript 1 Is Essential for Prostate Cancer Cell Viability and Proliferation.
resume_court: Prostate cancer is the second leading cause of cancer-related death among men in the United States. The authors selected two ICT1-specific short hairpin RNA (shRNA) sequences to block its endogenous expression in human androgen-independent prostate cancer cell lines DU145 and PC-3. Decreased ICT1 expression by either specific shRNA significantly inhibited cell viability and proliferation.

titre: Precision Medicine and Men's Health.
resume_court: Precision medicine can greatly benefit men's health by helping to prevent, diagnose, and treat prostate cancer, benign prostatic hyperplasia, infertility, hypogonadism, and erectile dysfunction.

titre: Design, synthesis and cytotoxicity studies of dithiocarbamate ester derivatives of emetine in prostate cancer cell lines.
resume_court: A small library of emetine dithiocarbamate ester derivatives were synthesized in 25-86% yield via derivatization of the N2'- position of emetine. Consequently, it appears that S-alkylation of compound 1 leads to a more stable dithiocarbamate ester derivative that resulted in lower anticancer activity in the prostate cancer cell lines.

titre: Co-targeting AR and HSP90 suppresses prostate cancer cell growth and prevents resistance mechanisms.
resume_court: Persistent androgen receptor (AR) signaling in castration resistant prostate cancer (CRPC) underpins the urgent need for therapeutic strategies that better target this pathway. Likewise, the heat shock response that is typically elicited with therapeutic doses of Hsp90 inhibitors, and is a potential mediator of resistance to these agents, was significantly reduced by combination treatment.

titre: European Code against Cancer 4th Edition: Physical activity and cancer.
resume_court: Physical activity is a complex, multidimensional behavior, the precise measurement of which is challenging in free-living individuals. Nonetheless, representative survey data show that 35% of the European adult population is physically inactive. Such advancements in physical activity measurement will help clarify the relationship between physical activity and cancer risk and survival.

titre: (68)Ga-PSMA-PET/CT-Guided Salvage Retroperitoneal Lymph Node Dissection for Disease Relapse After Radical Prostatectomy for Prostate Cancer.
Efficacy of Cabazitaxel in Castration-resistant Prostate Cancer Is Independent of the Presence of AR-V7 in Circulating Tumor Cells.
resume_court: To investigate the association between AR-V7 expression in CTCs and resistance to cabazitaxel. The response to cabazitaxel seems to be independent of the AR-V7 status of CTCs from mCRPC patients. Consequently, cabazitaxel might be a valid treatment option for patients with AR-V7-positive CTCs.

titre: Progression-free Survival Following Stereotactic Body Radiotherapy for Oligometastatic Prostate Cancer Treatment-naive Recurrence: A Multi-institutional Analysis.
resume_court: The literature on metastasis-directed therapy for oligometastatic prostate cancer (PCa) recurrence consists of small heterogeneous studies. We included patients with three or fewer metastases. A lower radiotherapy dose predicted a higher local recurrence rate with a 3-yr LPFS of 79% for patients treated with a biologically effective dose =100Gy versus 99% for patients treated with >100Gy (p=0.01).

titre: Prognostic value of Caveolin-1 in patients treated with radical prostatectomy: a multicentric validation study.
resume_court: To validate Caveolin-1 as an independent prognostic marker of biochemical recurrence (BCR) in a large multi-institutional cohort of patients with prostate cancer treated with radical prostatectomy (RP). In subgroup analyses, Caveolin-1 was associated with BCR in patients with favourable pathological features (pT2pN0 and Gleason score = 6; P = 0.021).

titre: Antitumor Activity of Ionic Liquids Based on Ampicillin.
resume_court: Significant antiproliferative effects against various tumor cell lines were observed with novel ampicillin salts as ionic liquids. The most promising combination of antitumor activity and low toxicity toward healthy cells was observed for the 1-hydroxyethyl-3-methylimidazolium-ampicillin pair ([C2 OHMIM][Amp]), making this the most suitable lead API-IL for future studies.

titre: Proposed prognostic scoring system evaluating risk factors for biochemical recurrence of prostate cancer after salvage radiation therapy.
resume_court: To update a previously proposed prognostic scoring system that predicts risk of biochemical recurrence (BCR) after salvage radiation therapy (SRT) for recurrent prostate cancer when using additional patients and a PSA value of 0.2 ng/mL and rising as the definition of BCR. At 5 years after SRT, 40% of patients were free of BCR.

titre: Ultrasensitive cytosensing based on an aptamer modified nanobiosensor with a bioconjugate: Detection of human non-small-cell lung cancer cells.
resume_court: A novel aptamer-based amperometric nanobiosensor was designed for the sensitive and selective detection of A549 human non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) cells. An excellent dynamic range of the proposed method was obtained from 15 to 1×10(6) cells/mL with a detection limit of 8 cells/mL.

titre: Patient specific modeling of palpation-based prostate cancer diagnosis: effects of pelvic cavity anatomy and intrabladder pressure.
resume_court: Computational modeling has become a successful tool for scientific advances including understanding the behavior of biological and biomedical systems as well as improving clinical practice. The conclusions and suggestions of this work have potential use not only in clinical practice and also for biomechanical modeling where structural patient-specificity needs to be considered. © 2015 The Authors.

titre: Prostate Cancer Knowledge and Decision Making Among African-American Men and Women in the Southeastern United States.
resume_court: This study used multiple methods for assessing African-American (AA) men's and their female relatives, friends, and significant others' knowledge and cancer-related decision-making practices within the context of a prostate cancer (PrCA) education program. Findings showed that men often relied on their female "significant other" and doctors for guidance on cancer-related decisions.

titre: Definitive 3D-CRT for clinically localized prostate cancer: modifications of the clinical target volume following a prostate MRI and the clinical benefits.
resume_court: To evaluate the modifications of the tumor stage and clinical target volume following a prostate magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) to evaluate the tumor (T) staging, and the clinical benefits for prostate cancer. Of the 410 patients, 189 patients had undergone a prostate MRI study to evaluate the T staging, and 221 patients had not.

titre: The Risk of Distant Metastases and Cancer Specific Survival in Men with Serum Prostate Specific Antigen Values above 100 ng/ml.
resume_court: Current EAU (European Association of Urology) guidelines state that prostate specific antigen 100 ng/ml or greater at diagnosis indicates metastatic disease. Only 59% of 3,527 men with prostate specific antigen 100 to 300 mg/ml had distant metastases on imaging. A fourth of men with prostate specific antigen 100 ng/ml or greater did not have distant metastases.

titre: Assessment of Prospectively Assigned Likert Scores for Targeted Magnetic Resonance Imaging-Transrectal Ultrasound Fusion Biopsies in Patients with Suspected Prostate Cancer.
resume_court: On multiple logistic regression analysis Likert score, lesion size and prostate volume were significant predictors of targeted biopsy positivity. The Likert scale score used to convey the degree of suspicion on multiparametric magnetic resonance imaging is the strongest predictor of targeted biopsy positivity and of the presence of clinically significant tumor.

titre: Strigolactone analogs act as new anti-cancer agents in inhibition of breast cancer in xenograft model.
resume_court: Strigolactones (SLs) are a novel class of plant hormones. Previously, we found that analogs of SLs induce growth arrest and apoptosis in breast cancer cell lines. In addition we show that SLs affect the integrity of the microtubule network and therefore may inhibit the migratory phenotype of the highly invasive breast cancer cell lines that were examined.

titre: Identification of Candidates for Active Surveillance: Should We Change the Current Paradigm?
resume_court: Active surveillance (AS) has been claimed to avoid overtreatment of prostate cancer (PCa). These factors lead to an incorrect classification of patients into risk groups. Although new variables would increase risk group classification, the necessary first step is to optimize the use of both prostate-specific antigen serum levels and Gleason score.

titre: PHI and PCA3 improve the prognostic performance of PRIAS and Epstein criteria in predicting insignificant prostate cancer in men eligible for active surveillance.
resume_court: To assess the performance of prostate health index (PHI) and prostate cancer antigen 3 (PCA3) when added to the PRIAS or Epstein criteria in predicting the presence of pathologically insignificant prostate cancer (IPCa) in patients who underwent radical prostatectomy (RP) but eligible for active surveillance (AS). PHI resulted in greater net benefit in predicting IPCa compared to PCA3.

titre: Prognostic value of metabolic parameters and clinical impact of ¹8F-fluorocholine PET/CT in biochemical recurrent prostate cancer.
resume_court: To evaluate the therapeutic impact of (18)F-fluorocholine (FCH) PET/CT in biochemical recurrent prostate cancer (PC) and to investigate the value of quantitative FCH PET/CT parameters in predicting progression-free survival (PFS). Treatment was changed in 49.6 % (68/137) of those with a positive FCH PET/CT scan and in 20 % (7/35) of those with a negative FCH PET/CT scan.

titre: Retzius-sparing robot-assisted laparoscopic radical prostatectomy: Critical appraisal of the anatomic landmarks for a complete intrafascial approach.
resume_court: The actual technique of the trans-Douglas, intrafascial nerve-sparing robotic radical prostatectomy is described. Using robotic technology, a complete intrafascial dissection of the prostate gland can be achieved through the Douglas space, reducing surgical trauma and providing excellent functional and oncological outcomes.

titre: Visually directed vs. software-based targeted biopsy compared to transperineal template mapping biopsy in the detection of clinically significant prostate cancer.
resume_court: Targeted biopsy based on cognitive or software magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) to transrectal ultrasound registration seems to increase the detection rate of clinically significant prostate cancer as compared with standard biopsy. At a patient level, the detection rate was 32 (64%), 34 (68%), and 38 (76%) for visually directed targeted, software-based biopsy, and TPM, respectively.

titre: Chances and risks in medical risk communication.
resume_court: Communication between physicians and patients in everyday life is marked by a number of disruptive factors. Apart from specific interests, mistakes, and misunderstandings on both sides, there are main factors that contribute to the risk in risk communication. Finally, the current work provides examples of successful risk communication.

titre: The Effect of Bisphosphonates on Bone Mineral Density in Metastatic Prostate Cancer Patients Who Are Treated with Anti-Androgen Drugs and Radiotherapy.
resume_court: To evaluate the potential effect of bisphosphonates on bone mineral density (BMD) in patients who are treated with anti-androgen drugs and radiotherapy for metastatic prostate cancer. Statistical analyses were performed with the T test. A significant increase was noted for pelvic bone and femoral neck follow-up in BMD values at the end of the 1st year compared to initial measurements in group 1.

titre: Recent progress in the development of protein-protein interaction inhibitors targeting androgen receptor-coactivator binding in prostate cancer.
resume_court: The androgen receptor (AR) is a key regulator for the growth, differentiation and survival of prostate cancer cells. Known as the castration-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC), the treatment options are limited for this advanced stage. In this review we will discuss the design and development of small-molecule inhibitors targeting the AR-coactivator interactions for the treatment of prostate cancer.

titre: Galeterone and VNPT55 induce proteasomal degradation of AR/AR-V7, induce significant apoptosis via cytochrome c release and suppress growth of castration resistant prostate cancer xenografts in vivo.
resume_court: Galeterone (Gal) is a first-in-class multi-target oral small molecule that will soon enter pivotal phase III clinical trials in castration resistant prostate cancer (CRPC) patients. The effects of gal and VNPT55 were analyzed on f-AR and AR-Vs (AR-V7/ARv567es) in LNCaP, CWR22Rv1 and DU145 (transfected with AR-Vs) human PC cells in vitro and CRPC tumor xenografts.

titre: The use of collagen-based scaffolds to simulate prostate cancer bone metastases with potential for evaluating delivery of nanoparticulate gene therapeutics.
resume_court: Prostate cancer bone metastases are a leading cause of cancer-related death in men with current treatments offering only marginally improved rates of survival. In conclusion, development of a novel 3D cell culture model of prostate cancer bone metastasis has been initiated resulting, for the first time, in the successful delivery of gene therapeutics in a 3D in vitro model.

titre: Treating Patients with Metastatic Castration Resistant Prostate Cancer: A Comprehensive Review of Available Therapies.
resume_court: The availability of newly approved treatment options for metastatic castration resistant prostate cancer is not matched with conclusive data on optimal sequencing strategies and resistance patterns. Both agents provide improved overall survival in patients with metastatic castration resistant prostate cancer who received prior docetaxel treatment and in those who are chemotherapy naïve.

titre: Near-infrared fluorescence heptamethine carbocyanine dyes mediate imaging and targeted drug delivery for human brain tumor.
resume_court: Brain tumors and brain metastases are among the deadliest malignancies of all human cancers, largely due to the cellular blood-brain and blood-tumor barriers that limit the delivery of imaging and therapeutic agents from the systemic circulation to tumors. These results show promise in the application of NIRF dyes as novel theranostic agents for the detection and treatment of brain tumors.

titre: Functional and Structural Characterization of FAU Gene/Protein from Marine Sponge Suberites domuncula.
resume_court: Finkel-Biskis-Reilly murine sarcoma virus (FBR-MuSV) ubiquitously expressed (FAU) gene is down-regulated in human prostate, breast and ovarian cancers. We found pro-apoptotic activity of sponge FAU protein. The same as its human homologue, sponge FAU increases apoptosis in human HEK293T cells.

titre: Detection of prostate cancer index lesions with multiparametric magnetic resonance imaging (mp-MRI) using whole-mount histological sections as the reference standard.
resume_court: To evaluate the sensitivity of multiparametric magnetic resonance imaging (mp-MRI) for detecting prostate cancer foci, including the largest (index) lesions. All lesions with a volume of >0.5 mL and/or pathological Gleason score of >6 were defined as clinically significant prostate cancer. Overall, mp-MRI detected 131/206 lesions including 13 of 68 'insignificant' prostate cancers.

titre: Patient- and treatment-specific predictors of genitourinary function after high-dose-rate monotherapy for favorable prostate cancer.
resume_court: High-dose-rate (HDR) brachytherapy alone is an effective treatment option for patients with early-stage prostate cancer. The purpose of this study was to quantify patient-reported short- and long-term toxicity and quality of life (QOL) after HDR monotherapy. Advanced patient age was predictive for worse sexual function on both acute and long-term followup.

titre: Tumor Necrosis Factor-related Apoptosis-inducing Ligand (TRAIL)-Troglitazone-induced Apoptosis in Prostate Cancer Cells Involve AMP-activated Protein Kinase.
resume_court: Prostate cancer (PCa) is one of the most frequently diagnosed cancers in men with limited treatment options for the hormone-resistant forms. These studies indicate the involvement of AMPK in TRAIL-TZD-mediated apoptosis and ß-catenin cleavage and suggest the possibility of utilizing AMPK as a therapeutic target in apoptosis-resistant prostate cancer.

titre: Glandular differentiation in dedifferentiated chondrosarcoma: molecular evidence of a rare phenomenon.
resume_court: Epithelial glandular differentiation in dedifferentiated chondrosarcoma has not been described. Deep parallel sequencing of the dedifferentiated component showed a nonsynonymous mutation at exon 4 of IDH1 gene at codon R132 leading to a substitution of arginine, with serine confirming glandular differentiation in dedifferentiated chondrosarcoma.

titre: Estimating the cost of caring for people with cancer at the end of life: A modelling study.
resume_court: People with advanced cancer require a range of health, social and informal care during the final phases of life. The cost to society of providing care to people at the end of their lives is significant. The cost to formal care services of replacing this care with paid care giving would be significant and demand for care will increase as the demographic profile of the population ages.

titre: Hormone therapy in combination with radiotherapy in the treatment of prostate cancer: why and in which group of patients?
resume_court: In recent years, significant development in the treatment of prostate cancer has taken place. One of the most documented methods of treatment in patients characterised by a high risk of progression is a combination of radiotherapy (RT) with long-term hormone therapy (HT).

titre: Delivery of retinoic acid to LNCap human prostate cancer cells using solid lipid nanoparticles.
resume_court: In this study retinoic acid (RTA) loaded solid lipid nanoparticles (SLNs) were optimized by tuning the process parameters (pressure/temperature) and using different lipids to develop nanodispersions with enhanced anticancer activity. The RTA-SLN dispersions have the potential to be used for prostate anticancer treatment.

titre: Metformin effects on biochemical recurrence and metabolic signaling in the prostate.
resume_court: Metformin has received considerable attention as a potential anti-cancer agent. We examine the effects of metformin on PCa biochemical recurrence (BCR) in a large clinical database followed by evaluating metabolic signaling changes in a cohort of men undergoing prostate needle biopsy (PNB). Cox regression was performed to determine association with BCR relative to metformin use.

titre: Prolactin- and testosterone-induced carboxypeptidase-D correlates with increased nitrotyrosines and Ki67 in prostate cancer.
resume_court: Carboxypeptidase-D (CPD) cleaves C-terminal arginine for conversion to nitric oxide (NO) by nitric oxide synthase (NOS). Archival paraffin-embedded tissues from 113 men with BPH or PCa were used for immunohistochemical (IHC) analysis of CPD, nitrotyrosines, phospho-Stat5 (for activated PRLR), AR, eNOS/iNOS, and Ki67. CPD, nitrotyrosines, and Ki67 tended to co-localize, as did phospho-Stat5.

titre: A comparison of plasma and prostate lycopene in response to typical servings of tomato soup, sauce or juice in men before prostatectomy.
resume_court: Tomato product consumption and estimated lycopene intake are hypothesised to reduce the risk of prostate cancer. Consumption of typical servings of processed tomato products results in differing plasma and prostate lycopene concentrations. Factors including meal composition and genetics deserve further evaluation to determine their impacts on lycopene absorption and biodistribution.

titre: Perceived influences on post-diagnostic dietary change among a group of men with prostate cancer.
resume_court: A cancer diagnosis is often associated with loss of agency and control that can adversely affect well-being. Evidence for the effectiveness of post-diagnostic dietary change in prostate cancer is not conclusive, which can cause uncertainty among patients and health professionals. The study points to the importance of the family context in enabling the men to implement dietary change.

titre: Health literacy-listening skill and patient questions following cancer prevention and screening discussions.
resume_court: Patient question-asking is essential to shared decision making. We sought to describe patients' questions when faced with cancer prevention and screening decisions, and to explore differences in question-asking as a function of health literacy with respect to spoken information (health literacy-listening). Two authors developed a coding scheme, which was applied to all questions.

titre: Review of advanced catheter technologies in radiation oncology brachytherapy procedures.
resume_court: The development of new catheter and applicator technologies in recent years has significantly improved treatment accuracy, efficiency, and outcomes in brachytherapy. The accuracy of catheter reconstruction, imaging artifacts, and other notable properties of plastic and titanium applicators in gynecologic treatments are reviewed.

titre: Targeted nanomedicine for prostate cancer therapy: docetaxel and curcumin co-encapsulated lipid-polymer hybrid nanoparticles for the enhanced anti-tumor activity in vitro and in vivo.
resume_court: Docetaxel (DTX) remains the only effective drug for prolonging survival and improving quality of life of metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) patients. DTX and CUR co-encapsulated LPNs (DTX-CUR-LPNs) were constructed. DTX-CUR-LPNs showed highest cytotoxicity and synergistic effect of two drugs in tumor cells in vitro.

titre: Multimodal imaging guided preclinical trials of vascular targeting in prostate cancer.
resume_court: The high mortality rate associated with castration-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC) underscores the need for improving therapeutic options for this patient population. This reduction in blood flow was validated by US and MRI. These results demonstrate the therapeutic potential of vascular targeting in combination with androgen deprivation against prostate cancer.

titre: Apparent Diffusion Coefficient Values of the Benign Central Zone of the Prostate: Comparison With Low- and High-Grade Prostate Cancer.
resume_court: The apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) values for benign central zone (CZ) of the prostate were compared with ADC values of benign peripheral zone (PZ), benign transition zone (TZ), and prostate cancer, using histopathologic findings from radical prostatectomy as the reference standard. ADC values of the groups were compared using paired t tests and ROC curve analysis.

titre: Real-Time MRI-Guided Focused Ultrasound for Focal Therapy of Locally Confined Low-Risk Prostate Cancer: Feasibility and Preliminary Outcomes.
resume_court: Focal therapy is an emerging approach to the treatment of localized prostate cancer. Oncologic outcomes were evaluated with multiparametric MRI and repeat transrectal ultrasound-guided biopsy 6 months after treatment. MRI-guided focused ultrasound is a feasible method of noninvasively ablating low-risk prostate cancers with low morbidity.

titre: Isolation and Total Synthesis of Stolonines A-C, Unique Taurine Amides from the Australian Marine Tunicate Cnemidocarpa stolonifera.
resume_court: Cnemidocarpa stolonifera is an underexplored marine tunicate that only occurs on the tropical to subtropical East Coast of Australia, with only two pyridoacridine compounds reported previously. An immunofluorescence assay on PC3 cells indicated that compounds 1 and 3 increased cell size, induced mitochondrial texture elongation, and caused apoptosis in PC3 cells.

titre: Daxx and TCF4 interaction links to oral squamous cell carcinoma growth by promoting cell cycle progression via induction of cyclin D1 expression.
resume_court: Death domain-associated protein (Daxx) has been recently implicated as a positive factor in ovarian cancer and prostate cancer, but the role of Daxx in oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC) has never been addressed. Herein, we investigate the expression and function of Daxx in OSCC. Xenograft tumor model was used to evaluate the in vivo tumorigenicity of Daxx in OSCC.

titre: Posttranscriptional regulation of T-type Ca(2+) channel expression by interleukin-6 in prostate cancer cells.
resume_court: At early stages, the growth of prostate cancers is androgen dependent. In this work we investigated whether IL-6 evoked NED of LNCaP cells results in a significant change in T-type Ca(2+) channel expression in comparison to non-stimulated LNCaP cells. These results indicate that the functional expression of T-type Ca(2+) channels is regulated by the interplay of multiple factors in LNCaP cells.

titre: Divergence between dietary folate intake and concentrations in the serum and red blood cells of aging males in the United States.
resume_court: As part of a broader study examining the relationship between serum folate concentrations and prostate cancer progression, we determined if there are age related changes in serum folate concentration compared to folate intake in the U.S. male population. Serum and RBC folate concentrations were significantly higher with age across these age groups (p < 0.001).

titre: Preclinical Testing Oncolytic Vaccinia Virus Strain GLV-5b451 Expressing an Anti-VEGF Single-Chain Antibody for Canine Cancer Therapy.
resume_court: Virotherapy on the basis of oncolytic vaccinia virus (VACV) strains is a novel approach for canine cancer therapy. Here we describe, for the first time, the characterization and the use of VACV strain GLV-5b451 expressing the anti-vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) single-chain antibody (scAb) GLAF-2 as therapeutic agent against different canine cancers.

titre: Nimesulide-loaded nanoparticles for the potential coadjuvant treatment of prostate cancer.
resume_court: Nimesulide (NS)-loaded nanoparticles (NPNS) were prepared from polylactide-co-glycolide (PLGA) and eventually coated with chitosan (NPNSCS). Drug encapsulation rate was high (88 ± 5% and 83 ± 7% of added drug) for NPNS and NPNSCS, respectively. NPNSCS and NPNS diluted 1/100 reduced the encapsulated drug to around 30% and 70%, respectively.

titre: A Multi-Institutional Analysis of Outcomes of Patients with Clinically Node Positive Urothelial Bladder Cancer Treated with Induction Chemotherapy and Radical Cystectomy.
resume_court: Selected patients with bladder cancer with pelvic lymphadenopathy (cN1-3) are treated with induction chemotherapy followed by radical cystectomy. The best survival outcomes are observed in male patients on cisplatin regimens with subsequent negative radical cystectomy margins and complete nodal response (pN0) with excision of 15 or more pelvic nodes.

titre: European Code against Cancer 4th Edition: Obesity, body fatness and cancer.
resume_court: Excess body weight is also a risk factor for several other diseases, including diabetes and heart disease, and is related to higher risk of premature death. In reviewing the current evidence related to excess body fat and cancer, the European Code against Cancer Nutrition Working Group has developed the following recommendation: 'Take action to be a healthy body weight'.

titre: The influence of physician recommendation on prostate-specific antigen screening.
resume_court: Prostate-specific antigen (PSA) screening is controversial, and little is known regarding a physician's effect on a patient's decision to undergo screening. The percentages of men informed and not informed of the risks and benefits of screening and the percentage men receiving recommendations for PSA screening from their provider were reported.

titre: Automated Computed Tomography-Ultrasound Cross-Modality 3-D Contouring Algorithm for Prostate.
resume_court: A novel fully automated algorithm is introduced for 3-D cross-modality image segmentation of the prostate, based on the simultaneous use of co-registered computed tomography (CT) and 3-D ultrasound (US) images. When only the CT scans were used, the average MDC value was 4.5 ± 1.7 mm (maximum value = 9.0 mm).

titre: Prediction of Complications Following Partial Nephrectomy: Implications for Ablative Techniques Candidates.
resume_court: Current guidelines recommend local tumour ablation (LTA) over partial nephrectomy (PN) in nonsurgical candidates; however, objective definitions of these candidates are lacking. To identify specific patients who would benefit from LTA more than PN. Specifically, patients at high risk of complications in case of PN may benefit the most from LTA and represent ideal LTA candidates.

titre: Activity of aminoferrocene-based prodrugs against prostate cancer.
resume_court: We tested cytotoxicity of aminoferrocene-based prodrugs towards human androgen-responsive and unresponsive prostate cancer cell lines LNCaP and DU-145 correspondingly. We observed that only prodrug 1 is active against the selected prostate cancer cells (IC50=11-27 µM) and its activity correlates with the high cell-membrane permeability and increased production of intracellular ROS.

titre: DGCR8 is essential for tumor progression following PTEN loss in the prostate.
resume_court: In human prostate cancer, the microRNA biogenesis machinery increases with prostate cancer progression. Together, these findings uncover a critical role for microRNAs in enhancing proliferation and enabling the expansion of the basal cell compartment associated with tumor progression following Pten loss.

titre: Interobserver variability study for daily cone beam computed tomography registration of prostate volumetric modulated arc therapy
resume_court: This work evaluated the interobserver variability in cone beam computed tomography (CBCT) registration for prostate cancers treated with intensity-modulated radiotherapy. This showed the importance of a daily CBCT/CT registration in prostate treatment with the possibility of a planning target volume margin reduction in the three directions.

titre: A retrospective planning analysis comparing intensity modulated radiation therapy (IMRT) to volumetric modulated arc therapy (VMAT) using two optimization algorithms for the treatment of early-stage prostate cancer.
resume_court: Three planning techniques were performed: a 5-field IMRT, VMAT using one arc (VMAT-1A), and VMAT with two arcs (VMAT-2A). Treatments using VMAT-1A were significantly faster than both IMRT and VMAT-2A. Comparison between versions 8.6 and 10.0 revealed that in the newer version, VMAT planning was significantly faster and the quality of the VMAT dose distributions produced were of a better quality.

titre: Fyn is an important molecule in cancer pathogenesis and drug resistance.
resume_court: Recent studies have demonstrated the importance of Fyn in the resistance or susceptibility of cancer cells to some anti-cancer treatments. Understanding the role of Fyn in initiation and progression of cancer and its contribution to resistance against anti-cancer therapeutic agents may facilitate the development and use of novel drugs targeting Fyn for better management of malignancies.

titre: Suicide and accidental deaths among patients with non-metastatic prostate cancer.
resume_court: Relative to other cancers, men with prostate cancer were at increased risk of suicide and accidental deaths within the first year of diagnosis and when definitive treatment was recommended but not received, suggesting the need for close monitoring and coordination with mental health professionals in at-risk men with potentially curable disease.

titre: Mitotic arrest induced in human DU145 prostate cancer cells in response to KHC-4 treatment.
resume_court: In this study, the antitumor activity of KHC-4 was analyzed using human prostate cancer (CaP) cells and the underlining anticancer mechanisms of KHC-4 were identified. KHC-4 inhibited cell proliferation and induced cytotoxicity in the castration-resistant CaP DU145 cell line. The most effective concentration of KHC-4 was 0.1 µM.

titre: Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) use is not associated with erectile dysfunction risk: results from the Prostate Cancer Prevention Trial.
resume_court: To evaluate the associations of non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) use with risk of erectile dysfunction (ED), considering the indications for NSAID use. The associations of NSAID use with ED risk were attenuated after controlling for indications for NSAID use. NSAID use was not associated with ED risk.

titre: Evaluation of pT0 prostate cancer in patients undergoing radical prostatectomy.
resume_court: To evaluate the incidence, predictors and oncological outcomes of pT0 prostate cancer (PCa). Compared with non-pT0 disease, pT0 disease was associated with longer recurrence-free survival (P < 0.05). Although pT0 has a very favourable prognosis, some men, especially those who received preoperative treatment, experience a small but non-negligible risk of disease recurrence and systemic progression.

titre: Blockade of autophagy enhances proapoptotic potential of BI-69A11, a novel Akt inhibitor, in colon carcinoma.
resume_court: BI-69A11, novel Akt inhibitor, is currently drawing much attention due to its intriguing effect in inducing apoptosis in melanoma, breast, prostate and colon cancer. Interaction between Beclin-1 and HSP90 is one of the prime causes of induction of autophagy. In summary; our findings suggest that induction of autophagy lead to the resistance of colon cancer towards BI-69A11 mediated apoptosis.

titre: Processing of voided urine for prostate cancer RNA biomarker analysis.
resume_court: Voided urine samples have been shown to contain cells released from prostate tumors. Collected urine samples were pelleted, and the RNA isolated was processed for cDNA synthesis and in vitro transcription to generate amplified sense aRNA. DMSO was used as a cell preservative for frozen storage of urine samples.

titre: Hsa-miR-146a-5p modulates androgen-independent prostate cancer cells apoptosis by targeting ROCK1.
resume_court: MicroRNAs (miRNAs) have been demonstrated playing important roles in the procession of prostate cancer cells transformation from androgen-dependence to androgen-independence. We also explored the role of hsa-miR-146a-5p (miR-146a) in MSKCC prostate cancer clinical database. We demonstrated that miR-146a was down-regulated in AIPC tissues and cell lines compared to that in the ADPC tissues.

titre: Is Eotaxin-1 a serum and urinary biomarker for prostate cancer detection and recurrence?
resume_court: Eotaxin-1 (CCL11) is a protein expressed in various tissues influencing immunoregulatory processes by acting as selective eosinophil chemo-attractant. Moreover, 40 urine samples were analyzed. Although this study has not established a prognostic role of Eotaxin-1 in PCa patients, this chemokine may serve as a diagnostic marker to distinguish between disease-free prostate and cancer.

titre: The many ways to make a luminal cell and a prostate cancer cell.
resume_court: Research in the area of stem/progenitor cells has led to the identification of multiple stem-like cell populations implicated in prostate homeostasis and cancer initiation. Given that there are multiple cells that can regenerate prostatic tissue and give rise to prostate cancer, our focus should shift to defining the signaling mechanisms that drive differentiation and progenitor self-renewal.

titre: Do Ultrasensitive Prostate Specific Antigen Measurements Have a Role in Predicting Long-Term Biochemical Recurrence-Free Survival in Men after Radical Prostatectomy?
resume_court: In this study we evaluate an ultrasensitive prostate specific antigen assay in patients with prostate cancer after radical prostatectomy to predict long-term biochemical recurrence-free survival. Prostate specific antigen concentrations in 44 men after cystoprostatectomy were all less than 0.03 ng/ml, with 95.4% less than 0.01 ng/ml.

titre: Bone scintigraphy predicts bisphosphonate-induced osteonecrosis of the jaw (BRONJ) in patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC).
resume_court: BS of mCRPC patients treated with BP was evaluated for pathologic tracer uptake of the jaws in BS suspicious for BRONJ. Pathologic tracer uptake in BS was significantly more often observed in patients who developed BRONJ compared to patients who did not (p = 0.049; OR 7.6). Patients with pathologic tracer uptake in the jaws in BS significantly more often develop BRONJ.

titre: Elevated expression of UBE2T exhibits oncogenic properties in human prostate cancer.
resume_court: Increased expression of ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme E2T (UBE2T) is reported in human prostate cancer. We here report the first functional characterization of UBE2T in prostate carcinogenesis. Ectopic expression of UBE2T significantly promotes prostate cancer cell proliferation, motility and invasion, while UBE2T depletion by shRNA significantly inhibits these abilities of prostate cancer cells.

titre: The histone demethylase PHF8 promotes prostate cancer cell growth by activating the oncomiR miR-125b.
resume_court: Prostate cancer (PCa) is the most frequently diagnosed malignancy in men. In this study, we aim to research the molecular mechanisms underlying the initiation and progression of PCa. Furthermore, miR-125b is a target of PHF8, and miR-125b seems to be essential for the hyper proliferation of PCa cells in the presence of PHF8.

titre: Adenocarcinoma of the urinary bladder.
resume_court: Adenocarcinoma is an uncommon malignancy in the urinary bladder which may arise primarily in the bladder as well as secondarily from a number of other organs. Urachal adenocarcinoma shares similar histologic features with bladder adenocarcinoma, but it has a more favorable prognosis than bladder adenocarcinoma, partly due to the relative young age of patients with urachal adenocarcinoma.

titre: Signaling mechanisms coupled to CXCL12/CXCR4-mediated cellular proliferation are PTEN-dependent.
resume_court: Intact PTEN suppresses phosphorylation of Akt downstream of PI3K activation in non-transformed cells whereas Akt phosphorylation is unimpeded in malignant cells that are often PTEN-deficient. Based on these data, we hypothesize that the CXCL12/CXCR4-mediated activation of downstream pro-proliferative signaling through the Raf/MEK/Erk or PI3K/Akt pathways is modulated by PTEN status.

titre: The role of HOXC6 in prostate cancer development.
resume_court: Homeobox (HOX) genes, which are involved in organ development and homeostasis, have been shown to be involved in normal prostate- and PCa development. In this study, we investigate the expression levels of the HOX A-D genes in PCa. HOXC6 was one of the most upregulated HOX genes in all primary, metastasized, and castration-resistant PCa.

titre: Prostaglandin E2 activates the mTORC1 pathway through an EP4/cAMP/PKA- and EP1/Ca2+-mediated mechanism in the human pancreatic carcinoma cell line PANC-1.
resume_court: Obesity, a known risk factor for pancreatic cancer, is associated with inflammation and insulin resistance. Furthermore, the increasing number of facilities, the development of hypofractionation and the selection of indications will contribute to find the true place of particle therapy, despite the "screening effect" of the cost.

titre: Probability modeling of the number of positive cores in a prostate cancer biopsy session, with applications.
resume_court: Among men, prostate cancer (CaP) is the most common newly diagnosed cancer and the second leading cause of death from cancer. The central challenge is deciding clinical significance or insignificance when the CaP biopsy results are positive but only marginally so. A related concern is deciding how to increase the number of biopsy cores for larger prostates.

titre: Recurrent antibiotic exposure may promote cancer formation--Another step in understanding the role of the human microbiota?
resume_court: Bacterial dysbiosis was previously described in human malignancies. Our aim was to evaluate possible association between antibiotic exposure and cancer risk. The association increased with the number of antibiotic courses and reached 1.4 for gastric cancers associated with >5 courses of penicillin (95% CI 1.2-1.8).

titre: A prospective comparative analysis of the accuracy of HistoScanning and multiparametric magnetic resonance imaging in the localization of prostate cancer among men undergoing radical prostatectomy.
resume_court: There is increasing interest in using imaging in the detection and localization of prostate cancer (PCa). On evaluation of cancer localization, HS identified cancer in 36/78 (46.2%) regions of interest, as compared with 41/78 (52.6%) on mpMRI (P = 0.3968). In our institution, the diagnostic accuracy of HS was inferior to that of mpMRI in PCa for PCa detection and localization.

titre: The expanding role of chemotherapy in prostate cancer.
ABO blood type correlates with survival on prostate cancer vaccine therapy.
resume_court: Immunotherapies for cancer are transforming patient care, but clinical responses vary considerably from patient to patient. To test the hypothesis, therefore, we developed a new glycan microarray-based method for determining ABO blood type. Consequently, blood type may provide an inexpensive screen to pre-select patients likely to benefit from PROSTVAC-VF therapy.

titre: Expression and mechanism of action of the SARI tumor suppressor in prostate cancer.
resume_court: In addition, the effects of the pro-inflammatory cytokine interferon (IFN)-ß on the expression of SARI in DU145 prostate cancer cells and the possible potential signaling pathways activated by SARI were detected using RT-PCR. In addition, IFN-ß might inhibit the growth of prostate cancer and promote cellular apoptosis by inducing the expression of SARI.

titre: Potential role of CXCR3 in proliferation and invasion of prostate cancer cells.
resume_court: To investigate the potential role of CXCR3 expression on prostate cancer cell proliferation and invasion and to illustrate its mechanism. The mRNA expressions of CXCR3A and CXCR3B in PC-3 cells from each group were analyzed using RT-PCR. Besides, cell proliferation ability and cell invasion ability of PC-3 cells in each group were analyzed using MTT assay and Matrige assay respectively.

titre: Prognostic implications of tissue and serum levels of microRNA-128 in human prostate cancer.
resume_court: MicroRNA-128 (miR-128) has been identified as a negative regulator of malignant phenotypes of prostate cancer (PCa) cells. Compared with non-cancerous prostate tissues and normal sera, both tissue and serum levels of miR-128 expression were significantly decreased in PCa patients (both P<0.001).

titre: Updates in advanced diffusion-weighted magnetic resonance imaging techniques in the evaluation of prostate cancer.
resume_court: Diffusion-weighted magnetic resonance imaging (DW-MRI) is considered part of the standard imaging protocol for the evaluation of patients with prostate cancer. Another technique is diffusion kurtosis imaging (DKI). Preliminary results suggest that DKI findings may have more value than findings from conventional DW-MRI for the assessment of prostate cancer.

titre: PCGEM1 stimulates proliferation of osteoarthritic synoviocytes by acting as a sponge for miR-770.
resume_court: Long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) have been reported to play important roles in cellular metabolism and development. The increased expression of PCGEM1 in human synoviocytes also suppressed the expression of miR-770. Transfection of the miR-770 precursor resulted in reduced proliferation, and induced apoptosis of human synoviocytes.

titre: NOTCH, ASCL1, p53 and RB alterations define an alternative pathway driving neuroendocrine and small cell lung carcinomas.
resume_court: Small cell lung cancers (SCLCs) and extrapulmonary small cell cancers (SCCs) are very aggressive tumors arising de novo as primary small cell cancer with characteristic genetic lesions in RB1 and TP53. In conclusion, we identified a novel pathway underlying rare secondary SCLC which may drive small cell carcinomas in organs other than lung, as well.

titre: Neutrophil and Lymphocyte Counts as Clinical Markers for Stratifying Low-Risk Prostate Cancer.
resume_court: Appropriate patient selection for active surveillance is challenging.Our study of 217 patients demonstrated that the preoperative absolute neutrophil and lymphocyte counts were better predictors of aggressive oncologic features than were the neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio in the assessment of low-risk prostate cancer patients. Survival analyses were performed using the Kaplan-Meier method.

titre: Individualization of Adjuvant Therapy After Radical Prostatectomy for Clinically Localized Prostate Cancer: Current Status and Future Directions.
resume_court: Radiation therapy indications in the postprostatectomy setting are evolving. Several retrospective series have identified a number of "high-risk" pathologic features associated with an elevated risk of disease recurrence after radical prostatectomy. Furthermore, some patients without high-risk features will develop recurrence.

titre: Filamin A: Insights into its Exact Role in Cancers.
resume_court: Filamin A (FlnA) is a well-known actin cross-linking protein. When localized to the cytoplasm, FlnA has a tumor-promoting effect by interacting with signaling molecules.
