resume_court: The objective of this study was to examine the rural-urban differences in Medicare expenditures on end-of-life care for elderly cancer patients in the United States. Rural patients cost Medicare about 10%, 6%, 8%, and 4% less on end-of-life care than their urban counterparts for breast, prostate, colorectal, and lung cancer, respectively.

titre: International expert consensus conference on testosterone deficiency and its treatment held in Prague, Czech Republic.
resume_court: An international expert consensus conference regarding testosterone deficiency (TD) (also known as hypogonadism) and its treatment was held on 1 October 2015, in Prague, Czech Republic. Final consensus statements (resolutions) are under development. It is hoped these will serve as a scientific foundation for further discussion, and will thereby reduce misinformation regarding TD and its treatment.

titre: Osteoblasts promote castration-resistant prostate cancer by altering intratumoral steroidogenesis.
resume_court: The skeleton is the preferred site for prostate cancer (PC) metastasis leading to incurable castration-resistant disease. Together, our results demonstrate that osteoblasts are important mediators of the intratumoral steroidogenesis of CRPC and for castration-resistant growth in bone. Targeting osteoblasts may therefore be important in the development of new therapeutic approaches.

titre: Chemical composition of the essential oil from the leaves of Anaxagorea brevipes (Annonaceae) and evaluation of its bioactivity.
resume_court: The essential oil obtained by hydrodistillation from leaves of Anaxagorea brevipes was analysed by gas chromatography fitted with a flame ionisation detector (GC-FID) and coupled to mass spectrometry (GC-MS). Thirty one components were identified, representing around 75.7% of total oil. This is the first report regarding the chemical composition and bioactivity of A. brevipes essential oil.

titre: Higher-intensity exercise helps cancer survivors remain motivated.
resume_court: The aim of the present study was to determine if exercise intensity impacts upon the psychosocial responses of breast and prostate cancer survivors to a rehabilitation program. Between baseline and post-intervention, both intervention arms improved their motivation to exercise compared to the controls (p?=?0.004). Intervention participation did not improve QOL more than controls.

titre: Nanoencapsulation of natural triterpenoid celastrol for prostate cancer treatment.
resume_court: Celastrol (CL), a triterpenoid extracted from the Chinese herb Tripterygium wilfordii, has recently attracted interest for its potential antitumor effects. The antiproliferative effects on LNCaP, DU-145, and PC3 cell lines of CL-NPs, compared to those of free CL at different concentrations (0.5, 1.0, and 2.0 µM), were investigated.

titre: Pilot study on the detection of antiandrogen resistance using serial diffusion-weighted imaging of bone metastases in prostate cancer.
resume_court: To evaluate serial apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) measurements of bone metastases in prostate cancer to determine whether antiandrogen resistance can be detected and time to progression estimated. Both mean ADCs (P?=?0.042) and percentages of voxels with significantly higher ADCs on fDMs (P?=?0.039) decreased more rapidly over time in patients with a shorter progression-free interval (PFI).

titre: Use of calcium channel blockers in prostate cancer: Friends or foe?
Prostate Cancer: Utility of Whole-Lesion Apparent Diffusion Coefficient Metrics for Prediction of Biochemical Recurrence After Radical Prostatectomy.
resume_court: The purpose of this study was to investigate the additional value of whole-lesion histogram apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) metrics, when combined with standard pathologic features, in prediction of biochemical recurrence (BCR) after radical prostatectomy for prostate cancer. Pathologic features from radical prostatectomy and subsequent BCR were recorded for each patient.

titre: Ratio of Tumor to Normal Prostate Tissue Apparent Diffusion Coefficient as a Method for Quantifying DWI of the Prostate.
resume_court: ADC maps were derived from four b value combinations. The concordance correlation coefficient was higher for ADC ratios (0.883; 95% CI, 0.816-0.927) compared with absolute ADC values for normal tissue (0.873; 95% CI, 0.799-0.921) and tumor (0.792; 95% CI, 0.688-0.864). Bland-Altman analysis showed higher variation for ADC maps incorporating a b value of zero for both ratio and absolute values.

titre: Cost-effectiveness of denosumab as a bone protective agent for patients with castration resistant prostate cancer.
resume_court: Fortunately, novel agents are nowadays available for the management of patients with castration-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC). Denosumab is a new bone-protective agent, approved for the prevention and management of skeletal-related events. In the present review we study the cost-effectiveness of denosumab in patients with CRPC.

titre: CHADS2 scores as a predictor of ischemic stroke after radical prostatectomy.
resume_court: Patients with prostate cancer have an increased risk of stroke, but their absolute rate of stroke depends on age and comorbid conditions. CHADS2 scores and CCIS were used to stratify the 5-year ischemic stroke risk. The 5-year risk of ischemic stroke in the present study was 1.7%.

titre: Review of the pathophysiological aspects involved in urological disease associated with metabolic syndrome.
resume_court: Metabolic syndrome is a constellation of disorders that includes insulin resistance, central obesity, arterial hypertension and hyperlipidaemia. These disorders can have implications for the genitourinary apparatus. These facts explain the relationship between metabolic syndrome, nephrolithiasis, lower urinary tract syndrome, hypogonadism and erectile dysfunction in men.

titre: Serum androgens and prostate cancer risk: results from the placebo arm of the Prostate Cancer Prevention Trial.
resume_court: Compelling and long-standing data suggest that androgens play an important role in the development of both normal prostate epithelium and prostate cancer. Although testosterone administration can induce prostate cancer (PCA) in laboratory animals, serum-based epidemiologic studies examining androgens in humans have not consistently supported a role for androgens in prostate carcinogenesis.

titre: Mechanisms of growth inhibition of primary prostate epithelial cells following gamma irradiation or photodynamic therapy include senescence, necrosis, and autophagy, but not apoptosis.
resume_court: In comparison to more differentiated cells, prostate cancer stem-like cells are radioresistant, which could explain radio-recurrent prostate cancer. Both PDT and gamma irradiation reduced the colony-forming ability of primary prostate epithelial cells. PDT and gamma irradiation therefore inhibit cell growth by different mechanisms.

titre: HOXB13 as an immunohistochemical marker of prostatic origin in metastatic tumors.
resume_court: HOBX13 is a transcription factor expressed in the normal prostatic glands and overexpressed in prostate cancer. PSA immunostaining was detected only in 8 (53%) cases of prostatic origin. Due to its high sensitivity and specificity, HOXB13 may be included in the pool of prostate-specific markers in metastases showing absent or weak staining for PSA before excluding prostatic derivation.

titre: Designing a broad-spectrum integrative approach for cancer prevention and treatment.
resume_court: Targeted therapies and the consequent adoption of "personalized" oncology have achieved notable successes in some cancers; however, significant problems remain with this approach. Among the approaches, 1.1% had contrary, 2.8% had mixed and 62.1% had complementary relationships. These results suggest that a broad-spectrum approach should be feasible from a safety standpoint.

titre: 1-Piperazinylphthalazines as potential VEGFR-2 inhibitors and anticancer agents: Synthesis and in vitro biological evaluation.
resume_court: In our endeavor towards the development of effective VEGFR-2 inhibitors, three novel series of phthalazine derivatives based on 1-piperazinyl-4-arylphthalazine scaffold were synthesized. All the newly prepared phthalazines 16a-k, 18a-e and 21a-g were evaluated in vitro for their inhibitory activity against VEGFR-2.

titre: Multiple biomarkers biosensor with just-in-time functionalization: Application to prostate cancer detection.

titre: Safety and efficacy of salvage low-dose-rate brachytherapy for prostate bed recurrences following radical prostatectomy.

titre: Diseases masking and delaying the diagnosis of urogenital tuberculosis.

titre: Testosterone and prostate cancer: an evidence-based review of pathogenesis and oncologic risk.

titre: Salvage helical tomotherapy for prostate cancer recurrence following definitive external beam radiotherapy: A case report.

titre: Alternatively activated macrophages are associated with metastasis and poor prognosis in prostate adenocarcinoma.

titre: Role of annexin A6 in cancer.

titre: Long non-coding RNA growth arrest-specific transcript 5 in tumor biology.

titre: Primary extragonadal germ cell tumor: A case report on prostate seminoma.

titre: Integration of tissue metabolomics, transcriptomics and immunohistochemistry reveals ERG- and gleason score-specific metabolomic alterations in prostate cancer.

titre: The pepper's natural ingredient capsaicin induces autophagy blockage in prostate cancer cells.

titre: Validation of a Genomic Classifier for Predicting Post-Prostatectomy Recurrence in a Community Based Health Care Setting.

titre: The Prevalence of Clinically Significant Prostate Cancer According to Commonly Used Histological Thresholds in Men Undergoing Template Prostate Mapping Biopsies.

titre: Role of general practitioners in cancer screening: A survey in the French armed forces
resume_court: The French Military Health Service organizes medical survey of 340,000 military men. titre: Ureteral obstruction by prostate cancer leads to spontaneous ureteric rupture: a case report.

titre: The role of microRNAs in prostate cancer progression.
